declarations.name: cofinalExactLocalMersenneHalfRows_of_criticalQuotientSupply
declarations.docstring: The critical quotient supply produces exact rows at cofinally many endpoints.

declarations.name: half_mem_mersenneAchievementSet_of_criticalQuotientSupply
declarations.docstring: Conditional #257 endpoint: the critical quotient supply is sufficient to place one half in the Mersenne achievement set.

declarations.name: half_mem_mersenneAchievementSet_of_preTakePrecriticalSuffixSupply
declarations.docstring: Conditional #257 endpoint with every consecutive-skip row removed: it is enough to prove the predecessor bound only at a skipped rank whose successor is actually selected.

declarations.name: localMersenneGeometricQuotient
declarations.docstring: The quotient of one scaled Mersenne weight written without division: a shift by the Euclidean remainder times a finite geometric word.

declarations.name: localGeometricPrefixQuotient
declarations.signature: def localGeometricPrefixQuotient (D : Finset ℕ) (M : ℕ) : ℕ
declarations.docstring: The corresponding geometric normal form of a finite prefix quotient.

declarations.name: localMersenneQuotient_eq_geometric
declarations.signature: theorem localMersenneQuotient_eq_geometric {M d : ℕ} (hd : 2 ≤ d) : localMersenneQuotient M d = localMersenneGeometricQuotient M d
declarations.docstring: Euclidean division by `2^d-1` is exactly the shifted finite geometric word with ones at spacings `d`.

declarations.name: localMersenneGeometricQuotient_eq_descendingMultiples
declarations.signature: theorem localMersenneGeometricQuotient_eq_descendingMultiples {M d : ℕ} (hd : 2 ≤ d) : localMersenneGeometricQuotient M d = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (M / d), 2 ^ (M - d * (i + 1))
declarations.docstring: The same quotient word, reindexed from its highest occupied binary position down through the positive multiples of `d`.

declarations.name: localMersenneQuotient_eq_descendingMultiples
declarations.signature: theorem localMersenneQuotient_eq_descendingMultiples {M d : ℕ} (hd : 2 ≤ d) : localMersenneQuotient M d = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (M / d), 2 ^ (M - d * (i + 1))
declarations.docstring: Division-free descending-multiple form of one integral Mersenne quotient.

declarations.name: localPrefixQuotient_eq_geometric
declarations.signature: theorem localPrefixQuotient_eq_geometric {D : Finset ℕ} {M : ℕ} (hD : ∀ d ∈ D, 2 ≤ d) : localPrefixQuotient D M = localGeometricPrefixQuotient D M
declarations.docstring: Summing the pointwise normal form removes every floor division from a finite local prefix quotient.

declarations.name: localMersenneGeometricQuotient_critical_self
declarations.signature: theorem localMersenneGeometricQuotient_critical_self {c : ℕ} (hc : 4 ≤ c) : localMersenneGeometricQuotient (2 * c - 2) c = 2 ^ (c - 2)
declarations.docstring: At endpoint `2c-2`, the newly inserted crossing rank contributes exactly the single binary coin `2^(c-2)`.

declarations.name: localGeometricPrefixQuotient_insert_critical
declarations.signature: theorem localGeometricPrefixQuotient_insert_critical {D : Finset ℕ} {c : ℕ} (hc : 4 ≤ c) (hD : ∀ d ∈ D, 2 ≤ d ∧ d < c) : localGeometricPrefixQuotient (insert c D) (2 * c - 2) = 2 ^ (c - 2) + localGeometricPrefixQuotient D (2 * c - 2)
declarations.docstring: Splitting off the crossing rank leaves a core-only geometric quotient.

declarations.name: criticalQuotient_iff_geometric
declarations.signature: theorem criticalQuotient_iff_geometric {D : Finset ℕ} {c : ℕ} (hc : 4 ≤ c) (hD : ∀ d ∈ D, 2 ≤ d ∧ d < c) : 2 ^ ((2 * c - 2) - 1) ≤ localPrefixQuotient (insert c D) (2 * c - 2) ↔ 2 ^ ((2 * c - 2) - 1) ≤ localGeometricPrefixQuotient (insert c D) (2 * c - 2)
declarations.docstring: The remaining integral crossing test is equivalently an explicit finite sum of shifted powers of two.

declarations.name: criticalQuotient_iff_geometricCore_deficit
declarations.signature: theorem criticalQuotient_iff_geometricCore_deficit {D : Finset ℕ} {c : ℕ} (hc : 4 ≤ c) (hD : ∀ d ∈ D, 2 ≤ d ∧ d < c) : 2 ^ ((2 * c - 2) - 1) ≤ localPrefixQuotient (insert c D) (2 * c - 2) ↔ 2 ^ ((2 * c - 2) - 1) - 2 ^ (c - 2) ≤ localGeometricPrefixQuotient D (2 * c - 2)
declarations.docstring: After removing the crossing coin, the sharp capacity socket is a single lower bound on the old core's explicit geometric word.

declarations.name: localBinarySuffix_two_mul_sub_two_lt_criticalCapacity_iff_geometric
declarations.signature: theorem localBinarySuffix_two_mul_sub_two_lt_criticalCapacity_iff_geometric {D : Finset ℕ} {c : ℕ} (hc : 4 ≤ c) (hD : ∀ d ∈ D, 2 ≤ d ∧ d < c) (hbelow : localMersennePrefixValue D < (1 / 2 : ℚ)) : localBinarySuffix D 1 (2 * c - 2) < 2 ^ (c - 2) ↔ 2 ^ ((2 * c - 2) - 1) ≤ localGeometricPrefixQuotient (insert c D) (2 * c - 2)
declarations.docstring: Geometric-series form of `localBinarySuffix_two_mul_sub_two_lt_criticalCapacity_iff`: the sharp strict upper fill is now reduced to one explicit binary carry inequality.

declarations.name: localBinarySuffix_two_mul_sub_two_lt_criticalCapacity_iff_geometricCore
declarations.signature: theorem localBinarySuffix_two_mul_sub_two_lt_criticalCapacity_iff_geometricCore {D : Finset ℕ} {c : ℕ} (hc : 4 ≤ c) (hD : ∀ d ∈ D, 2 ≤ d ∧ d < c) (hbelow : localMersennePrefixValue D < (1 / 2 : ℚ)) : localBinarySuffix D 1 (2 * c - 2) < 2 ^ (c - 2) ↔ 2 ^ ((2 * c - 2) - 1) - 2 ^ (c - 2) ≤ localGeometricPrefixQuotient D (2 * c - 2)
declarations.docstring: Core-only form of the same sharp skipped-core capacity test.

declarations.name: localMersenneCrossingRanks
declarations.signature: def localMersenneCrossingRanks (E : Finset ℕ) : Finset ℕ
declarations.docstring: Ranks of `E` at which its inclusive ordered prefix is already above one half.

declarations.name: exists_first_localMersenne_crossing
declarations.signature: theorem exists_first_localMersenne_crossing {E : Finset ℕ} (hE : ∀ d ∈ E, 2 ≤ d) (habove : (1 / 2 : ℚ) < localMersennePrefixValue E) : ∃ c : ℕ, c ∈ E ∧ 4 ≤ c ∧ localMersennePrefixValue (E.filter fun d ↦ d < c) < (1 / 2 : ℚ) ∧ (1 / 2 : ℚ) < localMersennePrefixValue (insert c (E.filter fun d ↦ d < c))
declarations.docstring: A finite positive-rank support above one half has a first crossing rank. The prefix before that rank is strictly below one half, and adding the crossing rank crosses strictly above one half.

declarations.name: exists_skippedCoreExactRow_of_value_above
declarations.signature: theorem exists_skippedCoreExactRow_of_value_above {E : Finset ℕ} {n : ℕ} (hE : ∀ d ∈ E, 2 ≤ d ∧ d ≤ n) (habove : (1 / 2 : ℚ) < localMersennePrefixValue E) : ∃ c : ℕ, 4 ≤ c ∧ c ≤ n ∧ ExactLocalMersenneHalfRow (2 * c - 2)
declarations.docstring: **Above-support recycling.** If a finite positive-rank support bounded by `n` lies above one half, its first crossing rank supplies an unconditional skipped-core exact row. The recycled crossing rank lies between `4` and `n`.

declarations.name: exactLocalMersenneHalfRow_of_first_localMersenne_crossing
declarations.signature: theorem exactLocalMersenneHalfRow_of_first_localMersenne_crossing {E : Finset ℕ} {c : ℕ} (hc : 4 ≤ c) (hE : ∀ d ∈ E, 2 ≤ d) (hbelow : localMersennePrefixValue (E.filter fun d ↦ d < c) < (1 / 2 : ℚ)) (hcross : (1 / 2 : ℚ) < localMersennePrefixValue (insert c (E.filter fun d ↦ d < c))) : ExactLocalMersenneHalfRow (2 * c - 2)
declarations.docstring: First-crossing data can be consumed directly by the skipped-core exact-row constructor. This is the nonexistential form of the recycling step.

declarations.name: skippedCoreSharpCapacity_below_or_strictly_laterExactRow
declarations.signature: theorem skippedCoreSharpCapacity_below_or_strictly_laterExactRow {D : Finset ℕ} {c : ℕ} (hc : 4 ≤ c) (hD : ∀ d ∈ D, 2 ≤ d ∧ d < c) (hbelow : localMersennePrefixValue D < (1 / 2 : ℚ)) (hsharp : localBinarySuffix D 1 (2 * c - 2) < 2 ^ (c - 2)) : (∃ E : Finset ℕ, (∀ d ∈ E, 2 ≤ d ∧ d ≤ 2 * c - 2) ∧ localPrefixQuotient E (2 * c - 2) = 2 ^ ((2 * c - 2) - 1) - 1 ∧ localMersennePrefixValue E < (1 / 2 : ℚ)) ∨ ∃ e : ℕ, c < e ∧ e ≤ 2 * c - 2 ∧
declarations.docstring: A sharp skipped-core repair cannot recycle at the same endpoint. The `c-2`-bit capacity builds an exact row at `2c-2` using no new rank at or below `c`. If that row is below one half, it is returned as a below-half exact row. If it is above one half, its first crossing is strictly later than `c`, and recycling there produces an exact row whose endpoint is strictly larger than `2c-2`. This theorem consumes the sharp capacity inequality; it does not assert that the inequality holds for every skipped core.

declarations.name: exactLocalMersenneHalfRow_double_or_recycle
declarations.signature: theorem exactLocalMersenneHalfRow_double_or_recycle {n : ℕ} (hn : 6 ≤ n) (hrow : ExactLocalMersenneHalfRow n) : ExactLocalMersenneHalfRow (2 * n - 1) ∨ ∃ c : ℕ, 4 ≤ c ∧ c ≤ n ∧ ExactLocalMersenneHalfRow (2 * c - 2)
declarations.docstring: Every exact row of endpoint at least six has one of the two available finite continuations. If the witness's finite value is below one half, the literal upper-window construction gives an exact row at `2n-1`. If it is above one half, the first crossing gives a recycled exact row at `2c-2` for some `4 ≤ c ≤ n`. The second endpoint is intentionally not claimed to exceed `n`; a separate progress input is still required before this transition can yield cofinal exact rows.

declarations.name: boundedDoubleOrRecycleModel
declarations.docstring: A one-point predicate satisfying the same endpoint transition shape as `exactLocalMersenneHalfRow_double_or_recycle`. It is the smallest explicit falsifier for any attempt to infer cofinal exact rows from that dichotomy alone: at endpoint six the recycling arm may return to endpoint six through `c = 4` forever.

declarations.name: boundedDoubleOrRecycleModel_transition
declarations.signature: theorem boundedDoubleOrRecycleModel_transition {n : ℕ} (hn : 6 ≤ n) (hmodel : boundedDoubleOrRecycleModel n) : boundedDoubleOrRecycleModel (2 * n - 1) ∨ ∃ c : ℕ, 4 ≤ c ∧ c ≤ n ∧ boundedDoubleOrRecycleModel (2 * c - 2)

declarations.name: boundedDoubleOrRecycleModel_not_cofinal
declarations.signature: theorem boundedDoubleOrRecycleModel_not_cofinal : ¬ ∀ N : ℕ, ∃ n : ℕ, N ≤ n ∧ boundedDoubleOrRecycleModel n
declarations.docstring: The bounded transition model is not cofinal. Consequently the transition shape proved above, even together with an endpoint-six seed, cannot by itself feed `half_mem_mersenneAchievementSet_of_cofinalExactLocalRows`. A future consumer must supply strict endpoint progress or cofinality by an independent arithmetic argument.

declarations.name: exists_seeded_bounded_double_or_recycle_model
declarations.signature: theorem exists_seeded_bounded_double_or_recycle_model : ∃ P : ℕ → Prop, P 6 ∧ (∀ n : ℕ, 6 ≤ n → P n → P (2 * n - 1) ∨ ∃ c : ℕ, 4 ≤ c ∧ c ≤ n ∧ P (2 * c - 2)) ∧ ¬ ∀ N : ℕ, ∃ n : ℕ, N ≤ n ∧ P n
declarations.docstring: **Finite-to-cofinal no-go.** There exists a seeded, bounded endpoint predicate satisfying the exact double-or-recycle transition schema. This packages the route falsifier in the same logical shape used by the exact-row development.

declarations.name: one_third_le_localMersenneFraction_two
declarations.signature: theorem one_third_le_localMersenneFraction_two (M : ℕ) : (1 / 3 : ℚ) ≤ localMersenneFraction M 2
declarations.docstring: The rank-two residue is always at least one third.

declarations.name: three_mul_sub_two_lt_two_pow_pred
declarations.docstring: The elementary slack needed for the doubling window.

declarations.name: localBinarySuffix_two_mul_sub_one_lt_upperWindow_of_exact_below
declarations.signature: theorem localBinarySuffix_two_mul_sub_one_lt_upperWindow_of_exact_below {D : Finset ℕ} {n : ℕ} (hn : 6 ≤ n) (hD : ∀ d ∈ D, 2 ≤ d ∧ d ≤ n) (htwo : 2 ∈ D) (hquot : localPrefixQuotient D n = 2 ^ (n - 1) - 1) (hbelow : localMersennePrefixValue D < (1 / 2 : ℚ)) : localBinarySuffix D 1 (2 * n - 1) < 2 ^ (n - 1)
declarations.docstring: If an exact quotient row is still below one half and contains rank two, then its missing quotient at row `2n-1` fits in the pure upper window `{n+1, ..., 2n-1}`. The rank-two residue supplies one third of a full window of slack, while all old residues together cost at most `n-1`.

declarations.name: exists_exactRowStrictUpperExtension_two_mul_sub_one_of_exact_below
declarations.signature: theorem exists_exactRowStrictUpperExtension_two_mul_sub_one_of_exact_below {D : Finset ℕ} {n : ℕ} (hn : 6 ≤ n) (hD : ∀ d ∈ D, 2 ≤ d ∧ d ≤ n) (htwo : 2 ∈ D) (hquot : localPrefixQuotient D n = 2 ^ (n - 1) - 1) (hbelow : localMersennePrefixValue D < (1 / 2 : ℚ)) : ∃ E : Finset ℕ, D ⊆ E ∧ (∀ d ∈ E, d ∉ D → n < d) ∧ 2 ∈ E ∧ (∀ d ∈ E, 2 ≤ d ∧ d ≤ 2 * n - 1) ∧ localPrefixQuotient E (2 * n - 1) = 2 ^ ((2 * n - 1) - 1) - 1
declarations.docstring: A below-half exact row containing rank two has an exact extension at endpoint `2n-1`, and every newly inserted rank lies strictly above `n`. This support-separation form is the input needed to locate a later first crossing if the extension lands above one half.

declarations.name: exists_exactRowExtension_two_mul_sub_one_of_exact_below
declarations.signature: theorem exists_exactRowExtension_two_mul_sub_one_of_exact_below {D : Finset ℕ} {n : ℕ} (hn : 6 ≤ n) (hD : ∀ d ∈ D, 2 ≤ d ∧ d ≤ n) (htwo : 2 ∈ D) (hquot : localPrefixQuotient D n = 2 ^ (n - 1) - 1) (hbelow : localMersennePrefixValue D < (1 / 2 : ℚ)) : ∃ E : Finset ℕ, D ⊆ E ∧ 2 ∈ E ∧ (∀ d ∈ E, 2 ≤ d ∧ d ≤ 2 * n - 1) ∧ localPrefixQuotient E (2 * n - 1) = 2 ^ ((2 * n - 1) - 1) - 1
declarations.docstring: Compatibility projection of the strict-support extension theorem.

declarations.name: exactLocalMersenneHalfRow_two_mul_sub_one_of_exact_below
declarations.signature: theorem exactLocalMersenneHalfRow_two_mul_sub_one_of_exact_below {D : Finset ℕ} {n : ℕ} (hn : 6 ≤ n) (hD : ∀ d ∈ D, 2 ≤ d ∧ d ≤ n) (htwo : 2 ∈ D) (hquot : localPrefixQuotient D n = 2 ^ (n - 1) - 1) (hbelow : localMersennePrefixValue D < (1 / 2 : ℚ)) : ExactLocalMersenneHalfRow (2 * n - 1)
declarations.docstring: Proposition-valued corollary of the literal extension theorem.

declarations.name: two_mem_of_exact_localMersenneQuotient
declarations.signature: theorem two_mem_of_exact_localMersenneQuotient {D : Finset ℕ} {n : ℕ} (hn : 3 ≤ n) (hD : ∀ d ∈ D, 2 ≤ d ∧ d ≤ n) (hquot : localPrefixQuotient D n = 2 ^ (n - 1) - 1) : 2 ∈ D
declarations.docstring: Any exact local Mersenne quotient row at endpoint `n ≥ 3` contains rank two. The proof compares a support omitting rank two with the complete tail after rank two, then contradicts the exact quotient target after scaling.

declarations.name: exactLocalMersenneHalfRow_exists_support_with_two
declarations.signature: theorem exactLocalMersenneHalfRow_exists_support_with_two {n : ℕ} (hn : 3 ≤ n) (hrow : ExactLocalMersenneHalfRow n) : ∃ D : Finset ℕ, 2 ∈ D ∧ (∀ d ∈ D, 2 ≤ d ∧ d ≤ n) ∧ localPrefixQuotient D n = 2 ^ (n - 1) - 1
declarations.docstring: Witness form: an exact-row proposition at endpoint `n ≥ 3` admits a witness support in which rank two is explicitly present.

declarations.name: exactRowSixSupport
declarations.docstring: The concrete support underlying the endpoint-six seed.

declarations.name: exactRowSixSupport_bounds
declarations.signature: theorem exactRowSixSupport_bounds : ∀ d ∈ exactRowSixSupport, 2 ≤ d ∧ d ≤ 6

declarations.name: exactRowSixSupport_value_lt_half
declarations.docstring: The seed is on the strict below-half side, so it can enter the literal row-doubling constructor.

declarations.name: exactLocalMersenneHalfRow_six
declarations.docstring: The support `{2, 3, 6}` is an exact local Mersenne half row at endpoint six.

declarations.name: localMersenneQuotient_endpoint_succ
declarations.signature: theorem localMersenneQuotient_endpoint_succ {M d : ℕ} (hd : 2 ≤ d) : localMersenneQuotient (M + 1) d = 2 * localMersenneQuotient M d + if d ∣ M + 1 then 1 else 0
declarations.docstring: The integral Mersenne quotient has a binary endpoint transition. The new low bit is one precisely at endpoints divisible by the rank.

declarations.name: localPrefixQuotient_succ
declarations.signature: theorem localPrefixQuotient_succ {D : Finset ℕ} {M : ℕ} (hD : ∀ d ∈ D, 2 ≤ d) : localPrefixQuotient D (M + 1) = 2 * localPrefixQuotient D M + endpointDivisorContribution D (M + 1)
declarations.docstring: Summing the one-rank transition over a fixed finite Boolean support adds exactly the number of selected ranks dividing the new endpoint.

declarations.name: halfEndpointTarget
declarations.docstring: The integer target corresponding to the dyadic value immediately below `1/2` at endpoint scale `2^M`.

declarations.name: halfEndpointTarget_succ
declarations.signature: theorem halfEndpointTarget_succ {M : ℕ} (hM : 1 ≤ M) : halfEndpointTarget (M + 1) = 2 * halfEndpointTarget M + 1

declarations.name: localPrefixQuotient_succ_eq_halfEndpointTarget_iff
declarations.signature: theorem localPrefixQuotient_succ_eq_halfEndpointTarget_iff {D : Finset ℕ} {M : ℕ} (hM : 1 ≤ M) (hD : ∀ d ∈ D, 2 ≤ d) (hexact : localPrefixQuotient D M = halfEndpointTarget M) : localPrefixQuotient D (M + 1) = halfEndpointTarget (M + 1) ↔ endpointDivisorContribution D (M + 1) = 1
declarations.docstring: With a support held fixed, an exact endpoint row propagates one step if and only if exactly one selected rank divides the new endpoint.

declarations.name: localEndpointDefect
declarations.signature: def localEndpointDefect (D : Finset ℕ) (M : ℕ) : ℤ
declarations.docstring: The signed finite-row defect from the integer immediately below one half. Unlike `localBinarySuffix`, this definition never truncates subtraction.

declarations.name: localEndpointDefect_succ
declarations.signature: theorem localEndpointDefect_succ {D : Finset ℕ} {M : ℕ} (hM : 1 ≤ M) (hD : ∀ d ∈ D, 2 ≤ d) : localEndpointDefect D (M + 1) = 2 * localEndpointDefect D M + 1 - (endpointDivisorContribution D (M + 1) : ℤ)
declarations.docstring: The exact `H = 2 A + 1 - S` transition, stated without a nonnegativity assumption by working in the integers.

declarations.name: localRepairInteger_eq_localEndpointDefect_succ
declarations.signature: theorem localRepairInteger_eq_localEndpointDefect_succ {D : Finset ℕ} {M : ℕ} (hM : 1 ≤ M) (hD : ∀ d ∈ D, 2 ≤ d) (hbelow : localPrefixQuotient D M ≤ halfEndpointTarget M) : localRepairInteger D 1 (M + 1) = localEndpointDefect D (M + 1)
declarations.docstring: When the previous quotient has not crossed its endpoint target, the natural suffix is the signed defect, so `localRepairInteger` is literally the next endpoint defect.

declarations.name: globalRepairStageSupport
declarations.signature: def globalRepairStageSupport (bit : ℕ → ℕ → Bool) (n : ℕ) : Finset ℕ
declarations.docstring: The finite Boolean support displayed by row `n`. Coordinates zero and one are normalized away at the definition boundary.

declarations.name: mem_globalRepairStageSupport
declarations.signature: @[simp] theorem mem_globalRepairStageSupport {bit : ℕ → ℕ → Bool} {n d : ℕ} : d ∈ globalRepairStageSupport bit n ↔ 2 ≤ d ∧ d ≤ n ∧ bit n d = true

declarations.name: globalRepairLowerSupport
declarations.signature: def globalRepairLowerSupport (bit : ℕ → ℕ → Bool) (n : ℕ) : Finset ℕ
declarations.docstring: The part of row `n` which is already frozen before its upper-half rewrite.

declarations.name: mem_globalRepairLowerSupport
declarations.signature: @[simp] theorem mem_globalRepairLowerSupport {bit : ℕ → ℕ → Bool} {n d : ℕ} : d ∈ globalRepairLowerSupport bit n ↔ 2 ≤ d ∧ d ≤ n / 2 ∧ bit n d = true

declarations.name: BooleanMobiusGlobalRepairTrajectory
declarations.docstring: Structural part of an endpoint-by-endpoint repair trajectory. The arithmetic producer receipts are separated into `GlobalBooleanMobiusRepairFeasible` below.

declarations.name: BooleanMobiusGlobalRepairTrajectory.bit_stable
declarations.signature: theorem BooleanMobiusGlobalRepairTrajectory.bit_stable (T : BooleanMobiusGlobalRepairTrajectory) {d n : ℕ} (hdn : 2 * d ≤ n) : T.bit n d = T.bit (2 * d) d
declarations.docstring: Once endpoint `2d` has been reached, coordinate `d` never changes.

declarations.name: globalRepairLimitBit
declarations.docstring: The diagonal limit bit: inspect coordinate `d` at the first row after which the upper-half rewrites can no longer touch it.

declarations.name: globalRepairLimitSupport
declarations.docstring: The positive frozen support selected by the diagonal limit word.

declarations.name: mem_globalRepairLimitSupport
declarations.signature: @[simp] theorem mem_globalRepairLimitSupport {T : BooleanMobiusGlobalRepairTrajectory} {d : ℕ} : d ∈ globalRepairLimitSupport T ↔ 2 ≤ d ∧ T.bit (2 * d) d = true

declarations.name: globalRepairStageSupport_agrees_limit_of_le_half
declarations.signature: theorem globalRepairStageSupport_agrees_limit_of_le_half (T : BooleanMobiusGlobalRepairTrajectory) {n d : ℕ} (hd : d ≤ n / 2) : d ∈ globalRepairStageSupport T.bit n ↔ d ∈ globalRepairLimitSupport T
declarations.docstring: A row and the diagonal limit agree through that row's frozen half.

declarations.name: GlobalEndpointExponentialBound
declarations.docstring: The empirically observed endpoint inequality which makes every repair integer nonnegative. This is a named open producer, not a conclusion of the global limit argument.

declarations.name: globalRepairUpperWord
declarations.signature: def globalRepairUpperWord (T : BooleanMobiusGlobalRepairTrajectory) (n : ℕ) : List ℕ
declarations.docstring: The upper-half row, read from endpoint `n` downwards as a natural least-significant-digit-first word.

declarations.name: globalRepairUpperWord_length
declarations.signature: theorem globalRepairUpperWord_length (T : BooleanMobiusGlobalRepairTrajectory) (n : ℕ) : (globalRepairUpperWord T n).length = upperHalfRepairLength n

declarations.name: globalRepairUpperWord_boolean
declarations.signature: theorem globalRepairUpperWord_boolean (T : BooleanMobiusGlobalRepairTrajectory) (n : ℕ) : ∀ b ∈ globalRepairUpperWord T n, b = 0 ∨ b = 1

declarations.name: GlobalBooleanMobiusRepairFeasible
declarations.docstring: Full finite receipt for the endpoint process. Of its four clauses, the exponential bound is the genuine arithmetic producer. Word realization, capacity, and the quotient equality are finite algebraic audit clauses kept here so the limit theorem cannot silently assume them. The quotient clause says that the row has consumed precisely every binary integer below the target `1/2` at scale `2^n`; the missing unit is carried by the sum of the Mersenne fractional parts.

declarations.name: globalRepairInteger_nonneg
declarations.signature: theorem globalRepairInteger_nonneg (T : BooleanMobiusGlobalRepairTrajectory) (hbound : GlobalEndpointExponentialBound T) {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) : 0 ≤ localRepairInteger (globalRepairLowerSupport T.bit n) 1 n
declarations.docstring: The named exponential producer discharges endpoint nonnegativity through the local theorem.

declarations.name: localMersenneFraction_lt_one
declarations.signature: theorem localMersenneFraction_lt_one {M d : ℕ} (hd : 2 ≤ d) : localMersenneFraction M d < 1
declarations.docstring: The named exponential producer discharges endpoint nonnegativity through the local theorem. -/ theorem globalRepairInteger_nonneg (T : BooleanMobiusGlobalRepairTrajectory) (hbound : GlobalEndpointExponentialBound T) {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) : 0 ≤ localRepairInteger (globalRepairLowerSupport T.bit n) 1 n := by exact localRepairInteger_nonneg_of_exponential_endpoint_bound (hbound n hn) /-! ## Quantitative endpoint approximation

declarations.name: localFractionMass_nonneg
declarations.signature: theorem localFractionMass_nonneg {D : Finset ℕ} {M : ℕ} (hD : ∀ d ∈ D, 2 ≤ d) : 0 ≤ localFractionMass D M

declarations.name: localFractionMass_le_card
declarations.signature: theorem localFractionMass_le_card {D : Finset ℕ} {M : ℕ} (hD : ∀ d ∈ D, 2 ≤ d) : localFractionMass D M ≤ (D.card : ℚ)

declarations.name: abs_localMersennePrefixValue_sub_half_le
declarations.signature: theorem abs_localMersennePrefixValue_sub_half_le {D : Finset ℕ} {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) (hD : ∀ d ∈ D, 2 ≤ d ∧ d ≤ n) (hquot : localPrefixQuotient D n = 2 ^ (n - 1) - 1) : |((localMersennePrefixValue D : ℚ) : ℝ) - (1 : ℝ) / 2| ≤ ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / (2 : ℝ) ^ n
declarations.docstring: Exact quotient at row `n` gives an `O(n/2^n)` approximation to one half. The proof uses no monotonicity: a row may overshoot or undershoot.

declarations.name: globalRepairStageValue
declarations.signature: noncomputable def globalRepairStageValue (T : BooleanMobiusGlobalRepairTrajectory) (n : ℕ) : ℝ
declarations.docstring: Real value of one finite endpoint row.

declarations.name: abs_globalRepairStageValue_sub_half_le
declarations.signature: theorem abs_globalRepairStageValue_sub_half_le (T : BooleanMobiusGlobalRepairTrajectory) (hfeas : GlobalBooleanMobiusRepairFeasible T) {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) : |globalRepairStageValue T n - (1 : ℝ) / 2| ≤ ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / (2 : ℝ) ^ n

declarations.name: tendsto_nat_succ_div_two_pow_zero
declarations.signature: theorem tendsto_nat_succ_div_two_pow_zero : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ ↦ ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / (2 : ℝ) ^ n) atTop (nhds 0)

declarations.name: globalRepairStageValue_tendsto_half
declarations.signature: theorem globalRepairStageValue_tendsto_half (T : BooleanMobiusGlobalRepairTrajectory) (hfeas : GlobalBooleanMobiusRepairFeasible T) : Tendsto (globalRepairStageValue T) atTop (nhds ((1 : ℝ) / 2))

declarations.name: globalRepair_prefix_indicator_eq
declarations.signature: theorem globalRepair_prefix_indicator_eq (T : BooleanMobiusGlobalRepairTrajectory) {n R : ℕ} (hR : R ≤ n / 2) : (∑ k ∈ Finset.range R, Set.indicator (globalRepairLimitSupport T) mersenneWeight (k + 1)) = ∑ k ∈ Finset.range R, Set.indicator (↑(globalRepairStageSupport T.bit n) : Set ℕ) mersenneWeight (k + 1)

declarations.name: abs_globalRepairLimitValue_sub_stageValue_le_tail
declarations.signature: theorem abs_globalRepairLimitValue_sub_stageValue_le_tail (T : BooleanMobiusGlobalRepairTrajectory) {n R : ℕ} (hR : R ≤ n / 2) : |positiveMersenneSupportValue (globalRepairLimitSupport T) - globalRepairStageValue T n| ≤ 2 * mersenneTail R
declarations.docstring: Coordinate agreement through `R` bounds the discrepancy of the two support values by two complete Mersenne tails.

declarations.name: globalRepairEvenStageValue_tendsto_limit
declarations.signature: theorem globalRepairEvenStageValue_tendsto_limit (T : BooleanMobiusGlobalRepairTrajectory) : Tendsto (fun R : ℕ ↦ globalRepairStageValue T (2 * R)) atTop (nhds (positiveMersenneSupportValue (globalRepairLimitSupport T)))

declarations.name: infinite_support_half_of_globalBooleanMobiusRepair
declarations.signature: theorem infinite_support_half_of_globalBooleanMobiusRepair (T : BooleanMobiusGlobalRepairTrajectory) (hfeas : GlobalBooleanMobiusRepairFeasible T) : (globalRepairLimitSupport T).Infinite ∧ erdosSupportSeries 2 (globalRepairLimitSupport T) = (1 : ℝ) / 2
declarations.docstring: A globally feasible endpoint repair trajectory produces an infinite Mersenne support of exact value `1/2`. This is a conditional counterexample to the universal assertion in Erdős #257; the hypothesis remains open.

declarations.name: lowerBinaryWindow
declarations.docstring: Number of binary suffix values available after a truncation at depth `M`, when ranks through `R` have already been fixed.

declarations.name: lowerBinaryWindow_even
declarations.signature: theorem lowerBinaryWindow_even (R : ℕ) (hR : 1 ≤ R) : lowerBinaryWindow (2 * R - 1) R = 2 ^ (R - 1)

declarations.name: lowerBinaryWindow_odd
declarations.signature: theorem lowerBinaryWindow_odd (R : ℕ) : lowerBinaryWindow (2 * R) R = 2 ^ R

declarations.name: localMersenneTarget
declarations.docstring: The local Boolean target at binary depth `M`. In the half construction `k = 1`, so this is the integer immediately below `2^(M-1)`.

declarations.name: localMersenneWeightsFrom
declarations.signature: def localMersenneWeightsFrom (M R : ℕ) : ℕ → List ℕ | d => if h : d ≤ R then localMersenneQuotient M d :: localMersenneWeightsFrom M R (d + 1) else [] termination_by d => R + 1 - d decreasing_by omega /-- The complete lower quotient word on ranks `2,…,R`. -/ def localMersenneWeights (M R : ℕ) : List ℕ
declarations.docstring: Descending local quotient weights with ranks `d,d+1,…,R`.

declarations.name: localMersenneWeights
declarations.signature: def localMersenneWeights (M R : ℕ) : List ℕ
declarations.docstring: The complete lower quotient word on ranks `2,…,R`.

declarations.name: localMersenneWeightsFrom_eq_nil
declarations.signature: theorem localMersenneWeightsFrom_eq_nil {M R d : ℕ} (h : R < d) : localMersenneWeightsFrom M R d = []

declarations.name: localMersenneWeightsFrom_eq_cons
declarations.signature: theorem localMersenneWeightsFrom_eq_cons {M R d : ℕ} (h : d ≤ R) : localMersenneWeightsFrom M R d = localMersenneQuotient M d :: localMersenneWeightsFrom M R (d + 1)

declarations.name: localMersenneWeightsFrom_length
declarations.signature: theorem localMersenneWeightsFrom_length (M R d : ℕ) : (localMersenneWeightsFrom M R d).length = R + 1 - d

declarations.name: localMersenneWeights_length
declarations.signature: @[simp] theorem localMersenneWeights_length (M R : ℕ) : (localMersenneWeights M R).length = R - 1

declarations.name: localMersenneQuotient_cast_le_scaled
declarations.signature: theorem localMersenneQuotient_cast_le_scaled {M d : ℕ} (hd : 1 ≤ d) : ((localMersenneQuotient M d : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ M * mersenneWeight d
declarations.docstring: The quotient is at most its unfloored real Mersenne weight.

declarations.name: scaled_lt_localMersenneQuotient_cast_add_one
declarations.signature: theorem scaled_lt_localMersenneQuotient_cast_add_one {M d : ℕ} (hd : 1 ≤ d) : (2 : ℝ) ^ M * mersenneWeight d < (((localMersenneQuotient M d + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ) : ℝ)
declarations.docstring: The unfloored real Mersenne weight is strictly below the successor of its integral quotient.

declarations.name: localMersenneWeightsFrom_cast_sum_add_tail_le
declarations.signature: theorem localMersenneWeightsFrom_cast_sum_add_tail_le (M R d : ℕ) (hd : 1 ≤ d) (hdR : d ≤ R + 1) : (((localMersenneWeightsFrom M R d).sum : ℕ) : ℝ) + (2 : ℝ) ^ M * mersenneTail R ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ M * mersenneTail (d - 1)
declarations.docstring: The finite quotient tail, together with the omitted infinite Mersenne tail after rank `R`, is bounded by the corresponding full tail.

declarations.name: two_pow_mul_half_pow
declarations.signature: theorem two_pow_mul_half_pow {M R : ℕ} (hRM : R ≤ M) : (2 : ℝ) ^ M * ((1 : ℝ) / 2) ^ R = (2 : ℝ) ^ (M - R)
declarations.docstring: Cancelling `R` binary factors exposes the exact first omitted harmonic. This is the parity-uniform identity behind the gap `2^(M-R)`.

declarations.name: localMersenneQuotient_dominanceGap
declarations.signature: theorem localMersenneQuotient_dominanceGap {M R d : ℕ} (hRM : R ≤ M) (hd : 1 ≤ d) (hdR : d ≤ R) : lowerBinaryWindow M R + (localMersenneWeightsFrom M R (d + 1)).sum ≤ localMersenneQuotient M d
declarations.docstring: Concrete first-harmonic plus higher-tail bound. The omitted first binary harmonic after rank `R` is exactly `2^(M-R)`; the strictly positive Mersenne correction beyond it absorbs all quotient-floor losses.

declarations.name: localMersenneWeightsFrom_gapDominates
declarations.signature: theorem localMersenneWeightsFrom_gapDominates {M R d : ℕ} (hRM : R ≤ M) (hd : 1 ≤ d) : GapDominates (lowerBinaryWindow M R) (localMersenneWeightsFrom M R d)

declarations.name: localMersenneWeights_gapDominates
declarations.signature: theorem localMersenneWeights_gapDominates {M R : ℕ} (hRM : R ≤ M) : GapDominates (lowerBinaryWindow M R) (localMersenneWeights M R)

declarations.name: localMersenneWeights_gapDominates_even
declarations.signature: theorem localMersenneWeights_gapDominates_even (R : ℕ) (hR : 1 ≤ R) : GapDominates (2 ^ (R - 1)) (localMersenneWeights (2 * R - 1) R)
declarations.docstring: Even endpoints `M = 2R-1` have separation window `2^(R-1)`.

declarations.name: localMersenneWeights_gapDominates_odd
declarations.signature: theorem localMersenneWeights_gapDominates_odd (R : ℕ) : GapDominates (2 ^ R) (localMersenneWeights (2 * R) R)
declarations.docstring: Odd endpoints `M = 2R` have separation window `2^R`.

declarations.name: lowerBinaryWindow_endpoint
declarations.docstring: At endpoint `n`, the gap is exactly the capacity of the already-written strict upper suffix through `n-1`.

declarations.name: localMersenneEndpointWeights_gapDominates
declarations.signature: theorem localMersenneEndpointWeights_gapDominates {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) : GapDominates (2 ^ (upperHalfRepairLength n - 1)) (localMersenneWeights (n - 1) (n / 2))
declarations.docstring: Endpoint form consumed by the Boolean--Möbius repair process.

declarations.name: gap_le_remainder_of_ne_integerGreedyBits
declarations.signature: theorem gap_le_remainder_of_ne_integerGreedyBits {gap C : ℕ} {weights : List ℕ} {bits : List Bool} (hgap : 0 < gap) (hdom : GapDominates gap weights) (hlen : bits.length = weights.length) (hadm : weightedBoolSum weights bits ≤ C) (hne : bits ≠ integerGreedyBits weights C) : gap ≤ C - weightedBoolSum weights bits
declarations.docstring: Every admissible non-greedy word misses the capacity by at least the full separation gap. This is the precise form needed before specializing the gap to `lowerBinaryWindow M R`.

declarations.name: eq_integerGreedyBits_of_remainder_lt_gap
declarations.signature: theorem eq_integerGreedyBits_of_remainder_lt_gap {gap C : ℕ} {weights : List ℕ} {bits : List Bool} (hgap : 0 < gap) (hdom : GapDominates gap weights) (hlen : bits.length = weights.length) (hadm : weightedBoolSum weights bits ≤ C) (hwindow : C - weightedBoolSum weights bits < gap) : bits = integerGreedyBits weights C
declarations.docstring: A Boolean word whose defect is smaller than the separation gap is the descending integer-greedy word.

declarations.name: remainder_lt_gap_iff_eq_integerGreedyBits
declarations.signature: theorem remainder_lt_gap_iff_eq_integerGreedyBits {gap C : ℕ} {weights : List ℕ} {bits : List Bool} (hgap : 0 < gap) (hdom : GapDominates gap weights) (hlen : bits.length = weights.length) (hadm : weightedBoolSum weights bits ≤ C) : C - weightedBoolSum weights bits < gap ↔ bits = integerGreedyBits weights C ∧ integerGreedyRemainder weights C < gap
declarations.docstring: Exact unique-window hinge. Under gap dominance, a given admissible word has a defect inside the binary upper window iff it is the integer-greedy word and the deterministic greedy remainder lies in that window.

declarations.name: lower_word_eq_greedy_and_remainder_eq
declarations.signature: theorem lower_word_eq_greedy_and_remainder_eq {M R C A : ℕ} {weights : List ℕ} {bits : List Bool} (hwindowPos : 0 < lowerBinaryWindow M R) (hdom : GapDominates (lowerBinaryWindow M R) weights) (hlen : bits.length = weights.length) (hfill : weightedBoolSum weights bits + A = C) (hA : A < lowerBinaryWindow M R) : bits = integerGreedyBits weights C ∧ A = integerGreedyRemainder weights C
declarations.docstring: Consumer form for the Boolean Möbius repair. If the chosen lower word and its binary suffix `A` exactly fill `C`, and `A` lies in the parity-uniform upper window, then the lower word is forced to be integer greedy and `A` is literally the integer-greedy remainder.

declarations.name: localBinarySuffix_eq_localMersenneTarget_sub
declarations.signature: theorem localBinarySuffix_eq_localMersenneTarget_sub (D : Finset ℕ) (k M : ℕ) : localBinarySuffix D k M = localMersenneTarget M k - localPrefixQuotient D M
declarations.docstring: The locally defined suffix is the target defect of the selected quotient sum. This identity is valid with truncated natural subtraction as written.

declarations.name: localPrefixQuotient_add_localBinarySuffix
declarations.signature: theorem localPrefixQuotient_add_localBinarySuffix {D : Finset ℕ} {k M : ℕ} (hadm : localPrefixQuotient D M ≤ localMersenneTarget M k) : localPrefixQuotient D M + localBinarySuffix D k M = localMersenneTarget M k
declarations.docstring: If the frozen quotient sum is admissible, its suffix exactly fills the local target.

declarations.name: localMersenneTarget_lower_word_eq_greedy_and_remainder_eq
declarations.signature: theorem localMersenneTarget_lower_word_eq_greedy_and_remainder_eq {M R k A : ℕ} {bits : List Bool} (hRM : R ≤ M) (hlen : bits.length = (localMersenneWeights M R).length) (hfill : weightedBoolSum (localMersenneWeights M R) bits + A = localMersenneTarget M k) (hA : A < lowerBinaryWindow M R) : bits = integerGreedyBits (localMersenneWeights M R) (localMersenneTarget M k) ∧ A = integerGreedyRemainder (localMersenneWeights M R) (localMersenneTarget M k)
declarations.docstring: Concrete quotient-word reduction at the general local target `2^(M-k)-1`. No abstract dominance premise remains.

declarations.name: localMersenneHalfTarget_lower_word_eq_greedy_and_remainder_eq
declarations.signature: theorem localMersenneHalfTarget_lower_word_eq_greedy_and_remainder_eq {M R A : ℕ} {bits : List Bool} (hRM : R ≤ M) (hlen : bits.length = (localMersenneWeights M R).length) (hfill : weightedBoolSum (localMersenneWeights M R) bits + A = 2 ^ (M - 1) - 1) (hA : A < lowerBinaryWindow M R) : bits = integerGreedyBits (localMersenneWeights M R) (2 ^ (M - 1) - 1) ∧ A = integerGreedyRemainder (localMersenneWeights M R) (2 ^ (M - 1) - 1)
declarations.docstring: Exact `k=1` endpoint used by the half construction. A lower quotient word whose defect lies inside the strict upper-half binary window is forced to be the deterministic integer-greedy word.

declarations.name: localMersenneEndpoint_lower_word_eq_greedy_and_remainder_eq
declarations.signature: theorem localMersenneEndpoint_lower_word_eq_greedy_and_remainder_eq {n A : ℕ} {bits : List Bool} (hn : 2 ≤ n) (hlen : bits.length = (localMersenneWeights (n - 1) (n / 2)).length) (hfill : weightedBoolSum (localMersenneWeights (n - 1) (n / 2)) bits + A = 2 ^ (n - 2) - 1) (hA : A < 2 ^ (upperHalfRepairLength n - 1)) : bits = integerGreedyBits (localMersenneWeights (n - 1) (n / 2)) (2 ^ (n - 2) - 1) ∧ A = integerGreedyRemainder (localMersenneWeights (n - 1) (n / 2)) (2 ^ (n - 2) - 1)
declarations.docstring: Fully specialized endpoint form: `M=n-1`, `R=⌊n/2⌋`, `k=1`. The target is `2^(n-2)-1` and the separating window is the strict upper suffix capacity `2^(upperHalfRepairLength n-1)`.

declarations.name: localBinarySuffix_forces_greedy_lower_word
declarations.signature: theorem localBinarySuffix_forces_greedy_lower_word {D : Finset ℕ} {M R k : ℕ} {bits : List Bool} (hRM : R ≤ M) (hlen : bits.length = (localMersenneWeights M R).length) (hsum : weightedBoolSum (localMersenneWeights M R) bits = localPrefixQuotient D M) (hadm : localPrefixQuotient D M ≤ localMersenneTarget M k) (hwindow : localBinarySuffix D k M < lowerBinaryWindow M R) : bits = integerGreedyBits (localMersenneWeights M R) (localMersenneTarget M k) ∧ localBinarySuffix D k M = integerGreedyRemainder (localMersenneWeights M R) (localMersenneTarget M k)
declarations.docstring: Source-level suffix form. Once a Boolean list is identified with the frozen support's quotient sum, admissibility and the binary-window bound force both the greedy word and its exact remainder.

declarations.name: localBinarySuffix_one_forces_greedy_lower_word
declarations.signature: theorem localBinarySuffix_one_forces_greedy_lower_word {D : Finset ℕ} {M R : ℕ} {bits : List Bool} (hRM : R ≤ M) (hlen : bits.length = (localMersenneWeights M R).length) (hsum : weightedBoolSum (localMersenneWeights M R) bits = localPrefixQuotient D M) (hadm : localPrefixQuotient D M ≤ 2 ^ (M - 1) - 1) (hwindow : localBinarySuffix D 1 M < lowerBinaryWindow M R) : bits = integerGreedyBits (localMersenneWeights M R) (2 ^ (M - 1) - 1) ∧ localBinarySuffix D 1 M = integerGreedyRemainder (localMersenneWeights M R) (2 ^ (M - 1) - 1)
declarations.docstring: The preceding source-level theorem at the exact half target `k=1`.

declarations.name: lowerBinaryWindow_le_defect_of_ne_greedy
declarations.signature: theorem lowerBinaryWindow_le_defect_of_ne_greedy {M R C : ℕ} {weights : List ℕ} {bits : List Bool} (hwindowPos : 0 < lowerBinaryWindow M R) (hdom : GapDominates (lowerBinaryWindow M R) weights) (hlen : bits.length = weights.length) (hadm : weightedBoolSum weights bits ≤ C) (hne : bits ≠ integerGreedyBits weights C) : lowerBinaryWindow M R ≤ C - weightedBoolSum weights bits
declarations.docstring: Conversely, every non-greedy admissible lower word leaves at least one complete upper window. Thus it can never be the lower half of a filled Boolean predecessor whose suffix is a binary word of width `M - R`.

declarations.name: RepairLoadSafe
declarations.docstring: A load on the next Möbius endpoint is safe when its binary repair value `2*A+1-load` is nonnegative.

declarations.name: repairLoadSafe_of_greedy
declarations.signature: theorem repairLoadSafe_of_greedy {M R C A : ℕ} {weights : List ℕ} {bits : List Bool} (endpointLoad : List Bool → ℕ) (hwindowPos : 0 < lowerBinaryWindow M R) (hdom : GapDominates (lowerBinaryWindow M R) weights) (hlen : bits.length = weights.length) (hfill : weightedBoolSum weights bits + A = C) (hA : A < lowerBinaryWindow M R) (hgreedy : RepairLoadSafe (endpointLoad (integerGreedyBits weights C)) (integerGreedyRemainder weights C)) : RepairLoadSafe (endpointLoad bits) A
declarations.docstring: Once the lower-window uniqueness theorem is available, proving the load cap for the deterministic greedy word is enough for every filled predecessor in that window. This theorem intentionally retains that greedy cap as a hypothesis: it is the genuine arithmetic hinge.

declarations.name: all_filled_lower_words_repairLoadSafe_iff_greedy
declarations.signature: theorem all_filled_lower_words_repairLoadSafe_iff_greedy {M R C : ℕ} {weights : List ℕ} (endpointLoad : List Bool → ℕ) (hwindowPos : 0 < lowerBinaryWindow M R) (hdom : GapDominates (lowerBinaryWindow M R) weights) (hgreedyWindow : integerGreedyRemainder weights C < lowerBinaryWindow M R) : (∀ (bits : List Bool) (A : ℕ), bits.length = weights.length → weightedBoolSum weights bits + A = C → A < lowerBinaryWindow M R → RepairLoadSafe (endpointLoad bits) A) ↔ RepairLoadSafe (endpointLoad (integerGreedyBits weights C)) (integerGreedyRemainder weights C)
declarations.docstring: Exact iff form of the remaining hinge, assuming the greedy remainder is itself in the upper window.

declarations.name: localMersenneQuotient
declarations.docstring: The integral part of `2^M / (2^d - 1)`.

declarations.name: localMersenneFraction
declarations.docstring: The source-current fractional part of `2^M / (2^d - 1)` for `d ≥ 2`. The exponent is reduced modulo `d` before the division.

declarations.name: localPrefixQuotient
declarations.signature: def localPrefixQuotient (D : Finset ℕ) (M : ℕ) : ℕ
declarations.docstring: Sum of the integral quotient contributions of a finite Boolean support.

declarations.name: localFractionMass
declarations.signature: def localFractionMass (D : Finset ℕ) (M : ℕ) : ℚ
declarations.docstring: Sum of the corresponding fractional contributions.

declarations.name: localMersennePrefixValue
declarations.docstring: The exact finite Mersenne value of a Boolean lower support.

declarations.name: RationalHalfCutoffUndershoot
declarations.signature: def RationalHalfCutoffUndershoot (D : Finset ℕ) (k : ℕ) : Prop
declarations.docstring: An analytic sufficient handoff for the local repair argument: the Boolean support frozen through the half cutoff has not yet exceeded the target Mersenne value `2⁻ᵏ`. Upper-half word capacity is a separate combinatorial fact and is derived below from the already-Boolean suffix. The direct endpoint-exponential criterion below is an independent sufficient route to nonnegativity and does not assume this predicate.

declarations.name: localBinarySuffix
declarations.signature: def localBinarySuffix (D : Finset ℕ) (k M : ℕ) : ℕ
declarations.docstring: The carry left after reading the nonterminating binary expansion of `2⁻ᵏ` through place `M` and subtracting the quotient contributions of `D`. The theorem below proves that the truncating natural subtraction is honest in the endpoint situation where it is used.

declarations.name: endpointDivisorContribution
declarations.signature: def endpointDivisorContribution (D : Finset ℕ) (n : ℕ) : ℕ
declarations.docstring: Number of selected lower ranks which divide the next endpoint.

declarations.name: endpointDivisorContribution_eq_supportCoeff
declarations.signature: theorem endpointDivisorContribution_eq_supportCoeff {D : Finset ℕ} {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) : endpointDivisorContribution D n = supportCoeff (↑D : Set ℕ) n
declarations.docstring: The endpoint count is exactly the existing Boolean--Möbius support coefficient, specialized from a finite support.

declarations.name: localRepairInteger
declarations.signature: def localRepairInteger (D : Finset ℕ) (k n : ℕ) : ℤ
declarations.docstring: The next signed Boolean--Möbius coefficient supplied by the binary carry recurrence.

declarations.name: localMersennePrefixValue_eq_finiteErdosSum
declarations.signature: @[simp] theorem localMersennePrefixValue_eq_finiteErdosSum (D : Finset ℕ) : localMersennePrefixValue D = finiteErdosSum D 2

declarations.name: two_pow_mod_mersenne
declarations.signature: theorem two_pow_mod_mersenne {M d : ℕ} (hd : 2 ≤ d) : 2 ^ M % (2 ^ d - 1) = 2 ^ (M % d)
declarations.docstring: A power of two has the expected remainder modulo a Mersenne denominator. The rank-one exception is excluded because its denominator is one.

declarations.name: scaled_mersenneWeightRat_eq_quotient_add_fraction
declarations.signature: theorem scaled_mersenneWeightRat_eq_quotient_add_fraction {M d : ℕ} (hd : 2 ≤ d) : (2 : ℚ) ^ M * mersenneWeightRat d = (localMersenneQuotient M d : ℚ) + localMersenneFraction M d
declarations.docstring: Euclidean division splits one scaled Mersenne weight into its integral quotient and the explicit residue fraction.

declarations.name: localMersenneFraction_pos
declarations.signature: theorem localMersenneFraction_pos {M d : ℕ} (hd : 2 ≤ d) : 0 < localMersenneFraction M d

declarations.name: scaled_localMersennePrefixValue
declarations.signature: theorem scaled_localMersennePrefixValue {D : Finset ℕ} {M : ℕ} (hD : ∀ d ∈ D, 2 ≤ d) : (2 : ℚ) ^ M * localMersennePrefixValue D = (localPrefixQuotient D M : ℚ) + localFractionMass D M
declarations.docstring: Scaling a finite Boolean Mersenne prefix gives the total quotient plus the total residue mass.

declarations.name: pred_mod_eq_pred_of_dvd
declarations.signature: theorem pred_mod_eq_pred_of_dvd {n d : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (hd : 2 ≤ d) (hdn : d ∣ n) : (n - 1) % d = d - 1
declarations.docstring: If `d` divides `n`, the exponent immediately before `n` is congruent to `d - 1` modulo `d`.

declarations.name: half_lt_localMersenneFraction_pred_of_dvd
declarations.signature: theorem half_lt_localMersenneFraction_pred_of_dvd {n d : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (hd : 2 ≤ d) (hdn : d ∣ n) : (1 / 2 : ℚ) < localMersenneFraction (n - 1) d
declarations.docstring: Every selected endpoint divisor contributes strictly more than one half to the fractional mass at the preceding binary place.

declarations.name: endpointDivisorContribution_le_two_mul_localBinarySuffix_add_one
declarations.signature: theorem endpointDivisorContribution_le_two_mul_localBinarySuffix_add_one {D : Finset ℕ} {k n : ℕ} (hk : k < n) (hD : ∀ d ∈ D, 2 ≤ d ∧ d ≤ n / 2) (hprefix : RationalHalfCutoffUndershoot D k) : endpointDivisorContribution D n ≤ 2 * localBinarySuffix D k (n - 1) + 1
declarations.docstring: **Endpoint fractional-part inequality.** Let `D` be a finite Boolean support contained in ranks `2, ..., ⌊n/2⌋`, and suppose its Mersenne value does not exceed `2⁻ᵏ`. At binary place `n-1`, every member of `D` which divides `n` contributes more than one half to the fractional mass. Hence the endpoint divisor count is at most `2A+1`, where `A` is the binary suffix carry. No nonnegativity assumption on the next repair coefficient occurs here; it is the conclusion of the following corollary.

declarations.name: localRepairInteger_nonneg
declarations.signature: theorem localRepairInteger_nonneg {D : Finset ℕ} {k n : ℕ} (hk : k < n) (hD : ∀ d ∈ D, 2 ≤ d ∧ d ≤ n / 2) (hprefix : RationalHalfCutoffUndershoot D k) : 0 ≤ localRepairInteger D k n
declarations.docstring: The endpoint repair coefficient is nonnegative as a theorem, not as a feasibility hypothesis.

declarations.name: nat_le_two_pow_pred
declarations.docstring: Elementary growth bound used by the direct endpoint-feasibility route.

declarations.name: localRepairInteger_nonneg_of_exponential_endpoint_bound
declarations.signature: theorem localRepairInteger_nonneg_of_exponential_endpoint_bound {D : Finset ℕ} {k n : ℕ} (hbound : 2 ^ (endpointDivisorContribution D n - 1) - 1 ≤ localBinarySuffix D k (n - 1)) : 0 ≤ localRepairInteger D k n
declarations.docstring: A direct, purely integral sufficient condition for repair feasibility. Writing `S` for the endpoint divisor contribution and `A` for the preceding binary suffix, the hypothesis `2^(S-1)-1 ≤ A` implies `S ≤ 2A+1`, hence `H = 2A+1-S ≥ 0`. This theorem deliberately does not assert that the exponential hypothesis always holds.

declarations.name: mobiusCoefficient_eq_one_sub_endpointDivisorContribution
declarations.signature: theorem mobiusCoefficient_eq_one_sub_endpointDivisorContribution {D : Finset ℕ} {p a : ℕ → ℤ} {n : ℕ} (hp : p n = 1) (hconv : p n = a n + (endpointDivisorContribution D n : ℤ)) : a n = 1 - (endpointDivisorContribution D n : ℤ)
declarations.docstring: At a least defect whose current Lambert digit is one, Möbius inversion forces the new coefficient to be `1-S`, where `S` is the contribution of the already frozen proper divisors.

declarations.name: localRepairInteger_eq_two_mul_suffix_add_one_sub_endpoint
declarations.signature: theorem localRepairInteger_eq_two_mul_suffix_add_one_sub_endpoint (D : Finset ℕ) (k n : ℕ) : localRepairInteger D k n = 2 * (localBinarySuffix D k (n - 1) : ℤ) + (1 - (endpointDivisorContribution D n : ℤ))
declarations.docstring: Exact decomposition of the repair value into twice the preceding carry plus the least-defect Möbius coefficient `1-S`.

declarations.name: localRepairInteger_lt_two_mul_suffix_of_two_le_endpoint
declarations.signature: theorem localRepairInteger_lt_two_mul_suffix_of_two_le_endpoint {D : Finset ℕ} {k n : ℕ} (hendpoint : 2 ≤ endpointDivisorContribution D n) : localRepairInteger D k n < 2 * (localBinarySuffix D k (n - 1) : ℤ)
declarations.docstring: A genuine negative least defect (`S ≥ 2`) gives the strict estimate `H < 2A` used to localize the binary repair block.

declarations.name: repair_update_frozen_below_left
declarations.signature: theorem repair_update_frozen_below_left (a q : ℕ → ℤ) {r m : ℕ} (hq : ∀ j < r, q j = 0) (hm : m < r) : a m + q m = a m
declarations.docstring: A repair update supported from `r` onward leaves every coefficient below the left cutoff literally unchanged. Increasing left endpoints therefore freeze each fixed prefix after finitely many local repairs.

declarations.name: localRepairInteger_lt_fullWindowCapacity
declarations.signature: theorem localRepairInteger_lt_fullWindowCapacity {D : Finset ℕ} {k n : ℕ} (hk : k < n) : localRepairInteger D k n < (2 ^ (n - k) : ℕ)
declarations.docstring: The endpoint repair always fits in the full binary window `(k,n]`. Localizing the same word to the much shorter upper-half window is a separate capacity question, isolated below.

declarations.name: signedDyadicValue
declarations.signature: def signedDyadicValue : List ℤ → ℤ | [] => 0 | z :: zs => z + 2 * signedDyadicValue zs theorem signedDyadicValue_natCast (y : List ℕ) : signedDyadicValue (List.map (fun b : ℕ ↦ (b : ℤ)) y) = (Nat.ofDigits 2 y : ℤ)
declarations.docstring: Signed dyadic value of a least-significant-digit-first coefficient word.

declarations.name: signedDyadicValue_natCast
declarations.signature: theorem signedDyadicValue_natCast (y : List ℕ) : signedDyadicValue (List.map (fun b : ℕ ↦ (b : ℤ)) y) = (Nat.ofDigits 2 y : ℤ)

declarations.name: signedDyadicValue_boolean_lt_two_pow
declarations.signature: theorem signedDyadicValue_boolean_lt_two_pow {y : List ℕ} (hbool : ∀ b ∈ y, b = 0 ∨ b = 1) : signedDyadicValue (List.map (fun b : ℕ ↦ (b : ℤ)) y) < (2 ^ y.length : ℕ)
declarations.docstring: The dyadic value of a Boolean word of length `L` is strictly below `2^L`. This is the exact capacity bound used by both repair constructors.

declarations.name: exists_boolean_word_of_lt_two_pow
declarations.signature: theorem exists_boolean_word_of_lt_two_pow {V L : ℕ} (hV : V < 2 ^ L) : ∃ y : List ℕ, y.length = L ∧ (∀ b ∈ y, b = 0 ∨ b = 1) ∧ Nat.ofDigits 2 y = V
declarations.docstring: Every natural below `2^L` has a Boolean word of length exactly `L`.

declarations.name: exists_boolean_replacement_of_signedDyadicValue
declarations.signature: theorem exists_boolean_replacement_of_signedDyadicValue (a : List ℤ) {V : ℕ} (ha : signedDyadicValue a = (V : ℤ)) (hfit : V < 2 ^ a.length) : ∃ y : List ℕ, y.length = a.length ∧ (∀ b ∈ y, b = 0 ∨ b = 1) ∧ signedDyadicValue (List.map (fun b : ℕ ↦ (b : ℤ)) y) = signedDyadicValue a
declarations.docstring: A signed block whose nonnegative value fits in its width can be replaced by a Boolean block of the same width without changing its dyadic value.

declarations.name: exists_fullWindow_boolean_word_for_localRepairInteger
declarations.signature: theorem exists_fullWindow_boolean_word_for_localRepairInteger {D : Finset ℕ} {k n : ℕ} (hk : k < n) (hD : ∀ d ∈ D, 2 ≤ d ∧ d ≤ n / 2) (hprefix : RationalHalfCutoffUndershoot D k) : ∃ y : List ℕ, y.length = n - k ∧ (∀ b ∈ y, b = 0 ∨ b = 1) ∧ signedDyadicValue (List.map (fun b : ℕ ↦ (b : ℤ)) y) = localRepairInteger D k n
declarations.docstring: The nonnegative endpoint repair has an unconditional Boolean realization on the full window `(k,n]`. This is the finite unchanged-value repair before the locality requirement `r > n/2` is imposed.

declarations.name: upperHalfRepairLength
declarations.docstring: Number of binary coordinates in the strict upper half interval `(⌊n/2⌋, n]`. A word of this length is read from `n` down to `⌊n/2⌋+1`.

declarations.name: UpperHalfCarryCapacity
declarations.signature: def UpperHalfCarryCapacity (D : Finset ℕ) (k n : ℕ) : Prop
declarations.docstring: The carry left by the frozen prefix fits below half of the strict upper-half binary capacity. Unlike `RationalHalfCutoffUndershoot`, this is not a remaining analytic hypothesis: it follows from the already-Boolean upper suffix once the exact carry/suffix identity is supplied.

declarations.name: upperSuffixWord
declarations.signature: def upperSuffixWord (a : ℕ → ℕ) (R M : ℕ) : List ℕ
declarations.docstring: Least-significant-digit-first word cut from coefficients on `(R,M]`.

declarations.name: upperSuffixWord_length
declarations.signature: @[simp] theorem upperSuffixWord_length (a : ℕ → ℕ) (R M : ℕ) : (upperSuffixWord a R M).length = M - R

declarations.name: upperSuffixWord_boolean
