declarations.docstring: Exact even-seam inheritance when both the old height and the reduced offset are even.

declarations.name: diagonalHeightIncrement_two_mul_odd
declarations.signature: theorem diagonalHeightIncrement_two_mul_odd {H r : ℕ} (hH : Even H) (hr : Odd r) : diagonalHeightIncrement (2 * H) (2 * r) = diagonalHeightIncrement H r
declarations.docstring: Exact even-seam inheritance when the reduced offset is odd.

declarations.name: diagonalWindowIncrement_evenSeam_even
declarations.signature: theorem diagonalWindowIncrement_evenSeam_even {t u r : ℕ} (ht : 2 ≤ t) (hheight : periodLcm u = 2 * periodLcm t) (hr : Even r) : diagonalWindowIncrement u (2 * r) = 2 * diagonalWindowIncrement t r
declarations.docstring: The power-of-two seam at the indexed LCM level. Once the new LCM height is twice the old one, every even offset is inherited from the old height, with multiplier two exactly when the reduced offset is even.

declarations.name: diagonalWindowIncrement_evenSeam_odd
declarations.signature: theorem diagonalWindowIncrement_evenSeam_odd {t u r : ℕ} (ht : 2 ≤ t) (hheight : periodLcm u = 2 * periodLcm t) (hr : Odd r) : diagonalWindowIncrement u (2 * r) = diagonalWindowIncrement t r

declarations.name: diagonalSuffixResidue
declarations.signature: def diagonalSuffixResidue (t J m : ℕ) : ℤ
declarations.docstring: The depth-`m` binary residue of the diagonal window suffix that starts after the cut `J`: the last `m` bits of the depth-`(J + m)` diagonal window, computed from the translated windows alone.

declarations.name: diagonalSuffixResidue_eq_increment_sum
declarations.signature: theorem diagonalSuffixResidue_eq_increment_sum (t J m : ℕ) : diagonalSuffixResidue t J m = (∑ r ∈ Finset.range m, diagonalWindowIncrement t (J + 1 + r) * 2 ^ (m - 1 - r)) % 2 ^ m
declarations.docstring: The suffix residue is the dyadically weighted sum of the signed window increments strictly after the cut — the operational shape used by the sliding-suffix probe.

declarations.name: diagonalWindowResidue_mod_suffix
declarations.signature: theorem diagonalWindowResidue_mod_suffix (t J m : ℕ) : diagonalWindowResidue t (J + m) % 2 ^ m = diagonalSuffixResidue t J m
declarations.docstring: Low-bit projection: the depth-`(J + m)` diagonal residue reduces modulo `2^m` to the sliding-suffix residue at cut `J`. The `J`-bit prefix vanishes; no estimate of it is required.

declarations.name: diagonalFreshLossResidueCert_of_suffix_central
declarations.signature: theorem diagonalFreshLossResidueCert_of_suffix_central {t J m : ℕ} (hleft : (periodLcm t + (J + m) + 2 : ℤ) < diagonalSuffixResidue t J m) (hright : diagonalSuffixResidue t J m < 2 ^ m - (2 * periodLcm t + (J + m) + 2)) : diagonalFreshLossResidueCert t (J + m)
declarations.docstring: **Sliding-suffix transference.** A central residue in the last `m` bits of the depth-`(J + m)` diagonal window already implies the full asymmetric safe-interval certificate at depth `J + m`: both excluded edge bands of the full window reduce into the corresponding edge bands of the suffix modulus.

declarations.name: diagonalSymmetricResidueCert_of_suffix_central
declarations.signature: theorem diagonalSymmetricResidueCert_of_suffix_central {t J m : ℕ} (hleft : (2 * periodLcm t + (J + m) + 2 : ℤ) < diagonalSuffixResidue t J m) (hright : diagonalSuffixResidue t J m < 2 ^ m - (2 * periodLcm t + (J + m) + 2)) : diagonalSymmetricResidueCert t (J + m)
declarations.docstring: Sliding-suffix transference with the symmetric `2H` edge retained.

declarations.name: diagonalAdjacentSuffixResidue
declarations.signature: def diagonalAdjacentSuffixResidue (t J m : ℕ) : ℤ
declarations.docstring: The canonical modular displacement from the suffix at cut `J` to the suffix at cut `J + 1`.

declarations.name: diagonalSuffixResidue_succ_cut
declarations.signature: theorem diagonalSuffixResidue_succ_cut (t J m : ℕ) : diagonalSuffixResidue t (J + 1) m = (2 * diagonalSuffixResidue t J m + diagonalWindowIncrement t (J + m + 1)) % 2 ^ m
declarations.docstring: Sliding the cut once doubles the retained suffix and appends the next diagonal increment.

declarations.name: diagonalAdjacentSuffixResidue_eq_terminal_corrected
declarations.signature: theorem diagonalAdjacentSuffixResidue_eq_terminal_corrected (t J m : ℕ) : diagonalAdjacentSuffixResidue t J m = (diagonalSuffixResidue t J m + diagonalWindowIncrement t (J + m + 1)) % 2 ^ m
declarations.docstring: The adjacent displacement is the terminal-corrected suffix residue.

declarations.name: diagonalAdjacentSuffixRawBlock
declarations.signature: def diagonalAdjacentSuffixRawBlock (t J m : ℕ) : ℤ
declarations.docstring: Unreduced integer block underlying the adjacent suffix displacement. It is the exact target-specific scalar evaluated by the canonical jump probe.

declarations.name: oldMobiusIncrement
declarations.signature: noncomputable def oldMobiusIncrement (H s : ℕ) : ℤ
declarations.docstring: The literal contribution at offset `s` of all Möbius channels whose indices divide the LCM height `H`.

declarations.name: oldMobiusIncrement_eq_sum_forwardDifference_channel
declarations.signature: theorem oldMobiusIncrement_eq_sum_forwardDifference_channel (H s : ℕ) (hH : 0 < H) : oldMobiusIncrement H s = ∑ d ∈ H.divisors, forwardDifference H (mobiusTotientChannel d) (H + s)
declarations.docstring: The old-channel formula is exactly the sum of the landed totalized Möbius channels after one height-`H` forward difference at `H + s`.

declarations.name: squarefree_dvd_squarefreeKernel
declarations.signature: theorem squarefree_dvd_squarefreeKernel {d H : ℕ} (hH : 0 < H) (hdH : d ∣ H) (hd : Squarefree d) : d ∣ RadicalMobiusShadow.squarefreeKernel H
declarations.docstring: A squarefree divisor of `H` divides the canonical radical of `H`.

declarations.name: oldMobiusIncrement_eq_scale_gcdWordCoeff
declarations.signature: theorem oldMobiusIncrement_eq_scale_gcdWordCoeff (H s : ℕ) (hH : 0 < H) : oldMobiusIncrement H s = (((H / RadicalMobiusShadow.squarefreeKernel H : ℕ) : ℤ)) * (RepunitMobiusNumerator.gcdWordCoeff (RadicalMobiusShadow.squarefreeKernel H) s : ℤ)
declarations.docstring: Exact offsetwise old-channel identity: the literal divisor-channel sum is `H / rad(H)` times the positive gcd-word coefficient at the same offset.

declarations.name: boundedMobiusChannelSum
declarations.signature: noncomputable def boundedMobiusChannelSum (D n : ℕ) : ℤ
declarations.docstring: A common finite channel cutoff containing every divisor channel of `φ(n)` whenever `0 < n ≤ D`.

declarations.name: totient_eq_boundedMobiusChannelSum
declarations.signature: theorem totient_eq_boundedMobiusChannelSum {D n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (hnD : n ≤ D) : (Nat.totient n : ℤ) = boundedMobiusChannelSum D n
declarations.docstring: Extending the landed divisor-channel expansion to a common finite cutoff adds only totalized zero channels.

declarations.name: finiteForeignChannelIncrement
declarations.signature: noncomputable def finiteForeignChannelIncrement (H s : ℕ) : ℤ
declarations.docstring: The literal finite foreign complement at one offset: exactly the channel differences whose indices do not divide the LCM height.

declarations.name: diagonalHeightIncrement_eq_sum_channelDifferences
declarations.signature: theorem diagonalHeightIncrement_eq_sum_channelDifferences (H s : ℕ) (hH : 0 < H) : diagonalHeightIncrement H s = ∑ d ∈ Finset.range (2 * H + s + 1), forwardDifference H (mobiusTotientChannel d) (H + s)
declarations.docstring: The actual finite height increment is the sum of all totalized channel differences under one common cutoff.

declarations.name: boundedOldChannelSum_eq_oldMobiusIncrement
declarations.signature: theorem boundedOldChannelSum_eq_oldMobiusIncrement (H s : ℕ) (hH : 0 < H) : (∑ d ∈ Finset.range (2 * H + s + 1), if d ∣ H then forwardDifference H (mobiusTotientChannel d) (H + s) else 0) = oldMobiusIncrement H s
declarations.docstring: The old part of the common cutoff is exactly `oldMobiusIncrement`; this is a theorem, not a second old-channel definition.

declarations.name: diagonalHeightIncrement_eq_oldMobius_add_finiteForeign
declarations.signature: theorem diagonalHeightIncrement_eq_oldMobius_add_finiteForeign (H s : ℕ) (hH : 0 < H) : diagonalHeightIncrement H s = oldMobiusIncrement H s + finiteForeignChannelIncrement H s
declarations.docstring: Exact finite offset split into the scaled-gcd-word old channel and the literal `d ∤ H` foreign channel sum.

declarations.name: foreignChannelPhaseTerm
declarations.signature: noncomputable def foreignChannelPhaseTerm (d H s : ℕ) : ℤ
declarations.docstring: Explicit three-way phase form of one foreign channel.

declarations.name: foreign_endpoint_support_disjoint
declarations.signature: theorem foreign_endpoint_support_disjoint {d H s : ℕ} (hdH : ¬d ∣ H) : ¬(d ∣ 2 * H + s ∧ d ∣ H + s)
declarations.docstring: Outside the old divisor set, an index cannot divide both endpoints.

declarations.name: forwardDifference_mobiusTotientChannel_of_not_dvd
declarations.signature: theorem forwardDifference_mobiusTotientChannel_of_not_dvd {d H s : ℕ} (hdH : ¬d ∣ H) : forwardDifference H (mobiusTotientChannel d) (H + s) = foreignChannelPhaseTerm d H s
declarations.docstring: Exact pointwise phase normal form of a foreign channel difference.

declarations.name: finiteForeignChannelIncrement_eq_phaseSum
declarations.signature: theorem finiteForeignChannelIncrement_eq_phaseSum (H s : ℕ) : finiteForeignChannelIncrement H s = ∑ d ∈ Finset.range (2 * H + s + 1), if d ∣ H then 0 else foreignChannelPhaseTerm d H s
declarations.docstring: The whole finite foreign increment is the sum of the explicit disjoint endpoint phase terms.

declarations.name: foreignChannelPhaseTerm_ne_zero_support
declarations.signature: theorem foreignChannelPhaseTerm_ne_zero_support {d H s : ℕ} (hdH : ¬d ∣ H) (hne : foreignChannelPhaseTerm d H s ≠ 0) : (d ∣ 2 * H + s ∧ ¬d ∣ H + s) ∨ (¬d ∣ 2 * H + s ∧ d ∣ H + s)
declarations.docstring: A nonzero foreign phase term is supported at exactly one endpoint.

declarations.name: squarefree_of_foreignChannelPhaseTerm_ne_zero
declarations.signature: theorem squarefree_of_foreignChannelPhaseTerm_ne_zero {d H s : ℕ} (hne : foreignChannelPhaseTerm d H s ≠ 0) : Squarefree d
declarations.docstring: Every nonzero foreign phase term comes from a squarefree index.

declarations.name: foreignChannelPhaseTerm_eq_neg_of_low
declarations.signature: theorem foreignChannelPhaseTerm_eq_neg_of_low {d H s : ℕ} (hdH : ¬d ∣ H) (hLow : d ∣ H + s) : foreignChannelPhaseTerm d H s = -(ArithmeticFunction.moebius d * ((((H + s) / d : ℕ) : ℤ)))
declarations.docstring: A supported lower endpoint has the negative branch of the phase term.

declarations.name: foreignChannelPhaseTerm_eq_of_top
declarations.signature: theorem foreignChannelPhaseTerm_eq_of_top {d H s : ℕ} (hdH : ¬d ∣ H) (hTop : d ∣ 2 * H + s) : foreignChannelPhaseTerm d H s = ArithmeticFunction.moebius d * ((((2 * H + s) / d : ℕ) : ℤ))
declarations.docstring: A supported top endpoint has the positive branch of the phase term.

declarations.name: foreignChannelPhaseTerm_low_double_echo
declarations.signature: theorem foreignChannelPhaseTerm_low_double_echo {d H s : ℕ} (hdH : ¬d ∣ H) (hLow : d ∣ H + s) : foreignChannelPhaseTerm d H s = -(ArithmeticFunction.moebius d * ((((H + s) / d : ℕ) : ℤ))) ∧ foreignChannelPhaseTerm d H (2 * s) = 2 * (ArithmeticFunction.moebius d * ((((H + s) / d : ℕ) : ℤ)))
declarations.docstring: Every lower pulse at offset `s` has a top echo at offset `2s`; the top quotient, and hence the top phase value, is exactly twice the lower one.

declarations.name: foreignChannelPhaseTerm_weighted_low_double_echo
declarations.signature: theorem foreignChannelPhaseTerm_weighted_low_double_echo {d H s m : ℕ} (hdH : ¬d ∣ H) (hLow : d ∣ H + s) (_hsm : 2 * s ≤ m) : foreignChannelPhaseTerm d H s * 2 ^ (m - s) + foreignChannelPhaseTerm d H (2 * s) * 2 ^ (m - 2 * s) = (ArithmeticFunction.moebius d * ((((H + s) / d : ℕ) : ℤ))) * (2 * 2 ^ (m - 2 * s) - 2 ^ (m - s))
declarations.docstring: The exact two-position contribution of a lower pulse and its doubled top echo inside a binary-reversed block.

declarations.name: dvd_offset_sub_of_two_low_supports
declarations.signature: theorem dvd_offset_sub_of_two_low_supports {d H s r : ℕ} (hsr : s ≤ r) (hs : d ∣ H + s) (hr : d ∣ H + r) : d ∣ r - s
declarations.docstring: Two lower-endpoint hits of one channel are separated by a multiple of the channel index.

declarations.name: channel_le_offset_sub_of_two_low_supports
declarations.signature: theorem channel_le_offset_sub_of_two_low_supports {d H s r : ℕ} (_hd : 0 < d) (hsr : s < r) (hs : d ∣ H + s) (hr : d ∣ H + r) : d ≤ r - s
declarations.docstring: Distinct lower-endpoint hits are at least `d` offsets apart.

declarations.name: dvd_offset_sub_of_two_top_supports
declarations.signature: theorem dvd_offset_sub_of_two_top_supports {d H s r : ℕ} (hsr : s ≤ r) (hs : d ∣ 2 * H + s) (hr : d ∣ 2 * H + r) : d ∣ r - s
declarations.docstring: Two top-endpoint hits of one channel are separated by a multiple of the channel index.

declarations.name: channel_le_offset_sub_of_two_top_supports
declarations.signature: theorem channel_le_offset_sub_of_two_top_supports {d H s r : ℕ} (_hd : 0 < d) (hsr : s < r) (hs : d ∣ 2 * H + s) (hr : d ∣ 2 * H + r) : d ≤ r - s
declarations.docstring: Distinct top-endpoint hits are at least `d` offsets apart.

declarations.name: lt_of_not_dvd_periodLcm
declarations.signature: theorem lt_of_not_dvd_periodLcm {t d : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) (hnd : ¬d ∣ periodLcm t) : t < d
declarations.docstring: Every positive channel missing from `periodLcm t` lies strictly above the LCM scale `t`.

declarations.name: prime_of_squarefree_not_dvd_periodLcm_lt_two_mul
declarations.signature: theorem prime_of_squarefree_not_dvd_periodLcm_lt_two_mul {t d : ℕ} (hsq : Squarefree d) (hd : 0 < d) (hlt : d < 2 * t) (hnd : ¬d ∣ periodLcm t) : Nat.Prime d
declarations.docstring: A squarefree foreign channel below `2t` is a prime, not merely a prime power.

declarations.name: repeated_low_support_primePow_of_short_periodLcm_window
declarations.signature: theorem repeated_low_support_primePow_of_short_periodLcm_window {t d s r m : ℕ} (hsPos : 1 ≤ s) (hsr : s < r) (hrm : r ≤ m + 1) (hm : m < 2 * t) (hnd : ¬d ∣ periodLcm t) (hs : d ∣ periodLcm t + s) (hr : d ∣ periodLcm t + r) : ∃ p k : ℕ, Nat.Prime p ∧ d = p ^ k ∧ t < d
declarations.docstring: If one lower endpoint repeats inside offsets `1..m+1` and `m < 2t`, then its foreign channel is a prime power in `(t,2t)`.

declarations.name: prime_of_squarefree_repeated_low_support_in_short_periodLcm_window
declarations.signature: theorem prime_of_squarefree_repeated_low_support_in_short_periodLcm_window {t d s r m : ℕ} (hsq : Squarefree d) (hsPos : 1 ≤ s) (hsr : s < r) (hrm : r ≤ m + 1) (hm : m < 2 * t) (hnd : ¬d ∣ periodLcm t) (hs : d ∣ periodLcm t + s) (hr : d ∣ periodLcm t + r) : Nat.Prime d
declarations.docstring: The squarefree channels that can actually carry a nonzero Möbius phase therefore reduce to primes whenever a lower endpoint repeats in the short window.

declarations.name: repeated_top_support_primePow_of_short_periodLcm_window
declarations.signature: theorem repeated_top_support_primePow_of_short_periodLcm_window {t d s r m : ℕ} (hsPos : 1 ≤ s) (hsr : s < r) (hrm : r ≤ m + 1) (hm : m < 2 * t) (hnd : ¬d ∣ periodLcm t) (hs : d ∣ 2 * periodLcm t + s) (hr : d ∣ 2 * periodLcm t + r) : ∃ p k : ℕ, Nat.Prime p ∧ d = p ^ k ∧ t < d
declarations.docstring: The same prime-power confinement holds for repeated top-endpoint hits.

declarations.name: prime_of_squarefree_repeated_top_support_in_short_periodLcm_window
declarations.signature: theorem prime_of_squarefree_repeated_top_support_in_short_periodLcm_window {t d s r m : ℕ} (hsq : Squarefree d) (hsPos : 1 ≤ s) (hsr : s < r) (hrm : r ≤ m + 1) (hm : m < 2 * t) (hnd : ¬d ∣ periodLcm t) (hs : d ∣ 2 * periodLcm t + s) (hr : d ∣ 2 * periodLcm t + r) : Nat.Prime d
declarations.docstring: A repeated squarefree top channel in the short window is prime.

declarations.name: oldMobiusRawBlock
declarations.signature: noncomputable def oldMobiusRawBlock (H J m : ℕ) : ℤ
declarations.docstring: The exact binary-reversed block made only from old Möbius channels.

declarations.name: gcdWordRawBlock
declarations.signature: def gcdWordRawBlock (R J m : ℕ) : ℤ
declarations.docstring: The positive gcd-word block before multiplication by `H / rad(H)`.

declarations.name: oldMobiusRawBlock_eq_scale_gcdWordRawBlock
declarations.signature: theorem oldMobiusRawBlock_eq_scale_gcdWordRawBlock (H J m : ℕ) (hH : 0 < H) : oldMobiusRawBlock H J m = (((H / RadicalMobiusShadow.squarefreeKernel H : ℕ) : ℤ)) * gcdWordRawBlock (RadicalMobiusShadow.squarefreeKernel H) J m
declarations.docstring: The old reversed block is one fixed scale times the positive gcd-word block.

declarations.name: finiteForeignChannelRawBlock
declarations.signature: noncomputable def finiteForeignChannelRawBlock (H J m : ℕ) : ℤ
declarations.docstring: The exact binary-reversed block of literal `d ∤ H` channel increments.

declarations.name: diagonalAdjacentSuffixRawBlock_eq_oldMobius_add_finiteForeign
declarations.signature: theorem diagonalAdjacentSuffixRawBlock_eq_oldMobius_add_finiteForeign (t J m : ℕ) : diagonalAdjacentSuffixRawBlock t J m = oldMobiusRawBlock (periodLcm t) J m + finiteForeignChannelRawBlock (periodLcm t) J m
declarations.docstring: Exact finite-window identification of the actual reversed numerator.

declarations.name: diagonalAdjacentSuffixRawBlock_sub_oldMobius_eq_finiteForeign
declarations.signature: theorem diagonalAdjacentSuffixRawBlock_sub_oldMobius_eq_finiteForeign (t J m : ℕ) : diagonalAdjacentSuffixRawBlock t J m - oldMobiusRawBlock (periodLcm t) J m = finiteForeignChannelRawBlock (periodLcm t) J m
declarations.docstring: The actual-minus-old complement is definitionally the literal foreign channel raw block; no unidentified production complement remains.

declarations.name: finiteForeignChannelRawPulse
declarations.signature: noncomputable def finiteForeignChannelRawPulse (d H J m : ℕ) : ℤ
declarations.docstring: The contribution of a fixed foreign index to a binary-reversed window.

declarations.name: terminalBinaryWeight
declarations.docstring: Binary weight of offset `s` in the `J = 0`, depth-`m` raw block. Both offsets `m` and `m + 1` have weight one; the latter is the terminal term.

declarations.name: terminalWeightedCoeff
declarations.signature: def terminalWeightedCoeff (m s q : ℕ) : ℤ
declarations.docstring: A coefficient at one optional offset of the depth-`m` raw block.

declarations.name: foreignLowerOffset
declarations.docstring: Least positive lower-support offset for a channel not dividing `H`.

declarations.name: foreignLowerQuotient
declarations.docstring: Lower quotient at the least positive lower-support offset.

declarations.name: foreignDoubleWrap
declarations.docstring: Whether doubling the least lower offset wraps once modulo `d`.

declarations.name: foreignTopOffset
declarations.docstring: Least positive top-support offset in the odd-prime band.

declarations.name: primeBandFourPulseRaw
declarations.signature: def primeBandFourPulseRaw (H m p : ℕ) : ℤ
declarations.docstring: The sharp four-position value of a prime channel in a window shorter than `2d`. Every term is conditional because the least support itself can lie beyond the chosen depth.

declarations.name: not_three_low_supports_of_short_foreign_window
declarations.signature: theorem not_three_low_supports_of_short_foreign_window {t d H m s r u : ℕ} (htd : t < d) (hm : m < 2 * t) (hsPos : 1 ≤ s) (hsr : s < r) (hru : r < u) (hu : u ≤ m + 1) (hs : d ∣ H + s) (hr : d ∣ H + r) (huLow : d ∣ H + u) : False
declarations.docstring: Three lower hits cannot occur in offsets `1..m+1` once `d > t` and `m < 2t`.

declarations.name: not_three_top_supports_of_short_foreign_window
declarations.signature: theorem not_three_top_supports_of_short_foreign_window {t d H m s r u : ℕ} (htd : t < d) (hm : m < 2 * t) (hsPos : 1 ≤ s) (hsr : s < r) (hru : r < u) (hu : u ≤ m + 1) (hs : d ∣ 2 * H + s) (hr : d ∣ 2 * H + r) (huTop : d ∣ 2 * H + u) : False
declarations.docstring: Three top hits cannot occur in the same short window.

declarations.name: not_two_low_supports_of_squarefree_tail_window
declarations.signature: theorem not_two_low_supports_of_squarefree_tail_window {t d H m s r : ℕ} (hdt : 2 * t ≤ d) (hm : m < 2 * t) (hsPos : 1 ≤ s) (hsr : s < r) (hrm : r ≤ m + 1) (hs : d ∣ H + s) (hr : d ∣ H + r) : False
declarations.docstring: A tail channel `d ≥ 2t` has at most one lower hit in the short window.

declarations.name: not_two_top_supports_of_squarefree_tail_window
declarations.signature: theorem not_two_top_supports_of_squarefree_tail_window {t d H m s r : ℕ} (hdt : 2 * t ≤ d) (hm : m < 2 * t) (hsPos : 1 ≤ s) (hsr : s < r) (hrm : r ≤ m + 1) (hs : d ∣ 2 * H + s) (hr : d ∣ 2 * H + r) : False
declarations.docstring: A tail channel `d ≥ 2t` has at most one top hit in the short window.

declarations.name: eq_or_eq_add_of_modEq_of_pos_le_two_mul
declarations.signature: theorem eq_or_eq_add_of_modEq_of_pos_le_two_mul {p u s : ℕ} (hp : 0 < p) (huPos : 1 ≤ u) (huLt : u < p) (hsPos : 1 ≤ s) (hsLe : s ≤ 2 * p) (hmod : s ≡ u [MOD p]) : s = u ∨ s = u + p
declarations.docstring: A positive residue `u < p` has only the representatives `u,u+p` inside the positive interval through `2p`.

declarations.name: prime_lower_support_iff_eq_base_or_add
declarations.signature: theorem prime_lower_support_iff_eq_base_or_add {p H u q s : ℕ} (hp : Nat.Prime p) (huPos : 1 ≤ u) (huLt : u < p) (huEq : H + u = q * p) (hsPos : 1 ≤ s) (hsLe : s ≤ 2 * p) : p ∣ H + s ↔ s = u ∨ s = u + p
declarations.docstring: Exact two-representative description of lower support in a window of length at most `2p`.

declarations.name: prime_top_base_eq
declarations.signature: theorem prime_top_base_eq {p H u v q ε : ℕ} (huPos : 1 ≤ u) (huEq : H + u = q * p) (hε : ε ≤ 1) (hvEq : 2 * u = v + ε * p) : 2 * H + v = (2 * q - ε) * p
declarations.docstring: The top-support base and quotient forced by the lower witness and the single-wrap equation.

declarations.name: prime_top_support_iff_eq_base_or_add
declarations.signature: theorem prime_top_support_iff_eq_base_or_add {p H u v q ε s : ℕ} (hp : Nat.Prime p) (huPos : 1 ≤ u) (huEq : H + u = q * p) (hε : ε ≤ 1) (hvPos : 1 ≤ v) (hvLt : v < p) (hvEq : 2 * u = v + ε * p) (hsPos : 1 ≤ s) (hsLe : s ≤ 2 * p) : p ∣ 2 * H + s ↔ s = v ∨ s = v + p
declarations.docstring: Exact two-representative description of top support in the same short window.

declarations.name: prime_lower_support_quotient
declarations.signature: theorem prime_lower_support_quotient {p H u q s : ℕ} (hp : Nat.Prime p) (huEq : H + u = q * p) (hs : s = u ∨ s = u + p) : (H + s) / p = if s = u then q else q + 1
declarations.docstring: Quotient values at the two lower representatives.

declarations.name: prime_top_support_quotient
declarations.signature: theorem prime_top_support_quotient {p H u v q ε s : ℕ} (hp : Nat.Prime p) (huPos : 1 ≤ u) (huEq : H + u = q * p) (hε : ε ≤ 1) (hvEq : 2 * u = v + ε * p) (hs : s = v ∨ s = v + p) : (2 * H + s) / p = if s = v then 2 * q - ε else 2 * q - ε + 1
declarations.docstring: Quotient values at the two top representatives.

declarations.name: finiteForeignChannelRawPulse_eq_zero_of_dvd
declarations.signature: theorem finiteForeignChannelRawPulse_eq_zero_of_dvd {d H J m : ℕ} (hdH : d ∣ H) : finiteForeignChannelRawPulse d H J m = 0
declarations.docstring: Old divisor channels contribute no foreign raw pulse.

declarations.name: squarefree_of_finiteForeignChannelRawPulse_ne_zero

declarations.name: canonicalAdjacentSuffixDepth
declarations.docstring: The canonical adjacent-suffix depth: ten guard bits beyond the binary scale of the LCM height. At this depth the analytic width budget is automatic; the only remaining arithmetic input is centrality of the adjacent residue.

declarations.name: canonicalAdjacentSuffixDepth_width

declarations.name: canonicalAdjacentSuffixDepth_symmetric_width

declarations.name: diagonalTargetDepthCorrectionEnvelope_lt_canonical_edge

declarations.name: baseTwoTargetResidue_central_iff_unwrapped
declarations.signature: theorem baseTwoTargetResidue_central_iff_unwrapped {m : ℕ} {d C : ℤ} (hm : 5 ≤ m) (hd0 : 0 ≤ d) (hdhi : d < (2 : ℤ) ^ (m - 1)) (hC : |C| < (2 : ℤ) ^ (m - 5)) : ((2 : ℤ) ^ (m - 5) ≤ (2 * d + C) % 2 ^ m ∧ (2 * d + C) % 2 ^ m ≤ 2 ^ m - 2 ^ (m - 5)) ↔ ((2 : ℤ) ^ (m - 5) ≤ 2 * d + C ∧ 2 * d + C ≤ 2 ^ m - 2 ^ (m - 5))

Thus modular centrality is equivalent to the two literal integer inequalities on `2*d + C`.

declarations.name: canonicalAdjacentSuffixResidue_central_iff_penultimate_exact
declarations.signature: theorem canonicalAdjacentSuffixResidue_central_iff_penultimate_exact {t : ℕ} (ht : 3 ≤ t) : ((2 : ℤ) ^ (canonicalAdjacentSuffixDepth t - 5) ≤ diagonalAdjacentSuffixResidue t 0 (canonicalAdjacentSuffixDepth t) ∧ diagonalAdjacentSuffixResidue t 0 (canonicalAdjacentSuffixDepth t) ≤ 2 ^ canonicalAdjacentSuffixDepth t - 2 ^ (canonicalAdjacentSuffixDepth t - 5)) ↔ ((2 : ℤ) ^ (canonicalAdjacentSuffixDepth t - 5) ≤ 2 * diagonalAdjacentSuffixResidue t 0 (canonicalAdjacentSuffixDepth t - 1) + diagonalTargetDepthCorrection t (canonicalAdjacentSuffixDepth t) ∧ 2 * diagonalAdjacentSuffixResidue t 0 (canonicalAdjacentSuffixDepth t - 1) + diagonalTargetDepthCorrection t (canonicalAdjacentSuffixDepth t) ≤

declarations.name: baseTwoTargetResidue_central_of_strongBand

declarations.docstring: A target-depth base-two step turns an old `1/16` band into the desired new `1/32` band whenever the appended correction fits inside the new edge.

declarations.name: baseTwoTargetResidue_central_of_envelope
declarations.signature: theorem baseTwoTargetResidue_central_of_envelope {m : ℕ} {d C B : ℤ} (hm : 5 ≤ m) (hC : |C| ≤ B) (hlo : 2 ^ (m - 5) + B ≤ 2 * d) (hhi : 2 * d + B ≤ 2 ^ m - 2 ^ (m - 5)) : (2 : ℤ) ^ (m - 5) ≤ (2 * d + C) % 2 ^ m ∧ (2 * d + C) % 2 ^ m ≤ 2 ^ m - 2 ^ (m - 5)

declarations.name: DiagonalAdjacentSuffixGapSupply

declarations.name: CanonicalAdjacentSuffixCentralSupply

declarations.name: CanonicalAdjacentSuffixPenultimateExactSupply

declarations.name: CanonicalAdjacentSuffixPenultimateMarginSupply

declarations.name: CanonicalAdjacentSuffixPenultimateStrongBandSupply
declarations.docstring: Parity-complete producer left after the one-depth correction estimate. Only the penultimate residue must occupy the stronger `1/16` band; all transport to the canonical `1/32` consumer is automatic.

declarations.name: CanonicalAdjacentSuffixJumpCentralSupply
declarations.docstring: The prime-power-jump-aligned producer throat. Repeated LCM heights carry no new arithmetic state, so it is enough to establish canonical centrality at arbitrarily large strict jumps.

declarations.name: periodLcm_strict_jump_iff_succ_not_dvd

declarations.name: periodLcm_succ_eq_prime_mul_of_strict_jump

declarations.name: powerTwoOddDepthCorrection

declarations.name: diagonalAdjacentSuffixResidue_powerTwo_oddDepth_step

declarations.name: baseFourResidue_central_of_correction_bounds

declarations.name: exists_periodLcm_strict_jump_ge
declarations.signature: theorem exists_periodLcm_strict_jump_ge (t₀ : ℕ) : ∃ t, t₀ ≤ t ∧ periodLcm t < periodLcm (t + 1)

declarations.name: canonicalAdjacentSuffixCentralSlack
declarations.docstring: Signed distance of the canonical adjacent residue from the nearer edge of the fixed central band. Nonnegative slack is exactly the two-sided centrality condition; this scalar is the proof-oriented cocycle to study at strict LCM jumps.

declarations.name: canonicalAdjacentSuffixCentralSlack_eq_of_periodLcm_eq
declarations.signature: theorem canonicalAdjacentSuffixCentralSlack_eq_of_periodLcm_eq {t u : ℕ} (hH : periodLcm t = periodLcm u) : canonicalAdjacentSuffixCentralSlack t = canonicalAdjacentSuffixCentralSlack u
declarations.docstring: The canonical scalar depends only on the LCM height. In particular it is constant across every plateau between consecutive strict jumps.

declarations.name: canonicalAdjacentSuffixCentral_iff_slack_nonneg
declarations.signature: theorem canonicalAdjacentSuffixCentral_iff_slack_nonneg (t : ℕ) : (2 ^ (canonicalAdjacentSuffixDepth t - 5) ≤ diagonalAdjacentSuffixResidue t 0 (canonicalAdjacentSuffixDepth t) ∧ diagonalAdjacentSuffixResidue t 0 (canonicalAdjacentSuffixDepth t) ≤ 2 ^ canonicalAdjacentSuffixDepth t - 2 ^ (canonicalAdjacentSuffixDepth t - 5)) ↔ 0 ≤ canonicalAdjacentSuffixCentralSlack t

declarations.name: CanonicalAdjacentSuffixJumpSlackSupply
declarations.docstring: Scalar strict-jump producer. This is equivalent to the original two-sided producer but exposes a single integer observable for recurrence, congruence, and exact-computation arguments.

declarations.name: CanonicalAdjacentSuffixPostJumpSlackSupply
declarations.docstring: Fresh-factor-aligned producer: the successful scalar is evaluated after the displayed strict jump, at the new LCM height.

declarations.name: CanonicalAdjacentSuffixPowerTwoPostJumpSlackSupply
declarations.docstring: Cofinal power-of-two specialisation of the post-jump producer. The argument is the new endpoint `2^a`, not the pre-jump index `2^a - 1`.

declarations.name: canonicalAdjacentSuffixPostJumpSlackSupply_of_powerTwo
declarations.docstring: Power-of-two post-jump centrality is already cofinal among strict LCM jumps, so it supplies the general post-jump producer.

declarations.name: canonicalAdjacentSuffixJumpSlackSupply_of_postJump
declarations.docstring: Post-jump centrality transports across the following LCM plateau to its next strict-jump index. This is the unconditional reindexing bridge that lets arithmetic arguments use the newly inserted factor while preserving the existing pre-jump producer and consumer.

declarations.name: canonicalAdjacentSuffixCentralSupply_iff_penultimateExact
declarations.docstring: The canonical central producer and its signed penultimate-coordinate form are logically equivalent. This pins the remaining cofinal arithmetic obligation exactly, without the loss introduced by an absolute correction envelope.

declarations.name: canonicalAdjacentSuffixCentralSupply_of_penultimateMargin
declarations.docstring: The sharp penultimate margin producer feeds the canonical centrality interface directly.

declarations.name: canonicalAdjacentSuffixPenultimateMarginSupply_of_strongBand
declarations.docstring: The cleaner penultimate `1/16` band is a sufficient corollary of the sharper doubled-margin producer because the canonical correction envelope is strictly smaller than one edge.

declarations.name: canonicalAdjacentSuffixCentralSupply_of_penultimateStrongBand
declarations.docstring: The penultimate strong-band producer feeds canonical centrality without a parity restriction or any power-of-two LCM-jump hypothesis.

declarations.name: canonicalAdjacentSuffixCentralSupply_of_jump
declarations.docstring: Restricting the producer to strict LCM jumps still supplies the canonical centrality interface.

declarations.name: diagonalAdjacentSuffixGapSupply_of_canonical
declarations.docstring: Canonical centrality supplies the existing adjacent-gap interface; the guard-bit and width obligations are discharged uniformly.

declarations.name: irrational_totientSeries_of_diagonalAdjacentSuffixGapSupply
declarations.signature: theorem irrational_totientSeries_of_diagonalAdjacentSuffixGapSupply (hsupply : DiagonalAdjacentSuffixGapSupply) : Irrational (∑' n : ℕ, (Nat.totient n : ℝ) / 2 ^ n)

declarations.signature: theorem irrational_totientSeries_of_canonicalAdjacentSuffixCentralSupply (hsupply : CanonicalAdjacentSuffixCentralSupply) : Irrational (∑' n : ℕ, (Nat.totient n : ℝ) / 2 ^ n)
declarations.docstring: Canonical adjacent-suffix centrality is sufficient for Erdős #249's irrationality target through the already-landed adjacent-gap consumer.

declarations.name: irrational_totientSeries_of_canonicalAdjacentSuffixPenultimateExactSupply
declarations.signature: theorem irrational_totientSeries_of_canonicalAdjacentSuffixPenultimateExactSupply (hsupply : CanonicalAdjacentSuffixPenultimateExactSupply) : Irrational (∑' n : ℕ, (Nat.totient n : ℝ) / 2 ^ n)

declarations.name: irrational_totientSeries_of_canonicalAdjacentSuffixPenultimateMarginSupply
declarations.signature: theorem irrational_totientSeries_of_canonicalAdjacentSuffixPenultimateMarginSupply (hsupply : CanonicalAdjacentSuffixPenultimateMarginSupply) : Irrational (∑' n : ℕ, (Nat.totient n : ℝ) / 2 ^ n)
declarations.docstring: The sharp penultimate-margin producer closes Erdős #249 through the canonical adjacent-suffix consumer.

declarations.name: irrational_totientSeries_of_canonicalAdjacentSuffixPenultimateStrongBandSupply
declarations.signature: theorem irrational_totientSeries_of_canonicalAdjacentSuffixPenultimateStrongBandSupply (hsupply : CanonicalAdjacentSuffixPenultimateStrongBandSupply) : Irrational (∑' n : ℕ, (Nat.totient n : ℝ) / 2 ^ n)

declarations.signature: theorem irrational_totientSeries_of_canonicalAdjacentSuffixJumpCentralSupply (hsupply : CanonicalAdjacentSuffixJumpCentralSupply) : Irrational (∑' n : ℕ, (Nat.totient n : ℝ) / 2 ^ n)

declarations.signature: theorem irrational_totientSeries_of_canonicalAdjacentSuffixPostJumpSlackSupply (hsupply : CanonicalAdjacentSuffixPostJumpSlackSupply) : Irrational (∑' n : ℕ, (Nat.totient n : ℝ) / 2 ^ n)

declarations.signature: theorem irrational_totientSeries_of_canonicalAdjacentSuffixPowerTwoPostJumpSlackSupply (hsupply : CanonicalAdjacentSuffixPowerTwoPostJumpSlackSupply) : Irrational (∑' n : ℕ, (Nat.totient n : ℝ) / 2 ^ n)
declarations.docstring: The cofinal power-of-two producer is sufficient for Erdős #249.

declarations.name: diagonalFreshLossProjectionCell_seven
declarations.docstring: At `t = 7`, depth `13` gives the exact diagonal projection and its floor. This is a bridge fixture, not evidence for an unbounded supply.

declarations.name: foreignDiagonalDefect_misses_fullTarget_seven_via_projection
declarations.docstring: The existing `t = 7` full-target miss can be recovered through the new operational composition seam.

declarations.name: diagonalSuffixCell_seven
declarations.signature: theorem diagonalSuffixCell_seven : (periodLcm 7 + (1 + 12) + 2 : ℤ) < diagonalSuffixResidue 7 1 12 ∧ diagonalSuffixResidue 7 1 12 < 2 ^ 12 - (2 * periodLcm 7 + (1 + 12) + 2)
declarations.docstring: At `t = 7`, the cut `J = 1` with suffix length `m = 12` is centrally placed: the last twelve bits alone recover the landed `(7, 13)` projection. A bridge fixture, not evidence for an unbounded supply.

declarations.name: foreignDiagonalDefect_misses_fullTarget_seven_via_suffix
declarations.docstring: The `t = 7` full-target miss re-derived from suffix bits only, through the sliding-suffix transference theorem.

declarations.name: baseTwoTargetResidue_central_iff_topBit
declarations.docstring: Under the canonical small-correction hypothesis, target centrality has only one nonautomatic inequality: the side selected by the top bit of the penultimate residue.

declarations.name: baseTwoTargetResidue_noncentral_iff_carryEdgeAlignment
declarations.signature: theorem baseTwoTargetResidue_noncentral_iff_carryEdgeAlignment {m : ℕ} {d C : ℤ} (hm : 5 ≤ m) (hd0 : 0 ≤ d) (hdhi : d < (2 : ℤ) ^ (m - 1)) (hC : |C| < (2 : ℤ) ^ (m - 5)) : (¬ ((2 : ℤ) ^ (m - 5) ≤ (2 * d + C) % 2 ^ m ∧ (2 * d + C) % 2 ^ m ≤ 2 ^ m - 2 ^ (m - 5))) ↔ ((d < (2 : ℤ) ^ (m - 2) ∧ 2 * d + C < 2 ^ (m - 5)) ∨ ((2 : ℤ) ^ (m - 2) ≤ d ∧ 2 ^ m - 2 ^ (m - 5) < 2 * d + C))
declarations.docstring: Exact failure form: noncentrality is precisely alignment of the penultimate top bit with the corresponding signed edge excursion.

declarations.name: canonicalAdjacentSuffixDepth_powerTwo_jump
declarations.signature: theorem canonicalAdjacentSuffixDepth_powerTwo_jump {a : ℕ} (ha : 2 ≤ a) : canonicalAdjacentSuffixDepth (2 ^ a) = canonicalAdjacentSuffixDepth (2 ^ a - 1) + 1
declarations.docstring: A power-of-two LCM jump adds exactly one canonical bit.

declarations.name: diagonalTargetDepthCorrection_powerTwo_of_even_predepth
declarations.signature: theorem diagonalTargetDepthCorrection_powerTwo_of_even_predepth {a q : ℕ} (ha : 2 ≤ a) (hdepth : canonicalAdjacentSuffixDepth (2 ^ a - 1) = 2 * q) : diagonalTargetDepthCorrection (2 ^ a) (canonicalAdjacentSuffixDepth (2 ^ a)) = powerTwoInheritedIncrement a (q + 1) - powerTwoFreshOddIncrement a q
declarations.docstring: If the pre-jump canonical depth is even, the target correction is the next inherited even increment minus the current fresh odd increment.

declarations.name: diagonalTargetDepthCorrection_powerTwo_of_odd_predepth
declarations.signature: theorem diagonalTargetDepthCorrection_powerTwo_of_odd_predepth {a q : ℕ} (ha : 2 ≤ a) (hdepth : canonicalAdjacentSuffixDepth (2 ^ a - 1) = 2 * q + 1) : diagonalTargetDepthCorrection (2 ^ a) (canonicalAdjacentSuffixDepth (2 ^ a)) = powerTwoFreshOddIncrement a (q + 1) - powerTwoInheritedIncrement a (q + 1)
declarations.docstring: If the pre-jump canonical depth is odd, the target correction is the next fresh odd increment minus the matching inherited even increment.

declarations.name: powerTwoOddCorrectionWord
declarations.docstring: The base-four word of all odd-depth corrections through step `q`.

declarations.name: powerTwoOddCorrectionWord_succ
declarations.signature: theorem powerTwoOddCorrectionWord_succ (a q : ℕ) : powerTwoOddCorrectionWord a (q + 1) = 4 * powerTwoOddCorrectionWord a q + powerTwoOddDepthCorrection a q
declarations.docstring: Appending one correction is the affine base-four recurrence.

declarations.name: diagonalAdjacentSuffixRawBlock_powerTwo_oddDepth_closed
declarations.signature: theorem diagonalAdjacentSuffixRawBlock_powerTwo_oddDepth_closed {a q : ℕ} (ha : 2 ≤ a) : diagonalAdjacentSuffixRawBlock (2 ^ a) 0 (2 * q + 1) = (4 : ℤ) ^ q * diagonalAdjacentSuffixRawBlock (2 ^ a) 0 1 + powerTwoOddCorrectionWord a q
declarations.docstring: Closed raw odd-depth orbit at a power-of-two endpoint.

declarations.name: diagonalAdjacentSuffixResidue_powerTwo_oddDepth_closed
declarations.signature: theorem diagonalAdjacentSuffixResidue_powerTwo_oddDepth_closed {a q : ℕ} (ha : 2 ≤ a) : diagonalAdjacentSuffixResidue (2 ^ a) 0 (2 * q + 1) = ((4 : ℤ) ^ q * diagonalAdjacentSuffixRawBlock (2 ^ a) 0 1 + powerTwoOddCorrectionWord a q) % 2 ^ (2 * q + 1)
declarations.docstring: Closed residue form of the odd-depth orbit.

declarations.name: diagonalAdjacentSuffixResidue_powerTwo_oddDepth_lowBits
declarations.signature: theorem diagonalAdjacentSuffixResidue_powerTwo_oddDepth_lowBits {a q : ℕ} (ha : 2 ≤ a) : diagonalAdjacentSuffixResidue (2 ^ a) 0 (2 * q + 1) % (4 : ℤ) ^ q = powerTwoOddCorrectionWord a q % (4 : ℤ) ^ q
declarations.docstring: The seed contributes only the top bit at odd depth: all lower `2q` bits are exactly the correction word modulo `4^q`.

declarations.name: diagonalWindowIncrement_even_of_two_le_periodLcm
declarations.signature: theorem diagonalWindowIncrement_even_of_two_le_periodLcm {t s : ℕ} (hH : 2 ≤ periodLcm t) (hs : 1 ≤ s) : Even (diagonalWindowIncrement t s)
declarations.docstring: Once the LCM height is at least two, every positive-offset diagonal increment is even: both totients are even before taking their difference.

declarations.name: diagonalWindowIncrement_even_of_two_le_offset
declarations.signature: theorem diagonalWindowIncrement_even_of_two_le_offset {t s : ℕ} (hs : 2 ≤ s) : Even (diagonalWindowIncrement t s)
declarations.docstring: Once the offset is at least two, both totient arguments exceed two, so the diagonal increment is even without any hypothesis on the LCM height.

declarations.name: powerTwoOddDepthCorrection_even
declarations.signature: theorem powerTwoOddDepthCorrection_even (a n : ℕ) : Even (powerTwoOddDepthCorrection a n)
declarations.docstring: Every odd-depth power-of-two correction is even. The fresh term is at offset at least three, the last inherited term is at reduced offset at least two, and the middle inherited term already carries a factor two.

declarations.name: diagonalAdjacentSuffixRawBlock_powerTwo_zero_one_even
declarations.docstring: The seed of the odd-depth power-of-two orbit is even.

declarations.name: diagonalAdjacentSuffixResidue_powerTwo_oddDepth_eq_correctionWord
declarations.signature: theorem diagonalAdjacentSuffixResidue_powerTwo_oddDepth_eq_correctionWord {a q : ℕ} (ha : 2 ≤ a) : diagonalAdjacentSuffixResidue (2 ^ a) 0 (2 * q + 1) = powerTwoOddCorrectionWord a q % 2 ^ (2 * q + 1)
declarations.docstring: The even seed vanishes modulo the full odd-depth modulus, so the correction word determines every bit of the residue, including its top bit.

declarations.name: powerTwoOddHalfCorrectionWord
declarations.signature: def powerTwoOddHalfCorrectionWord (a : ℕ) : ℕ → ℤ | 0 => 0 | q + 1 => 4 * powerTwoOddHalfCorrectionWord a q + powerTwoOddDepthCorrection a q / 2 /-- Appending one half-correction is the integral base-four recurrence. -/ theorem powerTwoOddHalfCorrectionWord_succ (a q : ℕ) : powerTwoOddHalfCorrectionWord a (q + 1) = 4 * powerTwoOddHalfCorrectionWord a q + powerTwoOddDepthCorrection a q / 2
declarations.docstring: The integral half-correction cocycle.

declarations.name: powerTwoOddHalfCorrectionWord_succ
declarations.signature: theorem powerTwoOddHalfCorrectionWord_succ (a q : ℕ) : powerTwoOddHalfCorrectionWord a (q + 1) = 4 * powerTwoOddHalfCorrectionWord a q + powerTwoOddDepthCorrection a q / 2
declarations.docstring: Appending one half-correction is the integral base-four recurrence.

declarations.name: powerTwoOddCorrectionWord_eq_two_mul_halfWord
declarations.signature: theorem powerTwoOddCorrectionWord_eq_two_mul_halfWord (a q : ℕ) : powerTwoOddCorrectionWord a q = 2 * powerTwoOddHalfCorrectionWord a q
declarations.docstring: The old correction word is exactly twice the integral half-word.

declarations.name: diagonalAdjacentSuffixResidue_powerTwo_oddDepth_eq_two_mul_halfWord
declarations.signature: theorem diagonalAdjacentSuffixResidue_powerTwo_oddDepth_eq_two_mul_halfWord {a q : ℕ} (ha : 2 ≤ a) : diagonalAdjacentSuffixResidue (2 ^ a) 0 (2 * q + 1) = 2 * (powerTwoOddHalfCorrectionWord a q % (4 : ℤ) ^ q)
declarations.docstring: At every odd depth, the residue is twice one residue modulo `4^q`. This removes the separate quotient-parity state from the correction-word description.

declarations.name: SignedSplitSafe
declarations.signature: def SignedSplitSafe (x y M e : ℤ) : Prop
declarations.docstring: Sufficient signed-coordinate conditions for a central sum modulo `M`. The same-direction branch prevents a wrap into the opposite edge; the opposite-direction branch prevents cancellation into the edge about zero.

declarations.name: emod_central_of_abs_between
declarations.signature: theorem emod_central_of_abs_between {z M e : ℤ} (_hM : 0 < M) (he : 0 < e) (hlo : e ≤ |z|) (hhi : |z| ≤ M - e) : e ≤ z % M ∧ z % M ≤ M - e
declarations.docstring: A short signed representative whose magnitude lies between the edge and its complementary radius has a central Euclidean residue.

declarations.name: abs_add_between_of_signedSplitSafe
declarations.signature: theorem abs_add_between_of_signedSplitSafe {x y M e : ℤ} (h : SignedSplitSafe x y M e) : e ≤ |x + y| ∧ |x + y| ≤ M - e
declarations.docstring: The expanded phase condition puts the unwrapped sum between the two signed edge radii.

declarations.name: signedSplitSafe_emod_central
declarations.signature: theorem signedSplitSafe_emod_central {x y M e : ℤ} (h : SignedSplitSafe x y M e) : e ≤ (x + y) % M ∧ (x + y) % M ≤ M - e
declarations.docstring: The signed old/foreign phase conditions exclude both width-`e` edge cylinders after recombination modulo `M`.

declarations.name: add_ediv_two_of_even
declarations.signature: theorem add_ediv_two_of_even {A B : ℤ} (hA : Even A) (hB : Even B) : (A + B) / 2 = A / 2 + B / 2
declarations.docstring: Integer halving is additive when both summands are even.

declarations.name: diagonalAdjacentSuffixRawBlock_half_central_of_signedSplit
declarations.signature: theorem diagonalAdjacentSuffixRawBlock_half_central_of_signedSplit {t J m : ℕ} {x y M e : ℤ} (hOldEven : Even (oldMobiusRawBlock (periodLcm t) J m)) (hForeignEven : Even (finiteForeignChannelRawBlock (periodLcm t) J m)) (hx : Int.ModEq M (oldMobiusRawBlock (periodLcm t) J m / 2) x) (hy : Int.ModEq M (finiteForeignChannelRawBlock (periodLcm t) J m / 2) y) (hSafe : SignedSplitSafe x y M e) : e ≤ (diagonalAdjacentSuffixRawBlock t J m / 2) % M ∧ (diagonalAdjacentSuffixRawBlock t J m / 2) % M ≤ M - e
declarations.docstring: Signed representatives of the exact old and literal foreign half-blocks put the actual reversed dyadic numerator in the central band.

declarations.name: diagonalAdjacentSuffixRawBlock_powerTwo_oddDepth_half_emod
declarations.signature: theorem diagonalAdjacentSuffixRawBlock_powerTwo_oddDepth_half_emod {a q : ℕ} (ha : 2 ≤ a) : (diagonalAdjacentSuffixRawBlock (2 ^ a) 0 (2 * q + 1) / 2) % (4 : ℤ) ^ q = powerTwoOddHalfCorrectionWord a q % (4 : ℤ) ^ q
declarations.docstring: At a power-of-two endpoint and odd depth, the actual raw half-numerator and the integral half-correction word agree modulo `4^q`.

declarations.name: diagonalAdjacentSuffixRawBlock_powerTwo_oddDepth_even
declarations.signature: theorem diagonalAdjacentSuffixRawBlock_powerTwo_oddDepth_even {a q : ℕ} (ha : 2 ≤ a) : Even (diagonalAdjacentSuffixRawBlock (2 ^ a) 0 (2 * q + 1))
declarations.docstring: The actual raw numerator is even at every power-two odd depth.

declarations.name: finiteForeignChannelRawBlock_powerTwo_oddDepth_even_of_old
declarations.signature: theorem finiteForeignChannelRawBlock_powerTwo_oddDepth_even_of_old {a q : ℕ} (ha : 2 ≤ a) (hOldEven : Even (oldMobiusRawBlock (periodLcm (2 ^ a)) 0 (2 * q + 1))) : Even (finiteForeignChannelRawBlock (periodLcm (2 ^ a)) 0 (2 * q + 1))
declarations.docstring: Evenness of the old block forces evenness of the exact literal foreign block at a power-two odd depth.

declarations.name: powerTwoOddHalfWordBand_of_signedSplit
declarations.signature: theorem powerTwoOddHalfWordBand_of_signedSplit {a q : ℕ} {x y : ℤ} (ha : 2 ≤ a) (hOldEven : Even (oldMobiusRawBlock (periodLcm (2 ^ a)) 0 (2 * q + 1))) (hx : Int.ModEq ((4 : ℤ) ^ q) (oldMobiusRawBlock (periodLcm (2 ^ a)) 0 (2 * q + 1) / 2) x) (hy : Int.ModEq ((4 : ℤ) ^ q) (finiteForeignChannelRawBlock (periodLcm (2 ^ a)) 0 (2 * q + 1) / 2) y) (hSafe : SignedSplitSafe x y ((4 : ℤ) ^ q) ((4 : ℤ) ^ q / 32)) : (4 : ℤ) ^ q ≤ 32 * (powerTwoOddHalfCorrectionWord a q % (4 : ℤ) ^ q) ∧ 32 * (powerTwoOddHalfCorrectionWord a q % (4 : ℤ) ^ q) ≤ 31 * (4 : ℤ) ^ q
declarations.docstring: Power-two specialization whose conclusion is exactly the half-word band consumed by the landed odd-depth centrality bridge.

declarations.name: diagonalAdjacentSuffixResidue_powerTwo_oddDepth_central_of_signedSplit
declarations.signature: theorem diagonalAdjacentSuffixResidue_powerTwo_oddDepth_central_of_signedSplit {a q : ℕ} {x y : ℤ} (ha : 2 ≤ a) (hq : 3 ≤ q) (hOldEven : Even (oldMobiusRawBlock (periodLcm (2 ^ a)) 0 (2 * q + 1))) (hx : Int.ModEq ((4 : ℤ) ^ q) (oldMobiusRawBlock (periodLcm (2 ^ a)) 0 (2 * q + 1) / 2) x) (hy : Int.ModEq ((4 : ℤ) ^ q) (finiteForeignChannelRawBlock (periodLcm (2 ^ a)) 0 (2 * q + 1) / 2) y) (hSafe : SignedSplitSafe x y ((4 : ℤ) ^ q) ((4 : ℤ) ^ q / 32)) : (2 : ℤ) ^ (2 * q + 1 - 5) ≤ diagonalAdjacentSuffixResidue (2 ^ a) 0 (2 * q + 1) ∧ diagonalAdjacentSuffixResidue (2 ^ a) 0 (2 * q + 1) ≤ 2 ^ (2 * q + 1) - 2 ^ (2 * q + 1 - 5)
declarations.docstring: Direct composition into the actual odd-depth adjacent suffix residue.

declarations.name: canonical_a2_to_a7_signedSplitSafe_fixture
declarations.docstring: Exact canonical divisor/foreign signed-lift fixtures from the committed `a = 2,...,7` receipts.

declarations.name: NearMultiple
declarations.signature: def NearMultiple (A M e : ℤ) : Prop
declarations.docstring: `A` lies in the open radius-`e` cylinder about a multiple of `M`.

declarations.name: nearMultiple_iff_emod_edge
declarations.signature: theorem nearMultiple_iff_emod_edge {A M e : ℤ} (hM : 0 < M) (he : 0 < e) (hwidth : 2 * e < M) : NearMultiple A M e ↔ A % M < e ∨ M - e < A % M
declarations.docstring: Exact conversion between an edge-cylinder representative and the two edge intervals of its Euclidean residue.

declarations.name: nearMultiple_correction_of_twoRank
declarations.signature: theorem nearMultiple_correction_of_twoRank {A B C M e : ℤ} (hA : NearMultiple A M e) (hB : NearMultiple B (4 * M) (4 * e)) (hstep : B = 4 * A + C) : NearMultiple C (4 * M) (8 * e)
declarations.docstring: Two consecutive edge-cylinder hits force the intervening base-four correction into a cylinder four times wider around a multiple of the new modulus. At dyadic width `M = 32e`, this says that the correction is within `M/4` of a multiple of `4M`.

declarations.name: powerTwoOddDepthCorrection_nearMultiple_of_twoRank
declarations.signature: theorem powerTwoOddDepthCorrection_nearMultiple_of_twoRank {a q : ℕ} (ha : 2 ≤ a) (hOld : NearMultiple (diagonalAdjacentSuffixRawBlock (2 ^ a) 0 (2 * q + 1)) ((2 : ℤ) ^ (2 * q + 1)) ((2 : ℤ) ^ (2 * q + 1 - 5))) (hNew : NearMultiple (diagonalAdjacentSuffixRawBlock (2 ^ a) 0 (2 * (q + 1) + 1)) (4 * (2 : ℤ) ^ (2 * q + 1)) (4 * (2 : ℤ) ^ (2 * q + 1 - 5))) : NearMultiple (powerTwoOddDepthCorrection a q) (4 * (2 : ℤ) ^ (2 * q + 1)) (8 * (2 : ℤ) ^ (2 * q + 1 - 5))
declarations.docstring: Direct specialization to the power-of-two odd-depth raw cocycle. Its hypotheses are exactly two consecutive edge-cylinder occupations.

declarations.name: abs_powerTwoOddDepthCorrection_le
declarations.signature: theorem abs_powerTwoOddDepthCorrection_le {a n : ℕ} (ha : 2 ≤ a) : |powerTwoOddDepthCorrection a n| ≤ (8 * periodLcm (2 ^ a) + 8 * n + 11 : ℤ)
declarations.docstring: A direct three-letter envelope for the base-four correction.

declarations.name: oddGuardedCanonicalAdjacentSuffixDepth
declarations.docstring: Make the canonical adjacent-suffix depth odd by spending at most one additional guard bit.

declarations.name: oddGuardedCanonicalAdjacentSuffixDepth_of_even
declarations.signature: theorem oddGuardedCanonicalAdjacentSuffixDepth_of_even {t : ℕ} (h : Even (canonicalAdjacentSuffixDepth t)) : oddGuardedCanonicalAdjacentSuffixDepth t = canonicalAdjacentSuffixDepth t + 1

declarations.name: oddGuardedCanonicalAdjacentSuffixDepth_of_odd
declarations.signature: theorem oddGuardedCanonicalAdjacentSuffixDepth_of_odd {t : ℕ} (h : Odd (canonicalAdjacentSuffixDepth t)) : oddGuardedCanonicalAdjacentSuffixDepth t = canonicalAdjacentSuffixDepth t

declarations.name: oddGuardedCanonicalAdjacentSuffixDepth_cases
declarations.signature: theorem oddGuardedCanonicalAdjacentSuffixDepth_cases (t : ℕ) : oddGuardedCanonicalAdjacentSuffixDepth t = canonicalAdjacentSuffixDepth t ∨ oddGuardedCanonicalAdjacentSuffixDepth t = canonicalAdjacentSuffixDepth t + 1

declarations.name: canonicalAdjacentSuffixDepth_le_oddGuarded
declarations.signature: theorem canonicalAdjacentSuffixDepth_le_oddGuarded (t : ℕ) : canonicalAdjacentSuffixDepth t ≤ oddGuardedCanonicalAdjacentSuffixDepth t

declarations.name: oddGuardedCanonicalAdjacentSuffixDepth_le_succ
declarations.signature: theorem oddGuardedCanonicalAdjacentSuffixDepth_le_succ (t : ℕ) : oddGuardedCanonicalAdjacentSuffixDepth t ≤ canonicalAdjacentSuffixDepth t + 1

declarations.name: periodLcm_dvd_of_forall_pos_le
declarations.signature: theorem periodLcm_dvd_of_forall_pos_le {t M : ℕ} (h : ∀ k : ℕ, 1 ≤ k → k ≤ t → k ∣ M) : periodLcm t ∣ M
declarations.docstring: If every positive integer at most `t` divides `M`, then the recursive universal period `periodLcm t` divides `M`.

declarations.name: one_le_factorization_centralBinom_of_prime_pow_window
declarations.signature: theorem one_le_factorization_centralBinom_of_prime_pow_window {n p e : ℕ} (hp : Nat.Prime p) (he : 0 < e) (hnp : n < p ^ e) (hp2n : p ^ e ≤ 2 * n) : 1 ≤ (Nat.centralBinom n).factorization p
declarations.docstring: If a positive prime power lies in `(n, 2n]`, then adding `n+n` carries across that prime-power digit. Kummer's factorization formula therefore puts at least one copy of the prime into the central binomial coefficient.

declarations.name: prime_dvd_centralBinom_of_prime_pow_window
declarations.signature: theorem prime_dvd_centralBinom_of_prime_pow_window {n p e : ℕ} (hp : Nat.Prime p) (he : 0 < e) (hnp : n < p ^ e) (hp2n : p ^ e ≤ 2 * n) : p ∣ Nat.centralBinom n
declarations.docstring: Divisibility form of the single-carry lemma.

declarations.name: periodLcm_two_mul_dvd_periodLcm_mul_centralBinom
declarations.signature: theorem periodLcm_two_mul_dvd_periodLcm_mul_centralBinom (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) : periodLcm (2 * n) ∣ periodLcm n * Nat.centralBinom n
declarations.docstring: Every positive index through `2n` divides the old LCM times the central binomial coefficient. Old divisors are immediate; a new index below `2n` is a prime power, whose predecessor power lies below `n` while its last prime is supplied by the Kummer carry. The endpoint `2n` is supplied by `n ∣ periodLcm n` and the evenness of the positive central binomial.

declarations.name: periodLcm_two_mul_le_periodLcm_mul_centralBinom
declarations.signature: theorem periodLcm_two_mul_le_periodLcm_mul_centralBinom (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) : periodLcm (2 * n) ≤ periodLcm n * Nat.centralBinom n

declarations.name: periodLcm_two_mul_le_periodLcm_mul_four_pow

declarations.name: periodLcm_sixteen_lt_two_pow_twenty

declarations.name: periodLcm_pow_two_lt_two_pow_guardTwelve

declarations.name: canonicalAdjacentSuffixDepth_powerTwo_succ_lt_two_mul

declarations.docstring: The twelve-bit LCM saving leaves one full bit beyond the optional parity guard: `canonicalDepth + 1` is still strictly shorter than `2t`.

declarations.name: canonicalAdjacentSuffixDepth_powerTwo_lt_two_mul
declarations.signature: theorem canonicalAdjacentSuffixDepth_powerTwo_lt_two_mul {a : ℕ} (ha : 4 ≤ a) : canonicalAdjacentSuffixDepth (2 ^ a) < 2 * 2 ^ a

declarations.name: oddGuardedCanonicalAdjacentSuffixDepth_powerTwo_lt_two_mul
declarations.signature: theorem oddGuardedCanonicalAdjacentSuffixDepth_powerTwo_lt_two_mul {a : ℕ} (ha : 4 ≤ a) : oddGuardedCanonicalAdjacentSuffixDepth (2 ^ a) < 2 * 2 ^ a
declarations.docstring: Strong consumer form for the previous sparse-pulse lane: the actual odd-guarded canonical depth also lies below `2t`, so repeated same-endpoint foreign support is confined to the prime exceptional set.

declarations.name: prime_of_squarefree_repeated_low_support_powerTwo_oddGuarded
declarations.signature: theorem prime_of_squarefree_repeated_low_support_powerTwo_oddGuarded {a d s r : ℕ} (ha : 4 ≤ a) (hsq : Squarefree d) (hsPos : 1 ≤ s) (hsr : s < r) (hr : r ≤ oddGuardedCanonicalAdjacentSuffixDepth (2 ^ a) + 1) (hnd : ¬d ∣ periodLcm (2 ^ a)) (hsLow : d ∣ periodLcm (2 ^ a) + s) (hrLow : d ∣ periodLcm (2 ^ a) + r) : Nat.Prime d

declarations.name: prime_of_squarefree_repeated_top_support_powerTwo_oddGuarded
declarations.signature: theorem prime_of_squarefree_repeated_top_support_powerTwo_oddGuarded {a d s r : ℕ} (ha : 4 ≤ a) (hsq : Squarefree d) (hsPos : 1 ≤ s) (hsr : s < r) (hr : r ≤ oddGuardedCanonicalAdjacentSuffixDepth (2 ^ a) + 1) (hnd : ¬d ∣ periodLcm (2 ^ a)) (hsTop : d ∣ 2 * periodLcm (2 ^ a) + s) (hrTop : d ∣ 2 * periodLcm (2 ^ a) + r) : Nat.Prime d

declarations.name: exists_oddGuardedCanonicalAdjacentSuffixDepth_index

declarations.name: canonicalAdjacentSuffixDepth_succ_width
declarations.signature: theorem canonicalAdjacentSuffixDepth_succ_width {t : ℕ} (ht : 3 ≤ t) : 5 ≤ canonicalAdjacentSuffixDepth t + 1 ∧ 32 * (3 * periodLcm t + 2 * ((canonicalAdjacentSuffixDepth t + 1) + 3) : ℤ) < 2 ^ (canonicalAdjacentSuffixDepth t + 1)

declarations.name: canonicalAdjacentSuffixDepth_succ_symmetric_width
declarations.signature: theorem canonicalAdjacentSuffixDepth_succ_symmetric_width {t : ℕ} (ht : 3 ≤ t) : 5 ≤ canonicalAdjacentSuffixDepth t + 1 ∧ 32 * (4 * periodLcm t + 2 * (canonicalAdjacentSuffixDepth t + 1) + 5 : ℤ) < 2 ^ (canonicalAdjacentSuffixDepth t + 1)
declarations.docstring: The symmetric width receipt likewise survives the optional parity guard bit.

declarations.name: oddGuardedCanonicalAdjacentSuffixDepth_width
declarations.signature: theorem oddGuardedCanonicalAdjacentSuffixDepth_width {t : ℕ} (ht : 3 ≤ t) : 5 ≤ oddGuardedCanonicalAdjacentSuffixDepth t ∧ 32 * (3 * periodLcm t + 2 * (oddGuardedCanonicalAdjacentSuffixDepth t + 3) : ℤ) < 2 ^ oddGuardedCanonicalAdjacentSuffixDepth t

declarations.name: oddGuardedCanonicalAdjacentSuffixDepth_symmetric_width
declarations.signature: theorem oddGuardedCanonicalAdjacentSuffixDepth_symmetric_width {t : ℕ} (ht : 3 ≤ t) : 5 ≤ oddGuardedCanonicalAdjacentSuffixDepth t ∧ 32 * (4 * periodLcm t + 2 * oddGuardedCanonicalAdjacentSuffixDepth t + 5 : ℤ) < 2 ^ oddGuardedCanonicalAdjacentSuffixDepth t

declarations.name: diagonalFreshLossResidueCert_or_of_powerTwo_oddGuard_halfWordBand
declarations.signature: theorem diagonalFreshLossResidueCert_or_of_powerTwo_oddGuard_halfWordBand {a q : ℕ} (ha : 2 ≤ a) (hdepth : oddGuardedCanonicalAdjacentSuffixDepth (2 ^ a) = 2 * q + 1) (hlo : (4 : ℤ) ^ q ≤ 32 * (powerTwoOddHalfCorrectionWord a q % (4 : ℤ) ^ q)) (hhi : 32 * (powerTwoOddHalfCorrectionWord a q % (4 : ℤ) ^ q) ≤ 31 * (4 : ℤ) ^ q) : diagonalFreshLossResidueCert (2 ^ a) (2 * q + 1) ∨ diagonalFreshLossResidueCert (2 ^ a) (1 + (2 * q + 1))

declarations.signature: theorem diagonalSymmetricResidueCert_or_of_powerTwo_oddGuard_halfWordBand {a q : ℕ} (ha : 2 ≤ a) (hdepth : oddGuardedCanonicalAdjacentSuffixDepth (2 ^ a) = 2 * q + 1) (hlo : (4 : ℤ) ^ q ≤ 32 * (powerTwoOddHalfCorrectionWord a q % (4 : ℤ) ^ q)) (hhi : 32 * (powerTwoOddHalfCorrectionWord a q % (4 : ℤ) ^ q) ≤ 31 * (4 : ℤ) ^ q) : diagonalSymmetricResidueCert (2 ^ a) (2 * q + 1) ∨ diagonalSymmetricResidueCert (2 ^ a) (1 + (2 * q + 1))

declarations.name: PowerTwoOddGuardHalfWordBandSupply

declarations.name: diagonalAdjacentSuffixGapSupply_of_powerTwoOddGuardHalfWordBand

declarations.name: irrational_totientSeries_of_powerTwoOddGuardHalfWordBandSupply
declarations.signature: theorem irrational_totientSeries_of_powerTwoOddGuardHalfWordBandSupply (hsupply : PowerTwoOddGuardHalfWordBandSupply) : Irrational (∑' n : ℕ, (Nat.totient n : ℝ) / 2 ^ n)

declarations.name: int_emod_two_mul_ge_iff_odd_ediv
declarations.signature: theorem int_emod_two_mul_ge_iff_odd_ediv {W Q : ℤ} (hQ : 0 < Q) : Q ≤ W % (2 * Q) ↔ Odd (W / Q)
declarations.docstring: For a positive base `Q`, the upper/lower half of `W mod 2Q` is exactly the parity of the Euclidean quotient `W / Q`.

declarations.name: diagonalAdjacentSuffixResidue_powerTwo_oddDepth_topBit_iff
declarations.signature: theorem diagonalAdjacentSuffixResidue_powerTwo_oddDepth_topBit_iff {a q : ℕ} (ha : 2 ≤ a) : (4 : ℤ) ^ q ≤ diagonalAdjacentSuffixResidue (2 ^ a) 0 (2 * q + 1) ↔ Odd (powerTwoOddCorrectionWord a q / (4 : ℤ) ^ q)
declarations.docstring: The exact top bit of the odd-depth power-of-two residue is the quotient parity of its correction word.

declarations.name: powerTwoOddHalfCorrectionWord_normalized_step
declarations.signature: theorem powerTwoOddHalfCorrectionWord_normalized_step (a q : ℕ) : ((powerTwoOddHalfCorrectionWord a (q + 1) : ℤ) : ℚ) / (4 : ℚ) ^ (q + 1) - ((powerTwoOddHalfCorrectionWord a q : ℤ) : ℚ) / (4 : ℚ) ^ q = ((powerTwoOddDepthCorrection a q / 2 : ℤ) : ℚ) / (4 : ℚ) ^ (q + 1)
declarations.docstring: After normalization by the growing base-four modulus, one odd-depth correction step is literal addition of the next base-four digit.

declarations.name: powerTwoOddHalfCorrectionWord_normalized_eq_sum
declarations.signature: theorem powerTwoOddHalfCorrectionWord_normalized_eq_sum (a q : ℕ) : ((powerTwoOddHalfCorrectionWord a q : ℤ) : ℚ) / (4 : ℚ) ^ q = ∑ n ∈ Finset.range q, ((powerTwoOddDepthCorrection a n / 2 : ℤ) : ℚ) / (4 : ℚ) ^ (n + 1)
declarations.docstring: Finite telescoping form of the normalized integral half-word.

declarations.name: powerTwoOddHalfCorrectionWord_eq_raw_sub_seed
declarations.signature: theorem powerTwoOddHalfCorrectionWord_eq_raw_sub_seed {a q : ℕ} (ha : 2 ≤ a) : 2 * powerTwoOddHalfCorrectionWord a q = diagonalAdjacentSuffixRawBlock (2 ^ a) 0 (2 * q + 1) - (4 : ℤ) ^ q * diagonalAdjacentSuffixRawBlock (2 ^ a) 0 1
declarations.docstring: The half-word is exactly the non-seed part of the normalized raw odd window. Its circle-valued orbit is therefore a sequence of finite diagonal tail approximants, up to one fixed integral seed.

declarations.name: baseFour_positiveWrap_ediv_succ
declarations.signature: theorem baseFour_positiveWrap_ediv_succ {Z M c : ℤ} (hM : 0 < M) (hlo : 4 * M ≤ 4 * (Z % M) + c) (hhi : 4 * (Z % M) + c < 8 * M) : (4 * Z + c) / (4 * M) = Z / M + 1

declarations.name: baseFour_edge_iff_centered_tube
declarations.signature: theorem baseFour_edge_iff_centered_tube {M e u c : ℤ} (hM : 0 < M) (he : 0 < e) (hwidth : 4 * e < M) (hu : |u| < e) (hc : |c| < 8 * e) : let r

declarations.name: baseFour_zeroCorrection_centered_tube_forever

declarations.name: threeFutureEdgeRanks_iff_oldStateCrossing
declarations.signature: theorem threeFutureEdgeRanks_iff_oldStateCrossing {A B D E C F G M e : ℤ} (he : 0 < e) (hscale : M = 32 * e) (hBstep : B = 4 * A + C) (hDstep : D = 4 * B + F) (hEstep : E = 4 * D + G) (hF : |F| < 15 * M) (hG : |G| < 60 * M) : (NearMultiple B (4 * M) (4 * e) ∧ NearMultiple D (16 * M) (16 * e) ∧ NearMultiple E (64 * M) (64 * e)) ↔ ∃ k : ℤ, |4 * (A - M * k) + C| < 4 * e ∧ |16 * (A - M * k) + 4 * C + F| < 16 * e ∧
declarations.docstring: Three future edge ranks are the same old-state lift with one more exact literal inequality.

declarations.name: powerTwo_a7_q91_q93_oldCell_integer_fixture

declarations.name: actualCenteredLift

declarations.name: actualOddHalfCenteredLift

declarations.name: actualOddHalfCorrection

declarations.name: two_mul_actualOddHalfCorrection_eq_three_diagonalWindowIncrements
declarations.signature: theorem two_mul_actualOddHalfCorrection_eq_three_diagonalWindowIncrements {a q : ℕ} (ha : 2 ≤ a) : 2 * actualOddHalfCorrection a q = diagonalWindowIncrement (2 ^ a) (2 * q + 3) - 2 * diagonalWindowIncrement (2 ^ a) (2 * q + 2) + diagonalWindowIncrement (2 ^ a) (2 * q + 4)
declarations.docstring: The integral half-correction is exactly the three consecutive literal LCM-ray letters surrounding the even terminal offset. This exposes the arithmetic content hidden by the inherited/fresh cocycle notation: the even initial letter occurs with coefficient `-2`, while the following odd and even letters occur with coefficient `1`.

declarations.name: actualCenteredLift_modEq
declarations.signature: theorem actualCenteredLift_modEq (A M : ℤ) : Int.ModEq M (actualCenteredLift A M) A
declarations.docstring: Centering changes an integer only by a multiple of the modulus.

declarations.name: actualOddHalfCenteredLift_modEq_halfCorrectionWord

declarations.name: actualOddHalf_affine_modEq_halfCorrectionWord_succ

declarations.name: abs_actualOddHalfCorrection_le
declarations.signature: theorem abs_actualOddHalfCorrection_le {a n : ℕ} (ha : 2 ≤ a) : |actualOddHalfCorrection a n| ≤ (4 * periodLcm (2 ^ a) + 4 * n + 5 : ℤ)

declarations.name: abs_actualOddHalfCorrection_le_canonicalEnvelope
declarations.signature: theorem abs_actualOddHalfCorrection_le_canonicalEnvelope {a q : ℕ} (ha : 2 ≤ a) (hdepth : oddGuardedCanonicalAdjacentSuffixDepth (2 ^ a) = 2 * q + 1) : |actualOddHalfCorrection a (q - 1)| ≤ (4 * periodLcm (2 ^ a) + 2 * (2 * q + 1) - 1 : ℤ)

declarations.name: canonicalActualOddHalfCorrectionEnvelope_lt_edge
declarations.signature: theorem canonicalActualOddHalfCorrectionEnvelope_lt_edge {a q : ℕ} (ha : 2 ≤ a) (hdepth : oddGuardedCanonicalAdjacentSuffixDepth (2 ^ a) = 2 * q + 1) : (4 * periodLcm (2 ^ a) + 2 * (2 * q + 1) - 1 : ℤ) < (4 : ℤ) ^ q / 32

declarations.name: abs_actualOddHalfCorrection_lt_canonicalHalfEdge

declarations.docstring: The actual final half-correction is automatically sub-edge at every odd-guarded canonical power-two depth.

declarations.name: baseFour_actual_central_iff_affineExclusion
declarations.signature: theorem baseFour_actual_central_iff_affineExclusion {P e u c : ℤ} (hP : 0 < P) (he : 0 < e) (hscale : P = 8 * e) (hu : |u| ≤ P / 2) (hc : |c| < e) : (e ≤ (4 * u + c) % (4 * P) ∧ (4 * u + c) % (4 * P) ≤ 4 * P - e) ↔ e ≤ |4 * u + c|

declarations.name: baseFour_actual_central_of_sharpSignFreeMargin
declarations.signature: theorem baseFour_actual_central_of_sharpSignFreeMargin {P e u c : ℤ} (hP : 0 < P) (he : 0 < e) (hscale : P = 8 * e) (hu : |u| ≤ P / 2) (hc : |c| < e) (hmargin : e + |c| ≤ 4 * |u|) : e ≤ (4 * u + c) % (4 * P) ∧ (4 * u + c) % (4 * P) ≤ 4 * P - e

declarations.name: abs_actualCenteredLift_le_half

declarations.name: fourPow_pred_eq_eight_mul_edge

declarations.name: powerTwoOddGuardHalfWordBand_of_actualPenultimateMargin
declarations.signature: theorem powerTwoOddGuardHalfWordBand_of_actualPenultimateMargin {a q : ℕ} (ha : 2 ≤ a) (hdepth : oddGuardedCanonicalAdjacentSuffixDepth (2 ^ a) = 2 * q + 1) (hmargin : (4 : ℤ) ^ q / 32 + |actualOddHalfCorrection a (q - 1)| ≤ 4 * |actualOddHalfCenteredLift a (q - 1)|) : (4 : ℤ) ^ q ≤ 32 * (powerTwoOddHalfCorrectionWord a q % (4 : ℤ) ^ q) ∧ 32 * (powerTwoOddHalfCorrectionWord a q % (4 : ℤ) ^ q) ≤ 31 * (4 : ℤ) ^ q

declarations.name: powerTwoOddGuardHalfWordBandSupply_of_actualPenultimateEnvelopeMargin

declarations.name: actualAffineExclusion_iff_signedMargin

declarations.name: baseFour_actual_central_iff_signedMargin

declarations.name: powerTwoOddGuardHalfWordBand_iff_actualPenultimateSignedMargin
declarations.signature: theorem powerTwoOddGuardHalfWordBand_iff_actualPenultimateSignedMargin {a q : ℕ} (ha : 2 ≤ a) (hdepth : oddGuardedCanonicalAdjacentSuffixDepth (2 ^ a) = 2 * q + 1) : ((4 : ℤ) ^ q ≤ 32 * (powerTwoOddHalfCorrectionWord a q % (4 : ℤ) ^ q) ∧ 32 * (powerTwoOddHalfCorrectionWord a q % (4 : ℤ) ^ q) ≤ 31 * (4 : ℤ) ^ q) ↔ ActualPenultimateSignedMargin (actualOddHalfCenteredLift a (q - 1)) (actualOddHalfCorrection a (q - 1)) ((4 : ℤ) ^ q / 32)

declarations.name: PowerTwoActualPenultimateSignedMarginSupply

declarations.name: powerTwoActualPenultimateSignedMarginSupply_iff_halfWordBandSupply

declarations.name: irrational_totientSeries_of_actualPenultimateSignedMarginSupply
declarations.signature: theorem irrational_totientSeries_of_actualPenultimateSignedMarginSupply (hsupply : PowerTwoActualPenultimateSignedMarginSupply) : Irrational (∑' n : ℕ, (Nat.totient n : ℝ) / 2 ^ n)
