declarations.signature: theorem booleanCollision_wrap_bound_of_common_multiple (A : Set ℕ) (F : Finset ℕ) (p : ℕ) (hsum : Summable (reciprocalSupportTerm A)) {v h L : ℕ} (hv : 0 < v) (hperiod : IsDoublingPeriod v h) (hL : 0 < L) (hFA : ∀ a ∈ F, a ∈ A) (hFL : ∀ a ∈ F, a ∣ L) (u : ℕ → ℕ) (hstate : IsOddSupportTailState A p v u) : (doublingWrapCount p v h : ℝ) / (h : ℝ) + (booleanCollisionSurplus F.card : ℝ) / (L : ℝ) ≤ reciprocalMass A
declarations.docstring: Canonical unshifted T10 theorem. If every element of `F` divides `L`, then collisions at the positive multiples of `L` force the full `ceil ((|F|-1)/2) / L` gain above the residue-wrap mean.

declarations.name: one_lt_of_tendsto_cesaroMean_of_positive_two_spikes
declarations.signature: theorem one_lt_of_tendsto_cesaroMean_of_positive_two_spikes (k : ℕ → ℕ) (limit : ℝ) (L r : ℕ) (hL : 0 < L) (hpos : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < k n) (hspike : ∀ j : ℕ, 2 ≤ k (r + j * L)) (hlimit : Tendsto (cesaroMean (fun n : ℕ => (k n : ℝ))) atTop (nhds limit)) : 1 < limit
declarations.docstring: A positive integer sequence with a density-`1/L` family of values at least two has Cesaro limit strictly greater than one.

declarations.name: one_lt_reciprocalMass_of_dyadic_support_fraction_of_two_pos_mem
declarations.signature: theorem one_lt_reciprocalMass_of_dyadic_support_fraction_of_two_pos_mem (A : Set ℕ) (hsum : Summable (reciprocalSupportTerm A)) (p : ℤ) (c : ℕ) {a b : ℕ} (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (hab : a ≠ b) (haA : a ∈ A) (hbA : b ∈ A) (hvalue : erdosSupportSeries 2 A = (p : ℝ) / ((2 ^ c : ℕ) : ℝ)) : 1 < reciprocalMass A
declarations.docstring: A dyadic support fraction with two distinct positive support elements has reciprocal mass strictly greater than one whenever that mass is summable.

declarations.name: dyadic_support_fraction_reciprocalMass_diverges_or_gt_one
declarations.signature: theorem dyadic_support_fraction_reciprocalMass_diverges_or_gt_one (A : Set ℕ) (hAinf : A.Infinite) (p : ℤ) (c : ℕ) (hvalue : erdosSupportSeries 2 A = (p : ℝ) / ((2 ^ c : ℕ) : ℝ)) : ¬ Summable (reciprocalSupportTerm A) ∨ 1 < reciprocalMass A
declarations.docstring: Dyadic consequence, stated without abusing the real `tsum` convention in the divergent case: an infinite dyadic-rational support has divergent reciprocal mass or finite reciprocal mass strictly greater than one.

declarations.name: one_add_mul_card_le_two_mul_shifted_state
declarations.signature: theorem one_add_mul_card_le_two_mul_shifted_state (A : Set ℕ) (F : Finset ℕ) (c v L : ℕ) (u : ℕ → ℕ) (hcL : c < L) (hpos : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < u n) (hrec : ∀ n : ℕ, u (n + 1) + v * supportCoeff A (c + n + 1) = 2 * u n) (hFA : ∀ a ∈ F, a ∈ A) (hFdvd : ∀ a ∈ F, a ∣ L) : 1 + v * F.card ≤ 2 * u (L - c - 1)
declarations.docstring: The division-free local T13 inequality. A finite marked support fragment contributes at least its cardinality to the coefficient at a common multiple, while positivity of the next carry contributes the extra one. The shifted index is `L - c - 1`, not `L - 1`.

declarations.name: one_add_mul_card_le_two_mul_state
declarations.signature: theorem one_add_mul_card_le_two_mul_state (A : Set ℕ) (F : Finset ℕ) (v L : ℕ) (u : ℕ → ℕ) (hL : 0 < L) (hpos : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < u n) (hrec : ∀ n : ℕ, u (n + 1) + v * supportCoeff A (n + 1) = 2 * u n) (hFA : ∀ a ∈ F, a ∈ A) (hFdvd : ∀ a ∈ F, a ∣ L) : 1 + v * F.card ≤ 2 * u (L - 1)
declarations.docstring: Unshifted wrapper for a recurrence indexed directly by `supportCoeff A (n + 1)`.

declarations.name: one_add_mul_card_ceil_half_le_shifted_state
declarations.signature: theorem one_add_mul_card_ceil_half_le_shifted_state (A : Set ℕ) (F : Finset ℕ) (c v L : ℕ) (u : ℕ → ℕ) (hcL : c < L) (hpos : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < u n) (hrec : ∀ n : ℕ, u (n + 1) + v * supportCoeff A (c + n + 1) = 2 * u n) (hFA : ∀ a ∈ F, a ∈ A) (hFdvd : ∀ a ∈ F, a ∣ L) : (1 + v * F.card + 1) / 2 ≤ u (L - c - 1)
declarations.docstring: Natural ceiling form of the shifted T13 inequality.

declarations.name: one_add_mul_card_half_le_shifted_state
declarations.signature: theorem one_add_mul_card_half_le_shifted_state (A : Set ℕ) (F : Finset ℕ) (c v L : ℕ) (u : ℕ → ℕ) (hcL : c < L) (hpos : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < u n) (hrec : ∀ n : ℕ, u (n + 1) + v * supportCoeff A (c + n + 1) = 2 * u n) (hFA : ∀ a ∈ F, a ∈ A) (hFdvd : ∀ a ∈ F, a ∣ L) : ((1 + v * F.card : ℕ) : ℝ) / 2 ≤ (u (L - c - 1) : ℝ)
declarations.docstring: Ordinary real half form of the shifted T13 inequality.

declarations.name: exists_shifted_odd_tail_nat_state_with_common_multiple_bound_of_support_fraction
declarations.signature: theorem exists_shifted_odd_tail_nat_state_with_common_multiple_bound_of_support_fraction (A : Set ℕ) (hA : ∃ a : ℕ, 0 < a ∧ a ∈ A) (F : Finset ℕ) (p : ℤ) (c v L : ℕ) (hv : 0 < v) (hcL : c < L) (hFA : ∀ a ∈ F, a ∈ A) (hFdvd : ∀ a ∈ F, a ∣ L) (hvalue : erdosSupportSeries 2 A = (p : ℝ) / ((2 ^ c * v : ℕ) : ℝ)) : ∃ u : ℕ → ℕ, (∀ n : ℕ, (u n : ℝ) = (v : ℝ) * binaryCoeffTail (supportCoeff A) (c + n)) ∧ (∀ n : ℕ, 0 < u n) ∧ (∀ n : ℕ, u (n + 1) + v * supportCoeff A (c + n + 1) = 2 * u n) ∧ (∀ n : ℕ, u n ≡ p.toNat * 2 ^ n [MOD v]) ∧
declarations.docstring: Fraction-facing local T13 wrapper. It preserves every clause of the existing shifted natural-state constructor and adds the raw common-multiple bound without changing that constructor's API.

declarations.name: shifted_state_unbounded_of_infinite_support
declarations.signature: theorem shifted_state_unbounded_of_infinite_support (A : Set ℕ) (hAinf : A.Infinite) (c v : ℕ) (hv : 0 < v) (u : ℕ → ℕ) (hpos : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < u n) (hrec : ∀ n : ℕ, u (n + 1) + v * supportCoeff A (c + n + 1) = 2 * u n) : ∀ B : ℕ, ∃ n : ℕ, B < u n
declarations.docstring: The complete T13 core: every positive shifted recurrence over an infinite support is globally unbounded. The proof selects `2B+1` positive support elements and uses their product, multiplied by `c+1`, as an explicit common multiple.

declarations.name: exists_unbounded_shifted_odd_tail_nat_state_of_support_fraction
declarations.signature: theorem exists_unbounded_shifted_odd_tail_nat_state_of_support_fraction (A : Set ℕ) (hAinf : A.Infinite) (p : ℤ) (c v : ℕ) (hv : 0 < v) (hvalue : erdosSupportSeries 2 A = (p : ℝ) / ((2 ^ c * v : ℕ) : ℝ)) : ∃ u : ℕ → ℕ, (∀ n : ℕ, (u n : ℝ) = (v : ℝ) * binaryCoeffTail (supportCoeff A) (c + n)) ∧ (∀ n : ℕ, 0 < u n) ∧ (∀ n : ℕ, u (n + 1) + v * supportCoeff A (c + n + 1) = 2 * u n) ∧ (∀ n : ℕ, u n ≡ p.toNat * 2 ^ n [MOD v]) ∧ (∀ B : ℕ, ∃ n : ℕ, B < u n)
declarations.docstring: Canonical fraction-facing T13 theorem. Every infinite rational support admits the existing shifted natural tail state, and that state is globally unbounded.

declarations.name: carryOrbit23_common_multiple_bound_validation66

declarations.name: moebius_prod_subset_primeFactors
declarations.signature: private theorem moebius_prod_subset_primeFactors {r : ℕ} (hr : Squarefree r) {s : Finset ℕ} (hs : s ⊆ r.primeFactors) : ArithmeticFunction.moebius (s.prod id) = (-1 : ℤ) ^ s.card

declarations.name: divisor_mobiusNumerator_eq_subset
declarations.signature: private theorem divisor_mobiusNumerator_eq_subset {r : ℕ} (hr : Squarefree r) : (∑ d ∈ r.divisors, ArithmeticFunction.moebius d * (((r / d : ℕ) : ℤ)) * (((RadicalMobiusShadow.mersenne r / RadicalMobiusShadow.mersenne d : ℕ) : ℤ))) = RadicalMobiusShadow.mobiusNumerator r

declarations.name: sum_divisors_moebius_ratio_eq_baseMobiusShadow
declarations.signature: theorem sum_divisors_moebius_ratio_eq_baseMobiusShadow {r : ℕ} (hr : Squarefree r) : (∑ d ∈ r.divisors, ((ArithmeticFunction.moebius d : ℤ) : ℚ) * (r : ℚ) / ((d : ℚ) * (RadicalMobiusShadow.mersenne d : ℚ))) = RadicalMobiusShadow.baseMobiusShadow r
declarations.docstring: The integral divisor expansion, normalized term-by-term as the rational Möbius/Mersenne sum. This is the finite identity needed to identify the divisor residue channels with the explicit radical shadow.

declarations.name: sum_divisors_moebius_ratio_eq_scaledMobiusShadow
declarations.signature: theorem sum_divisors_moebius_ratio_eq_scaledMobiusShadow (H : ℕ) (hH : 0 < H) : (∑ d ∈ H.divisors, ((ArithmeticFunction.moebius d : ℤ) : ℚ) * (H : ℚ) / ((d : ℚ) * (RadicalMobiusShadow.mersenne d : ℚ))) = (H : ℚ) * RadicalMobiusShadow.numericMobiusShadow H
declarations.docstring: The same divisor formula at an arbitrary positive scale. The Möbius coefficient kills every nonsquarefree divisor of `H`, so the remaining divisor set is exactly the divisor set of `rad(H)`.

declarations.name: mobiusNumeratorPolynomial_eval_two

declarations.name: det_residualMonomialMatrix

declarations.name: det_residualMonomialMatrix_ne_zero_iff

declarations.name: norm_det_residualMonomialMatrix

declarations.name: residualMonomialMatrix_locked_row_one

declarations.name: locked_reconstruction_preserves_nonzero_minor

declarations.name: norm_rowReconstructingResidual

declarations.name: rowReconstruction_zero_row_one

declarations.name: depth26RightAncestor_bit14_true

declarations.name: depth27_actualRewindSeam_not_boundaryPair

declarations.name: supportCoeff_eq_of_restriction_at_halfDivisor
declarations.signature: theorem supportCoeff_eq_of_restriction_at_halfDivisor {K M : ℕ} (hKM : K + 1 ≤ M) (hMlt : M < 2 * (K + 1)) (w : HalfWord M) (b : HalfWord (K + 1)) (hrestrict : restrictWord hKM w = b) : supportCoeff (wordSupport w) (2 * (K + 1)) = supportCoeff (wordSupport b) (2 * (K + 1))

declarations.name: totient_mul_prime_cocycle
declarations.signature: theorem totient_mul_prime_cocycle {p m : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) : Nat.totient (p * m) = (p - 1) * Nat.totient m + if p ∣ m then Nat.totient m else 0

declarations.name: totient_dilation_clean_of_square_residue
declarations.signature: theorem totient_dilation_clean_of_square_residue {p A a t h : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hclean : ¬p ∣ a + h) : Nat.totient (A + p * (a + p * t) + p * h - A) = (p - 1) * Nat.totient (a + p * t + h)

declarations.name: totient_dilation_clean_of_square_witness
declarations.signature: theorem totient_dilation_clean_of_square_witness {p A t h : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hh : 0 < h) (hhp : h < p) : Nat.totient (A + p ^ 2 * t + p * h - A) = (p - 1) * Nat.totient (p * t + h)
declarations.docstring: Canonical anchor residue `a = 0`. The hypotheses `0 < h < p` make the whole horizon `1 ≤ h ≤ J < p` clean after imposing `n = A + p^2*t`.

declarations.name: exists_square_witness_of_modEq

declarations.docstring: An ordered square congruence has the quotient witness used by the clean dilation theorem.

declarations.name: totient_dilation_clean_of_square_modEq
declarations.signature: theorem totient_dilation_clean_of_square_modEq {p A a n h : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hresidue : A + p * a ≤ n) (hmod : n ≡ A + p * a [MOD p ^ 2]) (hclean : ¬p ∣ a + h) : ∃ t : ℕ, n = A + p * (a + p * t) ∧ Nat.totient (n + p * h - A) = (p - 1) * Nat.totient (a + p * t + h)
declarations.docstring: Direct `Nat.ModEq` adapter: once the CRT representative is at least its target residue, the congruence produces a cofactor and the correction-free totient identity at every clean shift.

declarations.name: pairwise_coprime_prime_squares
declarations.signature: theorem pairwise_coprime_prime_squares {ι : Type*} {E : Finset ι} {p : ι → ℕ} (hprime : ∀ i ∈ E, (p i).Prime) (hinj : Set.InjOn p (E : Set ι)) : Set.Pairwise (E : Set ι) (fun i j => Nat.Coprime (p i ^ 2) (p j ^ 2))

declarations.name: exists_squareCRT_base
declarations.signature: theorem exists_squareCRT_base {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] (E : Finset ι) (p A a : ι → ℕ) (hmod : ∀ i ∈ E, p i ^ 2 ≠ 0) (hcop : Set.Pairwise (E : Set ι) (fun i j => Nat.Coprime (p i ^ 2) (p j ^ 2))) : ∃ n : ℕ, n < ∏ i ∈ E, p i ^ 2 ∧ ∀ i ∈ E, n ≡ A i + p i * a i [MOD p i ^ 2]
declarations.docstring: A finite family of pairwise-coprime square congruences has a simultaneous representative strictly below the product of the square moduli.

declarations.name: exists_squareCRT_base_of_distinct_primes
declarations.signature: theorem exists_squareCRT_base_of_distinct_primes {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] (E : Finset ι) (p A a : ι → ℕ) (hprime : ∀ i ∈ E, (p i).Prime) (hinj : Set.InjOn p (E : Set ι)) : ∃ n : ℕ, n < ∏ i ∈ E, p i ^ 2 ∧ ∀ i ∈ E, n ≡ A i + p i * a i [MOD p i ^ 2]

declarations.name: exists_large_squareCRT_base
declarations.signature: theorem exists_large_squareCRT_base {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] (E : Finset ι) (p A a : ι → ℕ) (B : ℕ) (hmod : ∀ i ∈ E, p i ^ 2 ≠ 0) (hcop : Set.Pairwise (E : Set ι) (fun i j => Nat.Coprime (p i ^ 2) (p j ^ 2))) : ∃ n : ℕ, B < n ∧ n < (∏ i ∈ E, p i ^ 2) * (B + 2) ∧ ∀ i ∈ E, n ≡ A i + p i * a i [MOD p i ^ 2]

declarations.name: exists_squareCRT_clean_totient_family
declarations.signature: theorem exists_squareCRT_clean_totient_family {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] (E : Finset ι) (p A a : ι → ℕ) (hprime : ∀ i ∈ E, (p i).Prime) (hinj : Set.InjOn p (E : Set ι)) : ∃ n : ℕ, n < (∏ i ∈ E, p i ^ 2) * (E.sup (fun i => A i + p i * a i) + 2) ∧ ∀ i ∈ E, ∀ h : ℕ, ¬p i ∣ a i + h → ∃ t : ℕ, n = A i + p i * (a i + p i * t) ∧ Nat.totient (n + p i * h - A i) = (p i - 1) * Nat.totient (a i + p i * t + h)

declarations.name: exists_squareCRT_clean_horizon
declarations.signature: theorem exists_squareCRT_clean_horizon {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] (E : Finset ι) (p A : ι → ℕ) (J : ℕ) (hprime : ∀ i ∈ E, (p i).Prime) (hinj : Set.InjOn p (E : Set ι)) (horizon : ∀ i ∈ E, J < p i) : ∃ n : ℕ, n < (∏ i ∈ E, p i ^ 2) * (E.sup A + 2) ∧ ∀ i ∈ E, ∀ h : ℕ, 0 < h → h ≤ J → ∃ t : ℕ, n = A i + p i ^ 2 * t ∧ Nat.totient (n + p i * h - A i) = (p i - 1) * Nat.totient (p i * t + h)

declarations.name: alternating_powerset_sum_eq_zero_of_insert_invariant
declarations.signature: theorem alternating_powerset_sum_eq_zero_of_insert_invariant {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] {s : Finset ι} {i : ι} (hi : i ∉ s) (f : Finset ι → ℤ) (hinv : ∀ t ∈ s.powerset, f (insert i t) = f t) : ∑ t ∈ (insert i s).powerset, (-1 : ℤ) ^ t.card * f t = 0

declarations.docstring: The actual diagonal lies in the sharp squared-Mersenne enclosure around the exact rational centre.

declarations.name: scaleFullTarget_miss_of_lambert_projected_separation
declarations.signature: theorem scaleFullTarget_miss_of_lambert_projected_separation {H D : ℕ} (hsep : ∀ z : ℤ, lambertSquareComplementBound H D < |lambertProjectedDiagonal H D - (z : ℝ)|) : ¬ScaleFullTargetHit H
declarations.docstring: Exact rational separation of the squared-Mersenne centre from the integer lattice forces a genuine miss of the actual full target.

declarations.name: LR
declarations.signature: inductive LR | left | right deriving DecidableEq, Repr /-- Exchange the two parabolic directions. -/ def LR.flip : LR → LR | .left => .right | .right => .left @[simp] theorem LR.flip_left : LR.left.flip = LR.right
declarations.docstring: The two Stern--Brocot mediant moves.

declarations.name: LR.flip
declarations.signature: def LR.flip : LR → LR | .left => .right | .right => .left @[simp] theorem LR.flip_left : LR.left.flip = LR.right
declarations.docstring: Exchange the two parabolic directions.

declarations.name: step
declarations.signature: def step : LR → ℕ × ℕ → ℕ × ℕ | .left, (a, b) => (a + b, b) | .right, (a, b) => (a, a + b) /-- The pair reached from `(1,1)`. The list head is the newest move and acts last; this agrees with the newest-run-first convention used below. -/ def sbPair : List LR → ℕ × ℕ | [] => (1, 1) | d :: w => step d (sbPair w) /-- Arithmetic height of a Stern--Brocot word. -/ def sbHeight (w : List LR) : ℕ
declarations.docstring: One mediant step on a positive lattice pair.

declarations.name: sbPair
declarations.signature: def sbPair : List LR → ℕ × ℕ | [] => (1, 1) | d :: w => step d (sbPair w) /-- Arithmetic height of a Stern--Brocot word. -/ def sbHeight (w : List LR) : ℕ
declarations.docstring: The pair reached from `(1,1)`. The list head is the newest move and acts last; this agrees with the newest-run-first convention used below.

declarations.name: sbHeight
declarations.docstring: Arithmetic height of a Stern--Brocot word.

declarations.name: sbPair_coprime
declarations.signature: theorem sbPair_coprime (w : List LR) : Nat.Coprime (sbPair w).1 (sbPair w).2
declarations.docstring: Every word reaches a primitive pair.

declarations.name: sbPair_pos
declarations.signature: theorem sbPair_pos (w : List LR) : 0 < (sbPair w).1 ∧ 0 < (sbPair w).2
declarations.docstring: Both coordinates reached from `(1,1)` stay positive.

declarations.name: runWord
declarations.signature: def runWord : LR → List ℕ → List LR | _, [] => [] | newest, n :: ns => List.replicate n newest ++ runWord newest.flip ns /-- The direction-free continuant state at run boundaries. Its first coordinate is the coordinate changed
declarations.docstring: A word with alternating directions and the supplied run lengths. The first length is the newest run and its direction is `newest`.

declarations.name: runBoundaryPair
declarations.signature: def runBoundaryPair : List ℕ → ℕ × ℕ | [] => (1, 1) | n :: ns => let p
declarations.docstring: The direction-free continuant state at run boundaries. Its first coordinate is the coordinate changed by the newest run; the second is the other coordinate.

declarations.name: runHeight
declarations.docstring: Height in run coordinates.

declarations.name: sbPair_replicate_left_append
declarations.signature: private theorem sbPair_replicate_left_append (n : ℕ) (w : List LR) : sbPair (List.replicate n LR.left ++ w) = ((sbPair w).1 + n * (sbPair w).2, (sbPair w).2)

declarations.name: sbPair_replicate_right_append
declarations.signature: private theorem sbPair_replicate_right_append (n : ℕ) (w : List LR) : sbPair (List.replicate n LR.right ++ w) = ((sbPair w).1, (sbPair w).2 + n * (sbPair w).1)

declarations.name: sbPair_runWord
declarations.signature: theorem sbPair_runWord (newest : LR) (ns : List ℕ) : sbPair (runWord newest ns) = match newest with | .left => runBoundaryPair ns | .right => ((runBoundaryPair ns).2, (runBoundaryPair ns).1)
declarations.docstring: The run continuant is not a new coordinate detached from the tree: it is exactly the pair reached by the corresponding alternating Stern--Brocot word, up to the expected coordinate swap for a newest right run.

declarations.name: sbHeight_runWord
declarations.signature: theorem sbHeight_runWord (newest : LR) (ns : List ℕ) : sbHeight (runWord newest ns) = runHeight ns
declarations.docstring: Run height is the literal arithmetic height on the mediant tree.

declarations.name: runBoundaryPair_coprime
declarations.signature: theorem runBoundaryPair_coprime (ns : List ℕ) : Nat.Coprime (runBoundaryPair ns).1 (runBoundaryPair ns).2
declarations.docstring: The run-boundary pair remains primitive.

declarations.name: runBoundaryPair_fib_lower
declarations.signature: theorem runBoundaryPair_fib_lower (ns : List ℕ) (hpos : ∀ n ∈ ns, 0 < n) : Nat.fib (ns.length + 2) ≤ (runBoundaryPair ns).1 ∧ Nat.fib (ns.length + 1) ≤ (runBoundaryPair ns).2
declarations.docstring: Coordinatewise Fibonacci floor for positive run lengths.

declarations.name: runHeight_fib_lower
declarations.signature: theorem runHeight_fib_lower (ns : List ℕ) (hpos : ∀ n ∈ ns, 0 < n) : Nat.fib (ns.length + 3) ≤ runHeight ns
declarations.docstring: **Fibonacci minimum height.** Every alternating word with `r` nonempty runs has height at least `F_{r+3}`.

declarations.name: sbHeight_runWord_fib_lower
declarations.signature: theorem sbHeight_runWord_fib_lower (newest : LR) (ns : List ℕ) (hpos : ∀ n ∈ ns, 0 < n) : Nat.fib (ns.length + 3) ≤ sbHeight (runWord newest ns)
declarations.docstring: Tree-facing form of the Fibonacci height floor.

declarations.name: runBoundaryPair_replicate_one
declarations.signature: theorem runBoundaryPair_replicate_one (r : ℕ) : runBoundaryPair (List.replicate r 1) = (Nat.fib (r + 2), Nat.fib (r + 1))
declarations.docstring: The all-unit alternating spine is exactly Fibonacci.

declarations.name: runHeight_replicate_one
declarations.signature: theorem runHeight_replicate_one (r : ℕ) : runHeight (List.replicate r 1) = Nat.fib (r + 3)
declarations.docstring: Equality case for the Fibonacci height floor.

declarations.name: defectRunLengths
declarations.signature: def defectRunLengths (e : List ℕ) : List ℕ
declarations.docstring: Replace every nonnegative defect `eᵢ` by the positive run length `1 + eᵢ`.

declarations.name: exactDefectPair
declarations.signature: def exactDefectPair : List ℕ → ℕ × ℕ | [] => (0, 0) | e :: es => let d
declarations.docstring: The exact defect of the two run-boundary coordinates from their Fibonacci values. The term `e * d.1` is the first mixed monomial created at the newest defect; recursively expanding it gives the full positive multiaffine continuant-defect polynomial.

declarations.name: linearDefectPair
declarations.signature: def linearDefectPair : List ℕ → ℕ × ℕ | [] => (0, 0) | e :: es => let d
declarations.docstring: The degree-one part of `exactDefectPair`. It is obtained by deleting the mixed term `e * d.1` at every recursive step.

declarations.name: runBoundaryPair_defectRunLengths
declarations.signature: theorem runBoundaryPair_defectRunLengths (e : List ℕ) : runBoundaryPair (defectRunLengths e) = (Nat.fib (e.length + 2) + (exactDefectPair e).1, Nat.fib (e.length + 1) + (exactDefectPair e).2)
declarations.docstring: Exact coordinate expansion around the all-unit Fibonacci spine.

declarations.name: runHeight_defectRunLengths
declarations.signature: theorem runHeight_defectRunLengths (e : List ℕ) : runHeight (defectRunLengths e) = Nat.fib (e.length + 3) + (exactDefectPair e).1 + (exactDefectPair e).2
declarations.docstring: Exact height expansion. In particular, `exactDefectPair` is not an estimate: it owns every mixed coefficient of the continuant defect.

declarations.name: linearDefectPair_le_exactDefectPair
declarations.signature: theorem linearDefectPair_le_exactDefectPair (e : List ℕ) : (linearDefectPair e).1 ≤ (exactDefectPair e).1 ∧ (linearDefectPair e).2 ≤ (exactDefectPair e).2
declarations.docstring: Every coefficient discarded by the linearization is nonnegative.

declarations.name: runHeight_defect_linear_lower
declarations.signature: theorem runHeight_defect_linear_lower (e : List ℕ) : Nat.fib (e.length + 3) + (linearDefectPair e).1 + (linearDefectPair e).2 ≤ runHeight (defectRunLengths e)
declarations.docstring: Structural linear floor for the full continuant defect. This statement retains the recursively ordered one-site coefficients; the next theorem identifies each of them with a closed Fibonacci product.

declarations.name: linearDefectPair_fib_sum_lower
declarations.signature: theorem linearDefectPair_fib_sum_lower (e : List ℕ) : Nat.fib e.length * e.sum ≤ (linearDefectPair e).1 ∧ Nat.fib (e.length + 1) * e.sum ≤ (linearDefectPair e).1 + (linearDefectPair e).2
declarations.docstring: The recursively ordered coefficients admit the uniform sharp floor: the first-coordinate coefficients are at least `F_r`, and the height coefficients are at least `F_{r+1}`.

declarations.name: runHeight_defect_fib_sum_lower
declarations.signature: theorem runHeight_defect_fib_sum_lower (e : List ℕ) : Nat.fib (e.length + 3) + Nat.fib (e.length + 1) * e.sum ≤ runHeight (defectRunLengths e)
declarations.docstring: **Sharp global stability floor.** If the positive run lengths are `1 + eᵢ`, their height gains at least `F_{r+1}` for every unit of total defect. Boundary one-site rays attain this coefficient exactly.

declarations.name: oneSiteWeight
declarations.docstring: Closed coefficient of a defect at position `i`, counted from the newest run boundary. The hypothesis `i < r` keeps the coefficient inside an `r`-run word without introducing a second indexing type.

declarations.name: oneSiteWeight_eq_base_add
declarations.signature: theorem oneSiteWeight_eq_base_add {r i : ℕ} (hi : i < r) : oneSiteWeight r i = Nat.fib (r + 1) + Nat.fib i * Nat.fib (r - i - 1)
declarations.docstring: The one-site coefficient is the boundary value `F_{r+1}` plus an explicit interior surplus.

declarations.name: linearDefectPair_first_lt_exact_of_head_tail_pos
declarations.signature: theorem linearDefectPair_first_lt_exact_of_head_tail_pos {e : ℕ} (he : 0 < e) {es : List ℕ} (htail : 0 < (exactDefectPair es).1) : (linearDefectPair (e :: es)).1 < (exactDefectPair (e :: es)).1
declarations.docstring: The recursive expansion exposes a strict mixed term as soon as the newest defect and an older defect are both present.

declarations.name: runHeight_one_cons
declarations.signature: private theorem runHeight_one_cons (ns : List ℕ) : runHeight (1 :: ns) = runHeight ns + (runBoundaryPair ns).1

declarations.name: runBoundaryPair_replicate_one_append
declarations.signature: private theorem runBoundaryPair_replicate_one_append (i : ℕ) (ns : List ℕ) : let p

declarations.name: runHeight_oneSiteDefect
declarations.signature: theorem runHeight_oneSiteDefect {r i : ℕ} (hi : i < r) (e : ℕ) : runHeight (List.replicate i 1 ++ (e + 1) :: List.replicate (r - i - 1) 1) = Nat.fib (r + 3) + oneSiteWeight r i * e
declarations.docstring: A single defect is exactly linear, with coefficient `F_{i+2} F_{r-i+1}`. This is the sharp coefficient formula and includes the arbitrary defect magnitude `e`, not only the derivative at `e = 0`.

declarations.name: runHeight_single
declarations.docstring: Exact height of one parabolic run.

declarations.name: runHeight_pair
declarations.signature: @[simp] theorem runHeight_pair (m n : ℕ) : runHeight [m, n] = (m + 1) * (n + 1) + 1
declarations.docstring: Exact height of two alternating parabolic runs. After putting `u = m+1`, `v = n+1`, the two orientations together contribute the weight `2 * 2^{-(uv+1)} = 2^{-uv}` used by the second induced layer.

declarations.name: zeroRunMass
declarations.docstring: Root contribution, before any nonempty parabolic run.

declarations.name: oneRunMass
declarations.docstring: Contribution of the two orientations with one positive run. The natural number index `n` represents run length `n+1`.

declarations.name: oneRunMass_eq_half
declarations.docstring: Exact first induced layer: the two parabolic cusps together carry mass `1/2`.

declarations.name: naturalRunDenominatorExponent
declarations.docstring: Sum of the invariant-coordinate exponents encountered on the unit-run spine. Clearing the corresponding Mersenne resolvents introduces factors on this exponent scale.

declarations.name: naturalRunDenominatorExponent_add_two
declarations.signature: theorem naturalRunDenominatorExponent_add_two (r : ℕ) : naturalRunDenominatorExponent r + 2 = Nat.fib (r + 3)
declarations.docstring: The natural exponent is exactly two below the minimum run height scale: `F₂ + ... + F_{r+1} + 2 = F_{r+3}`.

declarations.name: nat_add_one_pow_le_self_pow_mul_two_pow
declarations.signature: theorem nat_add_one_pow_le_self_pow_mul_two_pow (k a : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k) : (a + 1) ^ k ≤ k ^ k * 2 ^ a
declarations.docstring: A single explicit penalty `k^k` controls every exponent at every prime at least two.

declarations.name: factorization_add_one_pow_le_penalty_mul
declarations.signature: theorem factorization_add_one_pow_le_penalty_mul (n p k : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hp : p ∈ n.primeFactors) : (n.factorization p + 1) ^ k ≤ (if p < 2 ^ k then k ^ k else 1) * p ^ n.factorization p
declarations.docstring: Pointwise prime-factor estimate: only primes below `2^k` pay the explicit `k^k` penalty.

declarations.name: card_small_primeFactors_le_two_pow
declarations.signature: theorem card_small_primeFactors_le_two_pow (n k : ℕ) : (n.primeFactors.filter fun p => p < 2 ^ k).card ≤ 2 ^ k
declarations.docstring: There are at most `2^k` prime factors below the cutoff `2^k`.

declarations.name: divisorSubpowerConst
declarations.docstring: Completely explicit constant for the fixed-`k` divisor bound.

declarations.name: card_divisors_pow_le_divisorSubpowerConst_pow_mul
declarations.signature: theorem card_divisors_pow_le_divisorSubpowerConst_pow_mul (n k : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (hk : 1 ≤ k) : n.divisors.card ^ k ≤ divisorSubpowerConst k ^ k * n
declarations.docstring: Fixed-natural-power divisor theorem. All prime-factor bookkeeping is in `ℕ`; the only loss is the explicit penalty from primes below `2^k`.

declarations.name: card_divisors_le_divisorSubpowerConst_mul_rpow
declarations.signature: theorem card_divisors_le_divisorSubpowerConst_mul_rpow (n k : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k) : (n.divisors.card : ℝ) ≤ (divisorSubpowerConst k : ℝ) * (n : ℝ) ^ ((k : ℝ)⁻¹)
declarations.docstring: Take the real `k`-th root once, after the finite prime-factor product has been closed in `ℕ`. This version includes `n = 0`.

declarations.name: supportCoeff_pow_le_divisorSubpowerConst_pow_mul
declarations.signature: theorem supportCoeff_pow_le_divisorSubpowerConst_pow_mul (A : Set ℕ) (n k : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (hk : 1 ≤ k) : supportCoeff A n ^ k ≤ divisorSubpowerConst k ^ k * n
declarations.docstring: The support coefficient inherits the fixed-power divisor theorem.

declarations.name: supportCoeff_le_divisorSubpowerConst_mul_rpow
declarations.signature: theorem supportCoeff_le_divisorSubpowerConst_mul_rpow (A : Set ℕ) (n k : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k) : (supportCoeff A n : ℝ) ≤ (divisorSubpowerConst k : ℝ) * (n : ℝ) ^ ((k : ℝ)⁻¹)
declarations.docstring: Real subpower form inherited by `supportCoeff`.

declarations.name: SupportCoeffZeroWindow
declarations.signature: def SupportCoeffZeroWindow (A : Set ℕ) (N h : ℕ) : Prop
declarations.docstring: `supportCoeff A` vanishes on the `h` positive indices immediately after `N`, namely `N + 1, ..., N + h`.

declarations.name: shiftedTailState_eq_pow_mul_of_supportCoeffZeroWindow
declarations.signature: theorem shiftedTailState_eq_pow_mul_of_supportCoeffZeroWindow (A : Set ℕ) (c v N h : ℕ) (u : ℕ → ℕ) (hrec : ∀ n : ℕ, u (n + 1) + v * supportCoeff A (c + n + 1) = 2 * u n) (hzero : SupportCoeffZeroWindow A (c + N) h) : u (N + h) = 2 ^ h * u N
declarations.docstring: A shifted natural tail state doubles exactly across a support-coefficient zero window. This is the recurrence-only core of T11; it uses no analytic growth estimate.

declarations.name: pow_le_shiftedTailState_of_supportCoeffZeroWindow
declarations.signature: theorem pow_le_shiftedTailState_of_supportCoeffZeroWindow (A : Set ℕ) (c v N h : ℕ) (u : ℕ → ℕ) (hpos : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < u n) (hrec : ∀ n : ℕ, u (n + 1) + v * supportCoeff A (c + n + 1) = 2 * u n) (hzero : SupportCoeffZeroWindow A (c + N) h) : 2 ^ h ≤ u (N + h)
declarations.docstring: Positivity upgrades exact doubling to the natural-number lower bound `2^h ≤ u(N+h)`.

declarations.name: pow_le_mul_binaryCoeffTail_of_support_fraction_zeroWindow
declarations.signature: theorem pow_le_mul_binaryCoeffTail_of_support_fraction_zeroWindow (A : Set ℕ) (hA : ∃ a : ℕ, 0 < a ∧ a ∈ A) (p : ℤ) (c v N h : ℕ) (hv : 0 < v) (hvalue : erdosSupportSeries 2 A = (p : ℝ) / ((2 ^ c * v : ℕ) : ℝ)) (hzero : SupportCoeffZeroWindow A (c + N) h) : (2 : ℝ) ^ h ≤ (v : ℝ) * binaryCoeffTail (supportCoeff A) (c + N + h)
declarations.docstring: Fraction-facing algebraic T11 boundary. For a displayed denominator `2^c * v`, every zero window forces the odd tail state, hence the scaled true tail, to be at least `2^h`.

declarations.name: SupportCoeffTailEnvelope
declarations.signature: def SupportCoeffTailEnvelope (A : Set ℕ) (envelope : ℕ → ℝ) : Prop
declarations.docstring: An explicit upper envelope for the scaled support-coefficient tail.

declarations.name: supportCoeffTailEnvelope_two_mul_rpow_of_card_divisors_bound
declarations.signature: theorem supportCoeffTailEnvelope_two_mul_rpow_of_card_divisors_bound (A : Set ℕ) (C δ : ℝ) (hδ0 : 0 ≤ δ) (hδ1 : δ ≤ 1) (hdiv : ∀ n : ℕ, (n.divisors.card : ℝ) ≤ C * (n : ℝ) ^ δ) : SupportCoeffTailEnvelope A (fun M : ℕ => 2 * C * (((M + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ δ))
declarations.docstring: Package a pointwise divisor-card bound into the exact tail-envelope interface consumed by the rational carry theorem below.

declarations.name: supportCoeffTailEnvelope_divisorSubpower
declarations.signature: theorem supportCoeffTailEnvelope_divisorSubpower (A : Set ℕ) (k : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k) : SupportCoeffTailEnvelope A (fun M : ℕ => 2 * (divisorSubpowerConst k : ℝ) * (((M + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ ((k : ℝ)⁻¹)))
declarations.docstring: Unconditional support-tail envelope with exponent exactly `1/k`.

declarations.name: pow_le_mul_tailEnvelope_of_support_fraction_zeroWindow
declarations.signature: theorem pow_le_mul_tailEnvelope_of_support_fraction_zeroWindow (A : Set ℕ) (hA : ∃ a : ℕ, 0 < a ∧ a ∈ A) (p : ℤ) (c v N h : ℕ) (hv : 0 < v) (hvalue : erdosSupportSeries 2 A = (p : ℝ) / ((2 ^ c * v : ℕ) : ℝ)) (hzero : SupportCoeffZeroWindow A (c + N) h) (envelope : ℕ → ℝ) (henvelope : SupportCoeffTailEnvelope A envelope) : (2 : ℝ) ^ h ≤ (v : ℝ) * envelope (c + N + h)
declarations.docstring: Consumer-shaped conditional T11 theorem. Once a subpower tail envelope is supplied, a zero window is bounded by that envelope at its right endpoint. No divisor-growth implementation detail leaks into the rational-support argument.

declarations.name: pow_le_mul_two_mul_rpow_of_card_divisors_bound_zeroWindow
declarations.signature: theorem pow_le_mul_two_mul_rpow_of_card_divisors_bound_zeroWindow (A : Set ℕ) (hA : ∃ a : ℕ, 0 < a ∧ a ∈ A) (p : ℤ) (c v N h : ℕ) (hv : 0 < v) (hvalue : erdosSupportSeries 2 A = (p : ℝ) / ((2 ^ c * v : ℕ) : ℝ)) (hzero : SupportCoeffZeroWindow A (c + N) h) (C δ : ℝ) (hδ0 : 0 ≤ δ) (hδ1 : δ ≤ 1) (hdiv : ∀ n : ℕ, (n.divisors.card : ℝ) ≤ C * (n : ℝ) ^ δ) : (2 : ℝ) ^ h ≤ (v : ℝ) * (2 * C * ((((c + N + h) + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ δ))
declarations.docstring: Direct consumer bridge from any pointwise divisor subpower bound to a zero-window power inequality.

declarations.name: pow_le_divisorSubpower_of_support_fraction_zeroWindow
declarations.signature: theorem pow_le_divisorSubpower_of_support_fraction_zeroWindow (A : Set ℕ) (hA : ∃ a : ℕ, 0 < a ∧ a ∈ A) (p : ℤ) (c v N h k : ℕ) (hv : 0 < v) (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hvalue : erdosSupportSeries 2 A = (p : ℝ) / ((2 ^ c * v : ℕ) : ℝ)) (hzero : SupportCoeffZeroWindow A (c + N) h) : (2 : ℝ) ^ h ≤ (2 * (v : ℝ) * (divisorSubpowerConst k : ℝ)) * (((c + N + 1 + h : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ ((k : ℝ)⁻¹))
declarations.docstring: The unconditional divisor-subpower envelope composed with the verified rational carry mechanism.

declarations.name: supportCoeffZeroWindow_length_le_logb_divisorSubpower
declarations.signature: theorem supportCoeffZeroWindow_length_le_logb_divisorSubpower (A : Set ℕ) (hA : ∃ a : ℕ, 0 < a ∧ a ∈ A) (p : ℤ) (c v N h k : ℕ) (hv : 0 < v) (hk : 2 ≤ k) (hvalue : erdosSupportSeries 2 A = (p : ℝ) / ((2 ^ c * v : ℕ) : ℝ)) (hzero : SupportCoeffZeroWindow A (c + N) h) : (h : ℝ) ≤ (Real.logb 2 (c + N + 1 : ℝ) + Real.logb 2 ((2 * (v : ℝ) * (divisorSubpowerConst k : ℝ)) ^ k)) / ((k - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)
declarations.docstring: Parameterized fixed-`k` T11 theorem. This is the load-bearing form from which the every-`ε` statement follows.

declarations.name: supportCoeffZeroWindow_length_le_eps_logb_add
declarations.signature: theorem supportCoeffZeroWindow_length_le_eps_logb_add (A : Set ℕ) (hA : ∃ a : ℕ, 0 < a ∧ a ∈ A) (p : ℤ) (c v : ℕ) (hv : 0 < v) (hvalue : erdosSupportSeries 2 A = (p : ℝ) / ((2 ^ c * v : ℕ) : ℝ)) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) : ∃ B : ℝ, 0 ≤ B ∧ ∀ N h : ℕ, SupportCoeffZeroWindow A (c + N) h → (h : ℝ) ≤ ε * Real.logb 2 (N + 1 : ℝ) + B
declarations.docstring: **Unconditional T11.** For every positive `ε`, a rational support-series value forces every support-coefficient zero window to have length at most `ε * log₂(N+1)` plus a constant depending only on `ε`, `v`, and `c`. The bound is uniform in the support `A`, numerator `p`, starting index `N`, and window length `h`.

declarations.name: supportCoeffZeroWindow_length_le_eps_logb
declarations.signature: theorem supportCoeffZeroWindow_length_le_eps_logb (A : Set ℕ) (hA : ∃ a : ℕ, 0 < a ∧ a ∈ A) (p : ℤ) (c v : ℕ) (hv : 0 < v) (hvalue : erdosSupportSeries 2 A = (p : ℝ) / ((2 ^ c * v : ℕ) : ℝ)) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) : ∃ B : ℝ, 0 ≤ B ∧ ∀ N h : ℕ, 1 ≤ N → SupportCoeffZeroWindow A (c + N) h → (h : ℝ) ≤ ε * Real.logb 2 (N : ℝ) + B
declarations.docstring: Exact `ε * log₂ N + O(1)` form of unconditional T11 for every positive starting index.

declarations.name: SelectedHalfWindow.stepTailExplicit
declarations.signature: noncomputable def SelectedHalfWindow.stepTailExplicit {N R S C δ : ℕ} (hN : 1 ≤ N) (W : SelectedHalfWindow N R) (hSstrip : S ≤ halfStripBound (N + 1)) (hbuffer : S + C ≤ 2 * R) (hparentTail : ∀ q : ℕ, 1 ≤ q → q ≤ S → δ < parent C q) (hcoeff : ∀ k (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hkR : k ≤ R), δ < k → supportCoeff (wordSupport (W.word k hk hkR)) (N + 1) = C) : SelectedHalfWindow (N + 1) S

declarations.signature: theorem supportCoeff_eq_and_le_add_one_of_wordNumeral_eq_or_succ (m : ℕ) {N : ℕ} (lower upper : HalfWord N) : (wordSuffixNumeral lower 0 N = wordSuffixNumeral upper 0 N → supportCoeff (wordSupport lower) m = supportCoeff (wordSupport upper) m) ∧ (wordSuffixNumeral lower 0 N = wordSuffixNumeral upper 0 N + 1 → supportCoeff (wordSupport lower) m ≤ supportCoeff (wordSupport upper) m + 1)
declarations.docstring: Incrementing a fixed-length binary word can create at most one new selected divisor. The simultaneous equality clause is the induction invariant needed when the terminal increment does not carry.

declarations.name: ProfiledGapStage.lowerNextCoeff_le_upperNextCoeff_add_one
declarations.signature: theorem ProfiledGapStage.lowerNextCoeff_le_upperNextCoeff_add_one {M N : ℕ} (T : ProfiledGapStage M N) (hadjacent : T.HasAdjacentPrefixes) : supportCoeff (wordSupport T.lowerPrefix) (N + 1) ≤ supportCoeff (wordSupport T.upperPrefix) (N + 1) + 1

declarations.name: profiledGapStageOfTwoSheet_hasAdjacentPrefixes

declarations.docstring: The exact two-sheet state starts with adjacent complementary children of its common boundary prefix.

declarations.name: ProfiledGapStage.advanceOfNextCoeffProfile_hasAdjacentPrefixes
declarations.signature: theorem ProfiledGapStage.advanceOfNextCoeffProfile_hasAdjacentPrefixes {M N lowerCoeff upperCoeff : ℕ} (T : ProfiledGapStage M N) (hadjacent : T.HasAdjacentPrefixes) (hN : 1 ≤ N) (hprofile : T.HasNextCoeffProfile lowerCoeff upperCoeff) (hchildLoPos : 1 ≤ 2 * T.gapLo - lowerCoeff - 1) (hupperCoeff : upperCoeff ≤ 2 * T.gapHi) (hchildOrder : 2 * T.gapLo - lowerCoeff - 1 ≤ 2 * T.gapHi - upperCoeff) (hchildHiStrip : 2 * T.gapHi - upperCoeff ≤ halfStripBound (N + 1)) (hupperBuffer : halfStripBound (N + 1) + upperCoeff ≤ 2 * halfStripBound N) : (T.advanceOfNextCoeffProfile hN hprofile hchildLoPos hupperCoeff
declarations.docstring: A profiled fixed-cutoff successor leaves both literal prefixes unchanged, and therefore preserves their binary adjacency.

declarations.name: ProfiledGapStage.lowerNextCoeff
declarations.signature: noncomputable def ProfiledGapStage.lowerNextCoeff {M N : ℕ} (T : ProfiledGapStage M N) : ℕ
declarations.docstring: The lower-sheet coefficient forced by the retained literal prefix at the next row.

declarations.name: ProfiledGapStage.upperNextCoeff
declarations.signature: noncomputable def ProfiledGapStage.upperNextCoeff {M N : ℕ} (T : ProfiledGapStage M N) : ℕ
declarations.docstring: The upper-sheet coefficient forced by the retained literal prefix at the next row.

declarations.name: ProfiledGapStage.NextArithmetic

declarations.docstring: The four non-generic inequalities required to retain both profiled sheets through the next row. Coefficient production and the divisor buffer are not fields: they follow automatically from readiness and the universal square-root envelope.

declarations.name: ProfiledGapStage.upperNextCoeff_le_two_mul_sqrt
declarations.signature: theorem ProfiledGapStage.upperNextCoeff_le_two_mul_sqrt {M N : ℕ} (T : ProfiledGapStage M N) : T.upperNextCoeff ≤ 2 * Nat.sqrt (N + 1)

declarations.docstring: The standard inverse-parent buffer is automatic for every positive current row.

declarations.name: ProfiledGapStage.advanceOfReady

declarations.name: ProfiledGapStage.promoteCutoff_ready

declarations.docstring: The complete promote-then-advance operation preserves binary adjacency.

declarations.name: ProfiledGapStage
declarations.docstring: A finite carry gap together with independent literal prefixes for its two live suffix-cylinder sheets. The parameter `M` is the actual retained cutoff, rather than the predecessor of that cutoff. The endpoint-separation field is the invariant needed to promote the upper sheet when the cutoff reaches its next feedback boundary.

declarations.name: profiledGapStageOfTwoSheet
declarations.signature: noncomputable def profiledGapStageOfTwoSheet {K N : ℕ} (T : InStripTwoSheetStage K N) : ProfiledGapStage (K + 1) N
declarations.docstring: The exact one-hole feedback state is the initial profiled finite-gap state. Its two cutoff prefixes are the marked true/false children retained by `InStripTwoSheetStage`.

declarations.name: ProfiledGapStage.HasNextCoeffProfile
declarations.signature: def ProfiledGapStage.HasNextCoeffProfile {M N : ℕ} (T : ProfiledGapStage M N) (lowerCoeff upperCoeff : ℕ) : Prop
declarations.docstring: Per-sheet constant coefficients at the next row. Equality between the two constants is intentionally not part of this interface.

declarations.name: ProfiledGapStage.Ready
declarations.signature: def ProfiledGapStage.Ready {M N : ℕ} (_T : ProfiledGapStage M N) : Prop
declarations.docstring: The current cutoff can read the next coefficient row whenever the word depth has not passed its doubled feedback boundary.

declarations.name: ProfiledGapStage.hasNextCoeffProfile_of_ready
declarations.signature: theorem ProfiledGapStage.hasNextCoeffProfile_of_ready {M N : ℕ} (T : ProfiledGapStage M N) (hready : T.Ready) : T.HasNextCoeffProfile (supportCoeff (wordSupport T.lowerPrefix) (N + 1)) (supportCoeff (wordSupport T.upperPrefix) (N + 1))
declarations.docstring: Every ready profiled gap has an exact next-row coefficient profile, obtained from its two retained literal prefixes. This is the coefficient producer needed by an iterator; it replaces the non-iterable requirement that the two sheets have one common coefficient.

declarations.name: ProfiledGapStage.advanceOfNextCoeffProfile
declarations.signature: noncomputable def ProfiledGapStage.advanceOfNextCoeffProfile {M N lowerCoeff upperCoeff : ℕ} (T : ProfiledGapStage M N) (hN : 1 ≤ N) (hprofile : T.HasNextCoeffProfile lowerCoeff upperCoeff) (hchildLoPos : 1 ≤ 2 * T.gapLo - lowerCoeff - 1) (hupperCoeff : upperCoeff ≤ 2 * T.gapHi) (hchildOrder : 2 * T.gapLo - lowerCoeff - 1 ≤ 2 * T.gapHi - upperCoeff) (hchildHiStrip : 2 * T.gapHi - upperCoeff ≤ halfStripBound (N + 1)) (hupperBuffer : halfStripBound (N + 1) + upperCoeff ≤ 2 * halfStripBound N) : ProfiledGapStage M (N + 1)
declarations.docstring: Structure-preserving successor with independent coefficients on the two live sheets. The exact child gap is `[2*gapLo-lowerCoeff-1, 2*gapHi-upperCoeff]`; in particular, this constructor continues to apply after cutoff promotion has made the two coefficients different.

declarations.name: halfStripBound_two_mul_add_one_le_pow

declarations.docstring: The square-root protected strip at an odd feedback boundary lies below the next binary head weight.

declarations.signature: theorem selectedHalfWindowPromoteLow {M N R E : ℕ} (W : SelectedHalfWindow N R) (hM1N : M + 1 ≤ N) (pfx : HalfWord M) (hpfx : ∀ k (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hkR : k ≤ R), restrictWord ((Nat.le_succ M).trans hM1N) (W.word k hk hkR) = pfx) (hcyl : HasSuffixCylinderAt W ((Nat.le_succ M).trans hM1N) E) (hbelow : E ≤ 2 ^ (N - (M + 1))) : HasSuffixCylinderAt W hM1N E ∧ ∀ k (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hkR : k ≤ R), restrictWord hM1N (W.word k hk hkR) = extendHalfWord pfx false

declarations.name: selectedHalfIntervalPromoteHigh

declarations.docstring: At an odd feedback boundary, promote both live sheets of a profiled gap through the next cutoff bit. The gap and selected families are unchanged; only their extracted literal prefixes and the upper suffix endpoint are renormalized.

declarations.name: wordSuffixNumeral_extendHalfWord_false_zero

declarations.name: wordSuffixNumeral_extendHalfWord_true_zero

declarations.name: ProfiledGapStage.promoteCutoff
declarations.signature: noncomputable def ProfiledGapStage.promoteCutoff {M N : ℕ} (T : ProfiledGapStage M N) (hM : 4 ≤ M) (hboundary : N = 2 * M + 1) : ProfiledGapStage (M + 1) N
declarations.docstring: Type-namespace adapter for the cutoff-promotion implementation.

declarations.name: ProfiledGapStage.promoteCutoff_hasAdjacentPrefixes
declarations.signature: theorem ProfiledGapStage.promoteCutoff_hasAdjacentPrefixes {M N : ℕ} (T : ProfiledGapStage M N) (hadjacent : T.HasAdjacentPrefixes) (hM : 4 ≤ M) (hboundary : N = 2 * M + 1) : (T.promoteCutoff hM hboundary).HasAdjacentPrefixes
declarations.docstring: The low-false/high-true cutoff promotion preserves the binary boundary between the two profiled sheets.

declarations.name: ProfiledGapStage.lowerTop_suffixNumeral_eq_zero

declarations.name: ProfiledGapStage.upperBottom_suffixNumeral_eq_pow_sub_one

declarations.name: ProfiledGapStage.boundaryWordsAdjacent
declarations.signature: theorem ProfiledGapStage.boundaryWordsAdjacent {M N : ℕ} (T : ProfiledGapStage M N) (hadjacent : T.HasAdjacentPrefixes) (hlowerNonempty : 2 ≤ T.gapLo) (hupperNonempty : T.gapHi < halfStripBound N) : wordSuffixNumeral (T.lower.word (T.gapLo - 1) (by omega) (le_refl _)) 0 N = wordSuffixNumeral (T.upper.word (T.gapHi + 1) (le_refl _) (by omega)) 0 N + 1

declarations.name: LowerParentSurvives

declarations.docstring: Some target carry in `1,...,B` has its canonical `c`-parent in the upper parent interval `b+1,...,R`.

declarations.name: trackedParentSurvives_iff
declarations.signature: theorem trackedParentSurvives_iff {a b R lowerCoeff upperCoeff nextBound : ℕ} (hB : 1 ≤ nextBound) (hbuffer : nextBound + upperCoeff ≤ 2 * R) : TrackedParentSurvives a b R lowerCoeff upperCoeff nextBound ↔ lowerCoeff + 3 ≤ 2 * a ∨ 2 * b + 1 ≤ nextBound + upperCoeff

declarations.name: not_trackedParentSurvives_iff
declarations.signature: theorem not_trackedParentSurvives_iff {a b R lowerCoeff upperCoeff nextBound : ℕ} (hB : 1 ≤ nextBound) (hbuffer : nextBound + upperCoeff ≤ 2 * R) : ¬ TrackedParentSurvives a b R lowerCoeff upperCoeff nextBound ↔ 2 * a ≤ lowerCoeff + 2 ∧ nextBound + upperCoeff ≤ 2 * b

declarations.docstring: A two-sheet stage always contains a terminal-only witness. Its sole missing carry cannot delete both `1` and `2`, and both lie in every half strip. This consumes the operational in-strip object directly, without projecting through the legacy protected `3..27` interface.

declarations.name: CylinderStage.halfTerminalOnlyStripWitness_after_operational_feedback

declarations.docstring: **Operational feedback-row terminal consumer.** The exact two-output feedback theorem already gives a terminal-only witness at the next row: either the full cylinder advances, or the retained two sheets contain one of the carries `1` and `2`. In particular no lower bound such as `27 ≤ halfStripBound (N + 1)` is needed.

declarations.name: CylinderStage.halfTerminalOnlyStripWitness_after_feedback

declarations.docstring: **Feedback-row terminal consumer.** At an exact half-divisor horizon, the total suffix-cylinder feedback theorem produces a terminal-only witness at the next row in both cases: either the full cylinder advances, or its localized one-hole seam supplies a surviving terminal state.

declarations.name: ProfiledGapStage.halfTerminalOnlyStripWitness_after_trackedParentSurvives

declarations.name: commonRestrictionAt_succ_iff_endpoint_avoids_headThreshold
declarations.signature: theorem commonRestrictionAt_succ_iff_endpoint_avoids_headThreshold {K N R E : ℕ} (W : SelectedHalfWindow N R) (hK1N : K + 1 ≤ N) (hR : 1 ≤ R) (hcyl : HasSuffixCylinderAt W ((Nat.le_succ K).trans hK1N) E) : W.CommonRestrictionAt hK1N ↔ E ≤ 2 ^ (N - (K + 1)) ∨ 2 ^ (N - (K + 1)) + R ≤ E

declarations.name: commonRestrictionAt_succ_of_headThreshold_add_width_le_endpoint
declarations.signature: theorem commonRestrictionAt_succ_of_headThreshold_add_width_le_endpoint {K N R E : ℕ} (W : SelectedHalfWindow N R) (hK1N : K + 1 ≤ N) (hR : 1 ≤ R) (hcyl : HasSuffixCylinderAt W ((Nat.le_succ K).trans hK1N) E) (hmargin : 2 ^ (N - (K + 1)) + R ≤ E) : W.CommonRestrictionAt hK1N

declarations.name: promoteSuffixCylinderAt_succ_of_headThreshold_add_width_le_endpoint

declarations.name: promoteSuffixCylinderAt_succ_of_endpoint_le_headThreshold

declarations.name: OrthogonalPetalBouquet
declarations.docstring: A finite-core orthogonal petal bouquet. Every exceptional element and every ray core is absorbed by one fixed positive integer `Q`; the residual petals are nontrivial, coprime to `Q`, globally pairwise coprime, and have summable reciprocal mass. The support equation is deliberately set-valued, so duplicate bookkeeping cannot change the Boolean divisor transform.

declarations.name: SunflowerForcedSlotCarrySelection
declarations.docstring: The exact finite selector produced by the persistent-reduced-modulus argument. The first clause fixes the undamped carry slot. The second clause is the finite, natural-number form of a uniform binary-tail bound: every middle window beginning after that slot has normalized cost at most `16`. Keeping this predicate separate from `SunflowerForcedCarrySupply` records the real remaining mathematical seam. It contains no rationality hypothesis and refers directly to the genuine Boolean divisor transform `supportCoeff A`.

declarations.name: SunflowerForcedSlotTailSelection
declarations.docstring: Analytic form of the forced-slot selector. This is the statement proved directly by the orthogonal-bouquet averaging argument.

declarations.name: forcedSlotCarrySelection_of_tailSelection
declarations.signature: theorem forcedSlotCarrySelection_of_tailSelection (A : Set ℕ) (htail : SunflowerForcedSlotTailSelection A) : SunflowerForcedSlotCarrySelection A
declarations.docstring: A uniform real binary-tail bound pays every finite natural middle-window budget. This bridge keeps the analytic bouquet proof and the exact carry consumer cleanly separated.

declarations.name: sunflowerForcedCarrySupply_of_forcedSlotCarrySelection
declarations.signature: theorem sunflowerForcedCarrySupply_of_forcedSlotCarrySelection (A : Set ℕ) (hA : ∃ a : ℕ, 0 < a ∧ a ∈ A) (hselection : SunflowerForcedSlotCarrySelection A) : SunflowerForcedCarrySupply A
declarations.docstring: A forced-slot selector composes unconditionally into the landed carry supply as soon as the support has one positive member. This is the exact consumer bridge needed by the orthogonal-petal bouquet argument; in particular, no multiplicative decimation or layer-rationality transport is used. The proof chooses an explicit later scale. `param_linear_le_two_pow` absorbs the linear far-tail term, while the selector's `16 * 2^(L-K)` budget is paid by choosing `K = 16*q + 1`.

declarations.name: sunflowerForcedCarrySupply_of_orthogonalPetalBouquet
declarations.signature: theorem sunflowerForcedCarrySupply_of_orthogonalPetalBouquet {A : Set ℕ} (hB : OrthogonalPetalBouquet A) (hselection : SunflowerForcedSlotTailSelection A) : SunflowerForcedCarrySupply A
declarations.docstring: Exact bouquet composition endpoint. The sole remaining hypothesis is the analytic selector proved by the persistent-reduced-modulus averaging argument; all carry arithmetic and support positivity are discharged here.

declarations.name: irrational_erdosSupportSeries_of_orthogonalPetalBouquet
declarations.signature: theorem irrational_erdosSupportSeries_of_orthogonalPetalBouquet {A : Set ℕ} (hB : OrthogonalPetalBouquet A) (hselection : SunflowerForcedSlotTailSelection A) : Irrational (erdosSupportSeries 2 A)
declarations.docstring: Conditional headline for the bouquet lane, with the remaining selector named at exactly its mathematical boundary.

declarations.name: card_filter_dvd_progression_le_reduced
declarations.signature: theorem card_filter_dvd_progression_le_reduced (M c a Y : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a) : ((Finset.range Y).filter (fun y => a ∣ M * y + c)).card ≤ Y / (a / Nat.gcd a M) + 1
declarations.docstring: Divisibility along `M * y + c` occupies at most one residue class modulo the reduced modulus `a / gcd a M`. This is the valid replacement for applying the coprime progression bound when support strays share factors with the CRT frame.

declarations.name: gcd_dvd_offset_sub_of_dvd_progression
declarations.signature: theorem gcd_dvd_offset_sub_of_dvd_progression (M x a y r s : ℕ) (hframe : M ∣ x + r) (hhit : a ∣ x + y * M + s) : Nat.gcd a M ∣ s - r
declarations.docstring: If the frame step divides a distinguished slot, every later hit by a support divisor is spaced from that slot by `gcd a M`. This is the exact arithmetic source of the geometric damping in the repaired middle-window estimate.

declarations.name: gcd_le_offset_sub_of_dvd_progression
declarations.signature: theorem gcd_le_offset_sub_of_dvd_progression (M x a y r s : ℕ) (hframe : M ∣ x + r) (hhit : a ∣ x + y * M + s) (hrs : r < s) : Nat.gcd a M ≤ s - r
declarations.docstring: A nontrivial later hit cannot occur before the gcd spacing.

declarations.name: exactPrimePowerPullback
declarations.signature: def exactPrimePowerPullback (p e : ℕ) (A : Set ℕ) : Set ℕ
declarations.docstring: Support elements with exact `p`-adic exponent `e`, after removing the prime-power layer.

declarations.name: filter_range_succ_card
declarations.signature: private theorem filter_range_succ_card (P : ℕ → Prop) [DecidablePred P] (e : ℕ) : ((Finset.range (e + 1)).filter P).card = ((Finset.range e).filter P).card + if P e then 1 else 0

declarations.name: supportCoeff_prime_power_layer
declarations.signature: theorem supportCoeff_prime_power_layer (A : Set ℕ) {p e n : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (he : 0 < e) (hnp : n.Coprime p) : supportCoeff A (p ^ e * n) = supportCoeff A (p ^ (e - 1) * n) + supportCoeff (exactPrimePowerPullback p e A) n
declarations.docstring: The new divisor layer between `p^(e-1) * n` and `p^e * n` is exactly the prescribed valuation pullback, provided the residual argument is coprime to `p`.

declarations.name: supportCoeffInt_prime_power_layer
declarations.signature: theorem supportCoeffInt_prime_power_layer (A : Set ℕ) {p e n : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (he : 0 < e) (hnp : n.Coprime p) : supportCoeffInt A (p ^ e * n) - supportCoeffInt A (p ^ (e - 1) * n) = supportCoeffInt (exactPrimePowerPullback p e A) n
declarations.docstring: Integer-difference form consumed by valuation-signature operators.

declarations.name: supportCoeffInt_prime_power_layer_fixture
declarations.signature: theorem supportCoeffInt_prime_power_layer_fixture : supportCoeffInt ({8} : Set ℕ) (2 ^ 3 * 1) - supportCoeffInt ({8} : Set ℕ) (2 ^ (3 - 1) * 1) = 1
declarations.docstring: Moving-prime-power regression: the exact third `2`-adic layer of the singleton support `{8}` contributes one new divisor at residual argument `1`.

declarations.name: HalfTerminalOnlyStripWitness
declarations.docstring: A normalized finite word whose *terminal* integer half-carry is in the discrete square-root strip. There is deliberately no all-prefix admissibility hypothesis here.

declarations.name: HalfCarryCofinalTerminalOnlyStrip
declarations.docstring: Terminal-only square-root-strip witnesses exist at cofinally many depths. The `max N 1` guard makes the terminal index `M - 1` line up with the scaled-residual identity at exponent `M`.

declarations.name: zero_not_mem_wordSupport_of_terminalOnlyWitness
declarations.signature: theorem zero_not_mem_wordSupport_of_terminalOnlyWitness {M : ℕ} {a : HalfWord M} (hzero : a ⟨0, Nat.zero_lt_succ M⟩ = false) : 0 ∉ wordSupport a
declarations.docstring: The zero bit of a normalized terminal-only witness is absent from its finite support.

declarations.name: one_not_mem_wordSupport_of_terminalOnlyWitness
declarations.signature: theorem one_not_mem_wordSupport_of_terminalOnlyWitness {M : ℕ} {a : HalfWord M} (hone : ∀ h : 1 < M + 1, a ⟨1, h⟩ = false) : 1 ∉ wordSupport a
declarations.docstring: The exponent-one bit of a normalized terminal-only witness is absent from its finite support.

declarations.name: dist_half_erdosSupportSeries_wordSupport_le_of_terminalOnlyWitness
declarations.signature: theorem dist_half_erdosSupportSeries_wordSupport_le_of_terminalOnlyWitness {M : ℕ} (hM : 1 ≤ M) {a : HalfWord M} (hone : ∀ h : 1 < M + 1, a ⟨1, h⟩ = false) (hcarry : |(integerHalfCarry (wordSupport a) (M - 1) : ℝ)| ≤ (halfStripBound M : ℝ)) : dist (erdosSupportSeries 2 (wordSupport a)) (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ (4 * (M : ℝ) + 12) / (2 : ℝ) ^ M
declarations.docstring: Pointwise approximation estimate. A terminal-only strip witness at positive depth gives a finite support value within `(4*M + 12) / 2^M` of `1/2`. The constant combines the discrete terminal strip with the existing analytic support-coefficient-tail bound.

declarations.name: half_mem_mersenneAchievementSet_of_cofinalTerminalOnlyStrip
declarations.docstring: **Terminal-only cofinal consumer.** Cofinal square-root-strip terminal witnesses force `1/2` into the Mersenne achievement set. Unlike `exists_infinite_support_half_of_cofinalAdmissibility`, this theorem assumes neither coherent witnesses nor strip control at any earlier row.

declarations.name: exists_infinite_support_half_of_cofinalTerminalOnlyStrip
declarations.signature: theorem exists_infinite_support_half_of_cofinalTerminalOnlyStrip (hcofinal : HalfCarryCofinalTerminalOnlyStrip) : ∃ A : Set ℕ, A.Infinite ∧ erdosSupportSeries 2 A = (1 : ℝ) / 2
declarations.docstring: The terminal-only cofinal producer yields an infinite normalized support summing exactly to `1/2`. Infinitude follows from the existing odd- denominator obstruction for finite Boolean supports.

declarations.name: dist_half_erdosSupportSeries_wordSupport_le_carry_add_tail
declarations.signature: theorem dist_half_erdosSupportSeries_wordSupport_le_carry_add_tail {M : ℕ} (hM : 1 ≤ M) {a : HalfWord M} (hone : ∀ h : 1 < M + 1, a ⟨1, h⟩ = false) : dist (erdosSupportSeries 2 (wordSupport a)) (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ (|(integerHalfCarry (wordSupport a) (M - 1) : ℝ)| + (2 * Real.sqrt (M : ℝ) + 4)) / (2 : ℝ) ^ M
declarations.docstring: A terminal word is close to `1/2` by the sum of two normalized errors: its absolute terminal carry and the universal support-coefficient tail.

declarations.name: tendsto_two_sqrt_add_four_div_pow_zero
declarations.signature: theorem tendsto_two_sqrt_add_four_div_pow_zero : Tendsto (fun M : ℕ ↦ (2 * Real.sqrt (M : ℝ) + 4) / (2 : ℝ) ^ M) atTop (nhds 0)
declarations.docstring: The universal coefficient-tail envelope is negligible on the binary scale.

declarations.name: tendsto_halfStripBound_div_pow_zero
declarations.signature: theorem tendsto_halfStripBound_div_pow_zero : Tendsto (fun M : ℕ ↦ (halfStripBound M : ℝ) / (2 : ℝ) ^ M) atTop (nhds 0)
declarations.docstring: The concrete square-root strip is itself negligible on the binary scale.

declarations.name: HalfTerminalOnlyScaledVanishingSequence
declarations.docstring: The weakest sequential terminal-only producer used here. Depths tend to infinity, normalization makes every finite value an achievement-set member, and only the *scaled terminal carry* is required to vanish.

declarations.name: half_mem_mersenneAchievementSet_of_terminalScaledVanishing
declarations.docstring: **Scaled-terminal consumer.** Vanishing of the normalized terminal carry already puts `1/2` in the Mersenne achievement set.

declarations.name: exists_infinite_support_half_of_terminalScaledVanishing
declarations.signature: theorem exists_infinite_support_half_of_terminalScaledVanishing (S : HalfTerminalOnlyScaledVanishingSequence) : ∃ A : Set ℕ, A.Infinite ∧ erdosSupportSeries 2 A = (1 : ℝ) / 2
declarations.docstring: The scaled-terminal producer yields an infinite support summing exactly to `1/2`.

declarations.name: half_mem_mersenneAchievementSet_of_cofinalTerminalOnlyStrip_via_scaled
declarations.docstring: Compatibility theorem: the old square-root-strip hypothesis is a special case of the new scaled-terminal consumer.

declarations.name: threeTransportTail
declarations.docstring: The balanced four-ray tail word on multipliers `(1,2,3,6)`.

declarations.name: threeTransportDrive
declarations.docstring: The exact integer letter at boundary offset `s`.

declarations.name: threeTransportWindow
declarations.docstring: The dyadic depth-`L` boundary window.

declarations.name: threeTransportShiftedTail
declarations.signature: noncomputable def threeTransportShiftedTail (H L : ℕ) : ℝ
declarations.docstring: The shifted tail left after truncating at depth `L`.

declarations.name: threeTransportRadius
declarations.docstring: The symmetric edge radius forced by the positive and negative stencil masses: both sides have multiplier mass `4` and first moment `9`.

declarations.name: abs_threeTransportDrive_le
declarations.signature: theorem abs_threeTransportDrive_le (H s : ℕ) : |threeTransportDrive H s| ≤ (9 * H + 4 * s : ℤ)
declarations.docstring: The boundary letter itself already has the sharp elementary pointwise bound obtained by grouping the positive and negative stencil parts.

declarations.name: two_pow_mul_threeTransport_eq_window_add_shifted
declarations.signature: theorem two_pow_mul_threeTransport_eq_window_add_shifted (H L : ℕ) : (2 : ℝ) ^ L * threeTransportTail H = (threeTransportWindow H L : ℝ) + threeTransportShiftedTail H L
declarations.docstring: Exact prefix/tail split for the balanced four-ray word.

declarations.name: abs_threeTransportShiftedTail_le
declarations.signature: theorem abs_threeTransportShiftedTail_le (H L : ℕ) (hH : 1 ≤ H) : |threeTransportShiftedTail H L| ≤ (threeTransportRadius H L : ℝ)
declarations.docstring: The shifted tail lies in the sharp symmetric strip.

declarations.name: threeTransportWindow_succ
declarations.signature: theorem threeTransportWindow_succ (H L : ℕ) : threeTransportWindow H (L + 1) = 2 * threeTransportWindow H L + threeTransportDrive H (L + 1)
declarations.docstring: The boundary word is an exact input-driven doubling recurrence.

declarations.name: sharpThreeTransportCert
declarations.docstring: The exact decidable lattice-separation certificate.

declarations.name: sharpThreeTransportCert_depth_floor
declarations.signature: theorem sharpThreeTransportCert_depth_floor {H L : ℕ} (hcert : sharpThreeTransportCert H L) : (2 * threeTransportRadius H L : ℤ) < 2 ^ L
declarations.docstring: Every certificate has enough dyadic room for both excluded boundary arcs.

declarations.name: threeTransport_notMem_int_of_cert
declarations.signature: theorem threeTransport_notMem_int_of_cert {H L : ℕ} (hH : 1 ≤ H) (hcert : sharpThreeTransportCert H L) : threeTransportTail H ∉ Set.range ((↑) : ℤ → ℝ)
declarations.docstring: A sharp residue gap excludes integral three-transport curvature.

declarations.name: threeTransportTail_eq_commutator
declarations.signature: theorem threeTransportTail_eq_commutator (H : ℕ) : threeTransportTail H = ExponentOnlyTransport.threeTransportTailCommutator H
declarations.docstring: The new boundary word agrees definitionally with the earlier exponent-only transport commutator.

declarations.name: RoughnessBoundaryLatticeSupply
declarations.docstring: Arbitrarily large exact boundary certificates. This is the sole open producer socket in this module.

declarations.name: irrational_totientSeries_of_roughnessBoundaryLatticeSupply
declarations.signature: theorem irrational_totientSeries_of_roughnessBoundaryLatticeSupply (hsupply : RoughnessBoundaryLatticeSupply) : Irrational (∑' n : ℕ, (Nat.totient n : ℝ) / 2 ^ n)
declarations.docstring: The boundary-certificate supply contradicts eventual LCM-cone flatness.

declarations.name: threeTransportWindow_60_12
declarations.docstring: An exact balanced boundary word at the lcm height `H = lcm(1,…,6)`.

declarations.name: sharpThreeTransportCert_60_12
declarations.docstring: Kernel-checked finite lattice separation at `t = 6`, `H = 60`.

declarations.name: ReducedMarginSocket
declarations.signature: def ReducedMarginSocket (m A y : ℤ) : Prop
declarations.docstring: The reduced signed-margin socket: `y` lies within strict radius `A / 16` of some multiple of `m`, with the inequality kept integral.

declarations.name: not_reducedMarginSocket_midpoint
declarations.signature: theorem not_reducedMarginSocket_midpoint {r A : ℤ} (hr : 0 < r) (hA : A < 16 * r) : ¬ ReducedMarginSocket (2 * r) A r
declarations.docstring: A midpoint of a positive even lattice is outside every socket whose integral radius is strictly smaller than the midpoint distance.

declarations.name: not_reducedMarginSocket_midpoint_add_one
declarations.signature: theorem not_reducedMarginSocket_midpoint_add_one {r A : ℤ} (hr : 1 ≤ r) (hA : A < 16 * r - 16) : ¬ ReducedMarginSocket (2 * r) A (r + 1)
declarations.docstring: The successor of a midpoint is also outside when the radius is strictly smaller than its distance `r - 1` from the next lattice point.

declarations.name: reducedMarginSocket_not_decided_by_parity
declarations.signature: theorem reducedMarginSocket_not_decided_by_parity {m A : ℤ} (hmEven : Even m) (hmPos : 0 < m) (h16A : 16 < A) (hA : A < 8 * m - 16) : (∃ yHit yMiss : ℤ, Even yHit ∧ Even yMiss ∧ ReducedMarginSocket m A yHit ∧ ¬ ReducedMarginSocket m A yMiss) ∧ (∃ yHit yMiss : ℤ, Odd yHit ∧ Odd yMiss ∧ ReducedMarginSocket m A yHit ∧ ¬ ReducedMarginSocket m A yMiss)
declarations.docstring: Knowing only the parity of a reduced quotient cannot decide its margin socket. In each parity class there is both a socket hit and a socket miss. The hits are `0` and `1`. Writing the even modulus as `2*r`, the misses are the adjacent central residues `r` and `r+1`; their parities are opposite, so they cover the two classes in one order or the other.

declarations.name: powerTwo_reducedMarginSocket_not_decided_by_parity
declarations.signature: theorem powerTwo_reducedMarginSocket_not_decided_by_parity {k : ℕ} {A : ℤ} (hk : 0 < k) (h16A : 16 < A) (hA : A < 8 * (2 : ℤ) ^ k - 16) : (∃ yHit yMiss : ℤ, Even yHit ∧ Even yMiss ∧ ReducedMarginSocket ((2 : ℤ) ^ k) A yHit ∧ ¬ ReducedMarginSocket ((2 : ℤ) ^ k) A yMiss) ∧ (∃ yHit yMiss : ℤ, Odd yHit ∧ Odd yMiss ∧ ReducedMarginSocket ((2 : ℤ) ^ k) A yHit ∧ ¬ ReducedMarginSocket ((2 : ℤ) ^ k) A yMiss)
declarations.docstring: Power-of-two specialization. This is the form directly applicable to the reduced modulus `2^1198` at the canonical `t = 827` row once its margin constant is exported by the arithmetic certificate module.

declarations.name: totientOverlapFactor
declarations.docstring: The integral correction for the primes shared by `j` and `x` in the totient of the product `j*x`.

declarations.name: totient_mul_eq_overlapFactor_mul
declarations.signature: theorem totient_mul_eq_overlapFactor_mul (j x : ℕ) (hx : 0 < x) : Nat.totient (j * x) = totientOverlapFactor j x * Nat.totient x
declarations.docstring: Exact product formula with all common-prime overlap retained in an integral factor. This is the non-coprime extension of `Nat.totient_mul` needed by divisor offsets which exhaust a prime power of an LCM height.

declarations.name: relativePrimeFactors
declarations.signature: def relativePrimeFactors (j x : ℕ) : Finset ℕ
declarations.docstring: Prime factors introduced by `x`, rather than already present in `j`.

declarations.name: primeFactors_mul_eq_union_relative
declarations.signature: theorem primeFactors_mul_eq_union_relative {j x : ℕ} (hj : 0 < j) (hx : 0 < x) : (j * x).primeFactors = j.primeFactors ∪ relativePrimeFactors j x
declarations.docstring: Prime factors of a product split into the old factors and the genuinely new factors of the second input.

declarations.name: totient_mul_eq_totient_mul_relativeEulerProduct
declarations.signature: theorem totient_mul_eq_totient_mul_relativeEulerProduct (j x : ℕ) (hj : 0 < j) (hx : 0 < x) : (Nat.totient (j * x) : ℚ) = (Nat.totient j : ℚ) * (x : ℚ) * ∏ p ∈ relativePrimeFactors j x, (1 - (p : ℚ)⁻¹)
declarations.docstring: Relative Euler product in multiplication form. Equivalently, `phi(j*x) / phi(j) = x * ∏_{p|x, p∤j} (1 - 1/p)`. The multiplication form avoids a denominator in downstream ordered-field arguments while retaining exactly the same information.

declarations.name: totient_mul_div_totient_eq_relativeEulerProduct
declarations.signature: theorem totient_mul_div_totient_eq_relativeEulerProduct (j x : ℕ) (hj : 0 < j) (hx : 0 < x) : (Nat.totient (j * x) : ℚ) / Nat.totient j = (x : ℚ) * ∏ p ∈ relativePrimeFactors j x, (1 - (p : ℚ)⁻¹)
declarations.docstring: Quotient orientation of the relative Euler product.

declarations.name: relativePrimeFactors_lcmDivisor_endpoint_gt
declarations.signature: theorem relativePrimeFactors_lcmDivisor_endpoint_gt {t j q r : ℕ} (hj : j ∣ periodLcm t) (hrmem : r ∈ relativePrimeFactors j (q * (periodLcm t / j) + 1)) : t < r
declarations.docstring: Every genuinely new prime in a divisor-ray endpoint lies above the LCM cutoff. Small primes may occur in the endpoint only when they were already present in the outer divisor `j`, and the relative Euler product removes exactly those factors.

declarations.name: totientOverlapFactor_eq_totient_of_coprime
declarations.signature: theorem totientOverlapFactor_eq_totient_of_coprime {j x : ℕ} (hcop : Nat.Coprime j x) : totientOverlapFactor j x = Nat.totient j
declarations.docstring: In the coprime case the overlap factor is the familiar outer factor `phi(j)`.

declarations.name: totient_le_totientOverlapFactor
declarations.signature: theorem totient_le_totientOverlapFactor (j x : ℕ) (hx : 0 < x) : Nat.totient j ≤ totientOverlapFactor j x
declarations.docstring: Common-prime overlap can only enlarge the outer totient factor.

declarations.name: totientOverlapExcess
declarations.docstring: The nonnegative amount by which common-prime overlap enlarges the clean outer factor.

declarations.name: totientOverlapFactor_eq_totient_add_excess
declarations.signature: theorem totientOverlapFactor_eq_totient_add_excess (j x : ℕ) (hx : 0 < x) : totientOverlapFactor j x = Nat.totient j + totientOverlapExcess j x

declarations.name: exists_saturated_prime_of_overlapExcess_ne_zero
declarations.signature: theorem exists_saturated_prime_of_overlapExcess_ne_zero {H j q : ℕ} (hne : totientOverlapExcess j (q * (H / j) + 1) ≠ 0) : ∃ p : ℕ, Nat.Prime p ∧ p ∣ j ∧ ¬p ∣ H / j
declarations.docstring: A nonzero overlap excess on an LCM quotient ray is supported by a prime which is present in the offset but exhausted from the quotient.

declarations.name: lcmDivisorRayLetter
declarations.docstring: The quotient-scale letter attached to a divisor offset `j | H` on the actual diagonal. Its two overlap factors record exactly which saturated prime powers of `j` reappear in `H/j + 1` and `2*(H/j) + 1`.

declarations.name: lcmDivisorRayLetter_eq_cleanCore_add_overlapExcess
declarations.signature: theorem lcmDivisorRayLetter_eq_cleanCore_add_overlapExcess (H j : ℕ) : lcmDivisorRayLetter H j = (Nat.totient j : ℤ) * deltaTotient (H / j) (H / j + 1) + (totientOverlapExcess j (2 * (H / j) + 1) : ℤ) * Nat.totient (2 * (H / j) + 1) - (totientOverlapExcess j (H / j + 1) : ℤ) * Nat.totient (H / j + 1)
declarations.docstring: Exact signed loss decomposition of a divisor letter: the clean recursive core plus a nonnegative top-overlap deposit minus a nonnegative lower-overlap deposit. This identifies precisely what is discarded by the clean-divisor API.

declarations.name: deltaTotient_divisor_ray_eq_overlapLetter
declarations.signature: theorem deltaTotient_divisor_ray_eq_overlapLetter {H j : ℕ} (hdvd : j ∣ H) : deltaTotient H (H + j) = lcmDivisorRayLetter H j
declarations.docstring: Every divisor-offset forcing letter is an exact quotient-scale letter; unlike `deltaTotient_periodLcm_ray_split`, no cleanliness hypothesis is needed.

declarations.name: lcmDivisorRayLetter_eq_clean_delta
declarations.signature: theorem lcmDivisorRayLetter_eq_clean_delta {H j : ℕ} (hclean : ∀ p : ℕ, Nat.Prime p → p ∣ j → p ∣ (H / j)) : lcmDivisorRayLetter H j = (Nat.totient j : ℤ) * deltaTotient (H / j) (H / j + 1)
declarations.docstring: On a clean divisor the overlap factors collapse, recovering the recursive letter from `deltaTotient_periodLcm_ray_split`. Thus the overlap letter is a genuine extension of that API rather than a competing coordinate.

declarations.name: lcmRayArithmeticLetter
declarations.docstring: Actual LCM-ray letter: divisor offsets use the exact quotient-scale formula, while nondivisor offsets retain the literal totient difference.

declarations.name: lcmRayArithmeticLetter_eq_deltaTotient
declarations.signature: theorem lcmRayArithmeticLetter_eq_deltaTotient (t j : ℕ) : lcmRayArithmeticLetter t j = deltaTotient (periodLcm t) (periodLcm t + j)
declarations.docstring: The arithmetic letter is exactly the genuine totient forcing letter.

declarations.name: diagonalWindowIncrement_eq_lcmRayArithmeticLetter
declarations.signature: theorem diagonalWindowIncrement_eq_lcmRayArithmeticLetter (t j : ℕ) : diagonalWindowIncrement t j = lcmRayArithmeticLetter t j
declarations.docstring: The literal diagonal increment and the arithmetic LCM-ray letter are the same integer. Keeping this bridge named avoids reopening the endpoint addition normalization whenever a cocycle identity is combined with the divisor/prime-power arithmetic of `lcmRayArithmeticLetter`.

declarations.name: totient_dvd_lcmRayArithmeticLetter_of_dvd
declarations.signature: theorem totient_dvd_lcmRayArithmeticLetter_of_dvd {t j : ℕ} (hjdvd : j ∣ periodLcm t) : (Nat.totient j : ℤ) ∣ lcmRayArithmeticLetter t j
declarations.docstring: A divisor offset contributes a forcing letter divisible by its own totient. Both endpoints are multiples of the offset, so monotonicity of Euler's totient under divisibility applies before taking their difference.

declarations.name: even_short_offset_dvd_periodLcm_pow_two
declarations.signature: theorem even_short_offset_dvd_periodLcm_pow_two {a j : ℕ} (hjpos : 0 < j) (hjeven : Even j) (hjlt : j < 2 * 2 ^ a) : j ∣ periodLcm (2 ^ a)
declarations.docstring: Every positive even offset in the dyadic short window already divides the LCM height. A missing short offset would be a prime power above `2^a`; evenness forces its prime base to be two, contradicting the upper edge of the same window.

declarations.name: totient_dvd_lcmRayArithmeticLetter_of_even_short_pow_two
declarations.signature: theorem totient_dvd_lcmRayArithmeticLetter_of_even_short_pow_two {a j : ℕ} (hjpos : 0 < j) (hjeven : Even j) (hjlt : j < 2 * 2 ^ a) : (Nat.totient j : ℤ) ∣ lcmRayArithmeticLetter (2 ^ a) j
declarations.docstring: Consequently every positive even short-window letter carries the exact factor `φ(j)`. In particular this applies to the even terminal offset `j = 2*q+2` in the odd-rank carry corridor.

declarations.name: lcmRayArithmeticLetter_divisor_or_primePower
declarations.signature: theorem lcmRayArithmeticLetter_divisor_or_primePower {t j : ℕ} (hjpos : 0 < j) (hjlt : j < 2 * t) : (j ∣ periodLcm t ∧ lcmRayArithmeticLetter t j = lcmDivisorRayLetter (periodLcm t) j) ∨ ∃ p k : ℕ, Nat.Prime p ∧ j = p ^ k ∧ t < j ∧ lcmRayArithmeticLetter t j = deltaTotient (periodLcm t) (periodLcm t + j)
declarations.docstring: Below `2*t`, each arithmetic letter is either a quotient-scale divisor letter or a literal letter at a bare prime-power offset above `t`. This is the exact divisor/foreign dichotomy for the short actual-LCM window.

declarations.name: foreignPrimePower_predecessor_dvd_periodLcm
declarations.signature: theorem foreignPrimePower_predecessor_dvd_periodLcm {t p k : ℕ} (hp : Nat.Prime p) (hk : 0 < k) (hlt : p ^ k < 2 * t) (hnd : ¬p ^ k ∣ periodLcm t) : p ^ (k - 1) ∣ periodLcm t ∧ ¬p ∣ periodLcm t / p ^ (k - 1)
declarations.docstring: The immediate predecessor of a short foreign prime power divides the LCM height, but the next copy of its prime does not survive in the quotient.

declarations.name: foreignPrimePower_predecessor_endpoint_primeFactors_gt
declarations.signature: theorem foreignPrimePower_predecessor_endpoint_primeFactors_gt {t p k u r : ℕ} (hp : Nat.Prime p) (hk : 0 < k) (hlt : p ^ k < 2 * t) (hnd : ¬p ^ k ∣ periodLcm t) (hup : Nat.Coprime u p) (hr : Nat.Prime r) (hrdvd : r ∣ u * (periodLcm t / p ^ (k - 1)) + p) : t < r
declarations.docstring: After a foreign prime power is divided by its saturated predecessor, every prime factor of either coprime ray endpoint lies above the original LCM cutoff. The multiplier `u` is later specialized to `1` and `2`.

declarations.name: lcmPrimePowerPredecessorLetter
declarations.signature: def lcmPrimePowerPredecessorLetter (H p k : ℕ) : ℤ
declarations.docstring: Quotient-scale overlap letter for a foreign prime power after removing the predecessor power already present in the LCM height.

declarations.name: deltaTotient_foreignPrimePower_ray_eq_predecessorLetter
declarations.signature: theorem deltaTotient_foreignPrimePower_ray_eq_predecessorLetter {t p k : ℕ} (hp : Nat.Prime p) (hk : 0 < k) (hlt : p ^ k < 2 * t) (hnd : ¬p ^ k ∣ periodLcm t) : deltaTotient (periodLcm t) (periodLcm t + p ^ k) = lcmPrimePowerPredecessorLetter (periodLcm t) p k
declarations.docstring: Every short foreign prime-power letter has an exact predecessor-scale overlap formula. For `k = 1` the predecessor is `1`, so this deliberately degenerates to the literal new-prime letter; for `k ≥ 2` it is a genuine strict descent.

declarations.name: foreignPrimePower_predecessor_quotient_lt
declarations.signature: theorem foreignPrimePower_predecessor_quotient_lt {t p k : ℕ} (hp : Nat.Prime p) (hk : 2 ≤ k) (hlt : p ^ k < 2 * t) (hnd : ¬p ^ k ∣ periodLcm t) : periodLcm t / p ^ (k - 1) < periodLcm t
declarations.docstring: A higher foreign prime power really descends to a smaller LCM quotient. This leaves exponent-one primes as the only nondivisor letters with no strict quotient reduction in the short window.

declarations.name: lcmRayArithmeticLetter_divisor_or_predecessorPrimePower
declarations.signature: theorem lcmRayArithmeticLetter_divisor_or_predecessorPrimePower {t j : ℕ} (hjpos : 0 < j) (hjlt : j < 2 * t) : (j ∣ periodLcm t ∧ lcmRayArithmeticLetter t j = lcmDivisorRayLetter (periodLcm t) j) ∨ ∃ p k : ℕ, Nat.Prime p ∧ j = p ^ k ∧ t < j ∧ p ^ (k - 1) ∣ periodLcm t ∧ ¬p ∣ periodLcm t / p ^ (k - 1) ∧ lcmRayArithmeticLetter t j = lcmPrimePowerPredecessorLetter (periodLcm t) p k
declarations.docstring: Fully descended short-window classification. Divisor offsets use their quotient overlap letter; every nondivisor prime power uses its predecessor overlap letter together with the exact saturation witness.

declarations.name: newPrime_not_dvd_periodLcm
declarations.signature: theorem newPrime_not_dvd_periodLcm {t p : ℕ} (hp : Nat.Prime p) (htp : t < p) : ¬p ∣ periodLcm t
declarations.docstring: A prime strictly above the cutoff does not divide the LCM height.

declarations.name: newPrime_lcmRay_endpoint_primeFactors_gt
declarations.signature: theorem newPrime_lcmRay_endpoint_primeFactors_gt {t p q ℓ : ℕ} (hp : Nat.Prime p) (htp : t < p) (hℓ : Nat.Prime ℓ) (hℓdvd : ℓ ∣ q * periodLcm t + p) : t < ℓ
declarations.docstring: Every prime factor of a new-prime ray endpoint `q*H_t+p` lies above the LCM cutoff. This holds for every ray multiplier `q`, not only the two multipliers used by the diagonal letter.

declarations.name: one_sub_sum_le_prod_one_sub_rational
declarations.signature: theorem one_sub_sum_le_prod_one_sub_rational (s : Finset ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℚ) (hzero : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ f i) (hone : ∀ i ∈ s, f i ≤ 1) : 1 - ∑ i ∈ s, f i ≤ ∏ i ∈ s, (1 - f i)
declarations.docstring: Finite union bound in product form over the rationals.

declarations.name: rough_primeFactors_card_power_le
declarations.signature: theorem rough_primeFactors_card_power_le {t n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (hrough : ∀ r : ℕ, Nat.Prime r → r ∣ n → t < r) : (t + 1) ^ n.primeFactors.card ≤ n
declarations.docstring: If every prime factor of `n` is above `t`, then the product of the distinct factors bounds `(t+1)^omega(n)` from below.

declarations.name: totient_rational_lower_bound_of_primeFactors_gt
declarations.signature: theorem totient_rational_lower_bound_of_primeFactors_gt {t n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (hrough : ∀ r : ℕ, Nat.Prime r → r ∣ n → t < r) : (n : ℚ) * (1 - (n.primeFactors.card : ℚ) / ((t + 1 : ℕ) : ℚ)) ≤ (Nat.totient n : ℚ)
declarations.docstring: Rational Euler-product lower bound for a `t`-rough integer.
