declarations.name: rough_primeFactors_card_lt_quarter_of_lt_two_pow
declarations.signature: theorem rough_primeFactors_card_lt_quarter_of_lt_two_pow {a n : ℕ} (ha : 8 ≤ a) (hnPos : 0 < n) (hrough : ∀ r : ℕ, Nat.Prime r → r ∣ n → 2 ^ a < r) (hnPow : n < 2 ^ (2 * 2 ^ a)) : n.primeFactors.card < 2 ^ a / 4
declarations.docstring: A positive `2^a`-rough integer below `2^(2*2^a)` has fewer than one quarter as many distinct prime factors as the roughness cutoff. This is the generic counting core used by both exponent-one and predecessor letters.

declarations.name: three_quarters_mul_lt_totient_of_rough_lt_two_pow
declarations.signature: theorem three_quarters_mul_lt_totient_of_rough_lt_two_pow {a n : ℕ} (ha : 8 ≤ a) (hnPos : 0 < n) (hrough : ∀ r : ℕ, Nat.Prime r → r ∣ n → 2 ^ a < r) (hnPow : n < 2 ^ (2 * 2 ^ a)) : (3 / 4 : ℚ) * (n : ℚ) < (Nat.totient n : ℚ)
declarations.docstring: The corresponding uniform density statement: a positive `2^a`-rough integer in the same height range retains more than three quarters of its mass under Euler's totient.

declarations.name: relativePrimeFactors_card_power_le
declarations.signature: theorem relativePrimeFactors_card_power_le {t j x : ℕ} (hx : 0 < x) (hrough : ∀ r ∈ relativePrimeFactors j x, t < r) : (t + 1) ^ (relativePrimeFactors j x).card ≤ x
declarations.docstring: The product of the genuinely new prime factors of `x` is bounded by `x`. Consequently a uniform lower bound on those primes controls their cardinality exactly as in the fully rough case.

declarations.name: relativePrimeFactors_card_lt_quarter_of_lt_two_pow
declarations.signature: theorem relativePrimeFactors_card_lt_quarter_of_lt_two_pow {a j x : ℕ} (ha : 8 ≤ a) (hx : 0 < x) (hrough : ∀ r ∈ relativePrimeFactors j x, 2 ^ a < r) (hxPow : x < 2 ^ (2 * 2 ^ a)) : (relativePrimeFactors j x).card < 2 ^ a / 4
declarations.docstring: A relative prime-factor set in the actual LCM height range has fewer than one quarter as many elements as the power-of-two cutoff.

declarations.name: three_quarters_lt_relativeEulerProduct_of_lt_two_pow
declarations.signature: theorem three_quarters_lt_relativeEulerProduct_of_lt_two_pow {a j x : ℕ} (ha : 8 ≤ a) (hx : 0 < x) (hrough : ∀ r ∈ relativePrimeFactors j x, 2 ^ a < r) (hxPow : x < 2 ^ (2 * 2 ^ a)) : (3 / 4 : ℚ) < ∏ r ∈ relativePrimeFactors j x, (1 - (r : ℚ)⁻¹)
declarations.docstring: Uniform three-quarter lower bound for the relative Euler density. Only the genuinely new primes must lie above the cutoff; primes shared with the outer factor `j` are harmless because they are absent from this product.

declarations.name: two_mul_le_periodLcm_add_lt_two_pow
declarations.signature: theorem two_mul_le_periodLcm_add_lt_two_pow {a A p : ℕ} (ha : 8 ≤ a) (hA : A ≤ periodLcm (2 ^ a)) (hp : p < 2 * 2 ^ a) : 2 * A + p < 2 ^ (2 * 2 ^ a)
declarations.docstring: Every endpoint `2*A+p` below an actual power-of-two LCM height lies in the counting range used by the rough-density lemmas, provided `A ≤ H` and `p < 2*t`.

declarations.name: periodLcm_lt_four_mul_j_mul_lcmRayArithmeticLetter_divisor
declarations.signature: theorem periodLcm_lt_four_mul_j_mul_lcmRayArithmeticLetter_divisor {a j : ℕ} (ha : 8 ≤ a) (hjpos : 0 < j) (hjdvd : j ∣ periodLcm (2 ^ a)) : (periodLcm (2 ^ a) : ℤ) < 4 * (j : ℤ) * lcmRayArithmeticLetter (2 ^ a) j
declarations.docstring: Quantitative divisor-letter bound. If `H = periodLcm (2^a)` and `j ∣ H`, then `H < 4*j*c_j`. This is uniform enough to make the complete short word grow on a logarithmic-in-`t` scale.

declarations.name: lcmRayArithmeticLetter_divisor_pos
declarations.signature: theorem lcmRayArithmeticLetter_divisor_pos {a j : ℕ} (ha : 8 ≤ a) (hjpos : 0 < j) (hjdvd : j ∣ periodLcm (2 ^ a)) : 0 < lcmRayArithmeticLetter (2 ^ a) j
declarations.docstring: Every divisor-offset letter at a sufficiently large power-of-two LCM height is strictly positive. No cleanliness condition on the divisor is required.

declarations.name: lcmRayArithmeticLetter_foreignPrimePower_bracket
declarations.signature: theorem lcmRayArithmeticLetter_foreignPrimePower_bracket {a p k : ℕ} (ha : 8 ≤ a) (hp : Nat.Prime p) (hk : 2 ≤ k) (htq : 2 ^ a < p ^ k) (hqt : p ^ k < 2 * 2 ^ a) (hnd : ¬p ^ k ∣ periodLcm (2 ^ a)) : (periodLcm (2 ^ a) : ℤ) < 4 * lcmRayArithmeticLetter (2 ^ a) (p ^ k) ∧ 2 * lcmRayArithmeticLetter (2 ^ a) (p ^ k) < 5 * (periodLcm (2 ^ a) : ℤ)
declarations.docstring: Higher foreign prime powers obey the same quarter-height lower bound as the exponent-one frontier, and a uniform five-halves upper bound. The statement is integral: `H < 4*c` and `2*c < 5*H` are exactly `H/4 < c < 5*H/2` after embedding in `ℚ`.

declarations.name: newPrime_upper_endpoint_primeFactors_card_lt_quarter
declarations.signature: theorem newPrime_upper_endpoint_primeFactors_card_lt_quarter {a p : ℕ} (ha : 8 ≤ a) (hp : Nat.Prime p) (htp : 2 ^ a < p) (hpt : p < 2 * 2 ^ a) : (2 * periodLcm (2 ^ a) + p).primeFactors.card < 2 ^ a / 4
declarations.docstring: At a sufficiently large power-of-two LCM height, the upper endpoint of a new-prime letter has fewer than `t/4` distinct prime factors. The explicit threshold `a ≥ 8` is deliberately coarse but completely elementary.

declarations.name: periodLcm_lt_four_mul_lcmRayArithmeticLetter_newPrime
declarations.signature: theorem periodLcm_lt_four_mul_lcmRayArithmeticLetter_newPrime {a p : ℕ} (ha : 8 ≤ a) (hp : Nat.Prime p) (htp : 2 ^ a < p) (hpt : p < 2 * 2 ^ a) : (periodLcm (2 ^ a) : ℤ) < 4 * lcmRayArithmeticLetter (2 ^ a) p
declarations.docstring: Quantitative resolution of the actual exponent-one frontier: for `a ≥ 8`, every new-prime coefficient `c` in `(2^a,2^(a+1))` satisfies `H < 4*c`, where `H = periodLcm (2^a)`. Equivalently, `c > H/4`. The extra quarter-height margin comes from the elementary fact that the coprime divisors `t` and `t-1` have product dividing `H`. Thus `p < 2*t ≤ H`, and the rough-totient estimate `c > (3/4)*(2*H+p) - (H+p) = H/2-p/4` is greater than `H/4`.

declarations.name: quarter_periodLcm_lt_lcmRayArithmeticLetter_newPrime
declarations.signature: theorem quarter_periodLcm_lt_lcmRayArithmeticLetter_newPrime {a p : ℕ} (ha : 8 ≤ a) (hp : Nat.Prime p) (htp : 2 ^ a < p) (hpt : p < 2 * 2 ^ a) : ((periodLcm (2 ^ a) : ℚ) / 4) < (lcmRayArithmeticLetter (2 ^ a) p : ℚ)
declarations.docstring: Rationally normalized form of the quarter-height frontier bound.

declarations.name: lcmRayArithmeticLetter_newPrime_pos
declarations.signature: theorem lcmRayArithmeticLetter_newPrime_pos {a p : ℕ} (ha : 8 ≤ a) (hp : Nat.Prime p) (htp : 2 ^ a < p) (hpt : p < 2 * 2 ^ a) : 0 < lcmRayArithmeticLetter (2 ^ a) p
declarations.docstring: In particular, every actual exponent-one new-prime coefficient is strictly positive once the power-of-two height reaches `2^8`.

declarations.name: periodLcm_lt_four_mul_lcmRayArithmeticLetter_of_not_dvd
declarations.signature: theorem periodLcm_lt_four_mul_lcmRayArithmeticLetter_of_not_dvd {a j : ℕ} (ha : 8 ≤ a) (hjpos : 0 < j) (hjlt : j < 2 * 2 ^ a) (hnd : ¬j ∣ periodLcm (2 ^ a)) : (periodLcm (2 ^ a) : ℤ) < 4 * lcmRayArithmeticLetter (2 ^ a) j
declarations.docstring: Every nondivisor coefficient in the short window has the uniform quarter-height lower bound. The prime-power classification combines the higher-power predecessor estimate with the exponent-one frontier.

declarations.name: lcmRayArithmeticLetter_pos_of_lt_two_mul
declarations.signature: theorem lcmRayArithmeticLetter_pos_of_lt_two_mul {a j : ℕ} (ha : 8 ≤ a) (hjpos : 0 < j) (hjlt : j < 2 * 2 ^ a) : 0 < lcmRayArithmeticLetter (2 ^ a) j
declarations.docstring: Every coefficient in the complete short window is positive. Divisor offsets use the relative Euler product, while the sparse nondivisor complement is a prime power and is handled by the predecessor/new-prime frontier.

declarations.name: exists_pos_terminalTotient_factorization_of_actualOddHalfCorrection
declarations.signature: theorem exists_pos_terminalTotient_factorization_of_actualOddHalfCorrection {a q : ℕ} (ha : 8 ≤ a) (hshort : 2 * q + 2 < 2 * 2 ^ a) : ∃ k : ℤ, 0 < k ∧ lcmRayArithmeticLetter (2 ^ a) (2 * q + 2) = (Nat.totient (2 * q + 2) : ℤ) * k ∧ 2 * actualOddHalfCorrection a q = diagonalWindowIncrement (2 ^ a) (2 * q + 3) + diagonalWindowIncrement (2 ^ a) (2 * q + 4) - 2 * (Nat.totient (2 * q + 2) : ℤ) * k
declarations.docstring: In the short power-two window, the even initial letter in the exact three-letter half-correction formula is a *positive* multiple of its own Euler totient. This is the strongest direct factorization supplied by the new terminal divisor: it rewrites the half-correction using the two following letters and a positive arithmetic quotient, without asserting the missing state/carry anti-concentration.

declarations.name: two_mul_totient_dvd_actualOddHalfCorrection_sub_following_pair
declarations.signature: theorem two_mul_totient_dvd_actualOddHalfCorrection_sub_following_pair {a q : ℕ} (ha : 8 ≤ a) (hshort : 2 * q + 2 < 2 * 2 ^ a) : 2 * (Nat.totient (2 * q + 2) : ℤ) ∣ 2 * actualOddHalfCorrection a q - diagonalWindowIncrement (2 ^ a) (2 * q + 3) - diagonalWindowIncrement (2 ^ a) (2 * q + 4)
declarations.docstring: Divisibility-only projection of the positive terminal factorization. It constrains the actual correction relative to its two neighbouring literal letters, but deliberately makes no endpoint claim: the same middle factor cancels in the existing two-rank carry recurrence.

declarations.name: two_mul_affineStep_eq_terminal_sub_carry_add_two
declarations.signature: theorem two_mul_affineStep_eq_terminal_sub_carry_add_two {a q : ℕ} (ha : 2 ≤ a) {u z : ℤ} (hterminal : 2 * u = diagonalWindowIncrement (2 ^ a) (2 * q + 2) - carryOrbit (periodLcm (2 ^ a)) (periodLcm (2 ^ a)) z (2 * q + 1)) : 2 * (4 * u + actualOddHalfCorrection a q) = diagonalWindowIncrement (2 ^ a) (2 * q + 4) - carryOrbit (periodLcm (2 ^ a)) (periodLcm (2 ^ a)) z (2 * q + 3)
declarations.docstring: The three-letter correction formula is exactly compatible with two steps of the affine carry recurrence. Thus a terminal identity at odd rank `q` propagates to the next odd rank after the state update `u ↦ 4 * u + actualOddHalfCorrection a q`. In particular, the positive totient quotient exposed above cancels from this propagation and supplies no independent corridor-escape inequality.

declarations.name: periodLcm_lt_eight_mul_t_mul_lcmRayArithmeticLetter
declarations.signature: theorem periodLcm_lt_eight_mul_t_mul_lcmRayArithmeticLetter {a j : ℕ} (ha : 8 ≤ a) (hjpos : 0 < j) (hjlt : j < 2 * 2 ^ a) : (periodLcm (2 ^ a) : ℤ) < 8 * (2 ^ a : ℤ) * lcmRayArithmeticLetter (2 ^ a) j
declarations.docstring: Uniform quantitative lower bound for every coefficient in the complete short window. Divisor letters lose a factor `j < 2*t`; foreign prime powers retain the stronger quarter-height estimate.

declarations.name: newPrime_lcmRay_endpoints_coprime
declarations.signature: theorem newPrime_lcmRay_endpoints_coprime {t p : ℕ} (hp : Nat.Prime p) (htp : t < p) : Nat.Coprime (periodLcm t + p) (2 * periodLcm t + p)
declarations.docstring: The lower and upper endpoints belonging to a new-prime offset are coprime. Indeed their difference is the LCM height, which is coprime to the new prime.

declarations.name: lcmRayArithmeticLetter_newPrime_frontier
declarations.signature: theorem lcmRayArithmeticLetter_newPrime_frontier {t p : ℕ} (hp : Nat.Prime p) (htp : t < p) : lcmRayArithmeticLetter t p = deltaTotient (periodLcm t) (periodLcm t + p) ∧ Nat.Coprime (periodLcm t + p) (2 * periodLcm t + p) ∧ (∀ ℓ : ℕ, Nat.Prime ℓ → ℓ ∣ periodLcm t + p → t < ℓ) ∧ (∀ ℓ : ℕ, Nat.Prime ℓ → ℓ ∣ 2 * periodLcm t + p → t < ℓ)
declarations.docstring: Complete structural package for an exponent-one foreign letter. Its literal coefficient is the totient difference of two coprime integers whose prime factors all lie beyond the LCM cutoff.

declarations.name: lcmDiagonalArithmeticWord_term_divisor_or_primePower
declarations.signature: theorem lcmDiagonalArithmeticWord_term_divisor_or_primePower {t L r : ℕ} (hr : r < L) (hshort : L < 2 * t) : ((r + 1) ∣ periodLcm t ∧ lcmRayArithmeticLetter t (r + 1) = lcmDivisorRayLetter (periodLcm t) (r + 1)) ∨ ∃ p k : ℕ, Nat.Prime p ∧ r + 1 = p ^ k ∧ t < r + 1 ∧ lcmRayArithmeticLetter t (r + 1) = deltaTotient (periodLcm t) (periodLcm t + (r + 1))
declarations.docstring: Every coefficient actually used by a short arithmetic word inherits the divisor/prime-power dichotomy.

declarations.name: lcmDiagonalArithmeticWord
declarations.docstring: Binary-reversed finite word built from the quotient-scale divisor letters and the sparse prime-power complement.

declarations.name: lcmDiagonalArithmeticWord_eq_windowDiscrepancy
declarations.signature: theorem lcmDiagonalArithmeticWord_eq_windowDiscrepancy (t L : ℕ) : lcmDiagonalArithmeticWord t L = windowDiscrepancy (periodLcm t) (periodLcm t) L
declarations.docstring: Exact identification of the arithmetic word with the actual diagonal window discrepancy.

declarations.name: lcmDiagonalArithmeticWord_succ
declarations.signature: theorem lcmDiagonalArithmeticWord_succ (t L : ℕ) : lcmDiagonalArithmeticWord t (L + 1) = 2 * lcmDiagonalArithmeticWord t L + lcmRayArithmeticLetter t (L + 1)
declarations.docstring: Appending one arithmetic letter is the exact binary affine recurrence for the unreduced word.

declarations.name: two_mul_lcmDiagonalArithmeticWord_lt_succ
declarations.signature: theorem two_mul_lcmDiagonalArithmeticWord_lt_succ {a L : ℕ} (ha : 8 ≤ a) (hshort : L + 1 < 2 * 2 ^ a) : 2 * lcmDiagonalArithmeticWord (2 ^ a) L < lcmDiagonalArithmeticWord (2 ^ a) (L + 1)
declarations.docstring: Throughout the short power-of-two window, the positive appended letter makes the unreduced word grow by strictly more than doubling.

declarations.name: LcmDiagonalArithmeticKill
declarations.docstring: A finite arithmetic residue band at one LCM height.

declarations.name: lcmDiagonalArithmeticKill_iff_certifiedKill
declarations.signature: theorem lcmDiagonalArithmeticKill_iff_certifiedKill (t L : ℕ) : LcmDiagonalArithmeticKill t L ↔ certifiedKill (periodLcm t) (periodLcm t) L
declarations.docstring: The quotient-scale arithmetic band is exactly a certified kill on the actual LCM diagonal.

declarations.name: lcmDiagonalArithmeticWord_emod_eq_diagonalWindowResidue
declarations.signature: theorem lcmDiagonalArithmeticWord_emod_eq_diagonalWindowResidue (t L : ℕ) : lcmDiagonalArithmeticWord t L % 2 ^ L = diagonalWindowResidue t L
declarations.docstring: The quotient-scale arithmetic word is the same signed binary window used by `diagonalWindowResidue`. This is the exact bridge from the short-word producer to the older adjacent-suffix and fresh-loss machinery; the two surfaces differ only in which safe interval they ask the common residue to occupy.

declarations.name: lcmDiagonalArithmeticKill_iff_diagonalSymmetricResidueCert
declarations.signature: theorem lcmDiagonalArithmeticKill_iff_diagonalSymmetricResidueCert (t L : ℕ) : LcmDiagonalArithmeticKill t L ↔ diagonalSymmetricResidueCert t L
declarations.docstring: The symmetric residue surface is exactly the actual-LCM arithmetic kill; the two modules expose different names for the same modular word.

declarations.name: diagonalFreshLossResidueCert_of_lcmDiagonalArithmeticKill
declarations.signature: theorem diagonalFreshLossResidueCert_of_lcmDiagonalArithmeticKill {t L : ℕ} (hkill : LcmDiagonalArithmeticKill t L) : diagonalFreshLossResidueCert t L
declarations.docstring: The symmetric short arithmetic band is stronger than the asymmetric fresh-loss band at the same actual LCM height. Thus every arithmetic kill can be consumed directly by the adjacent-suffix/full-target proof cone.

declarations.name: actualLcmTailOrbit_notMem_int_of_arithmeticKill
declarations.signature: theorem actualLcmTailOrbit_notMem_int_of_arithmeticKill {a L : ℕ} (hkill : LcmDiagonalArithmeticKill (2 ^ a) L) : actualLcmTailOrbit a ∉ Set.range ((↑) : ℤ → ℝ)
declarations.docstring: One coefficient-arithmetic band already rules out an integer hit by the actual LCM tail orbit at that exponent.

declarations.name: PowerTwoActualLcmShortArithmeticKillSupply
declarations.docstring: Strictly stronger producer than unrestricted actual-orbit nonintegrality: certificates must occur inside the short window where every nondivisor coefficient is a prime power.

declarations.name: powerTwoActualLcmShortArithmeticKillSupply_of_oddGuardHalfWordBand
declarations.docstring: The existing odd-guard half-word producer already pays the stronger symmetric margin. Projecting that receipt here closes the routing gap from the adjacent-suffix cone to the short actual-LCM arithmetic endpoint.

declarations.name: diagonalFreshLossProjectionSupply_of_shortArithmeticKill
declarations.docstring: The cofinal short-word producer therefore also feeds the landed fresh-loss projection supply. This connects the actual-orbit route to the adjacent-suffix, jump-cocycle, and signed-margin reductions without changing the stronger short-window obligation.

declarations.name: actualLcmOrbitNonintegralitySupply_of_shortArithmeticKill
declarations.docstring: The short coefficient-arithmetic producer feeds the landed exact actual-LCM nonintegrality endpoint.

declarations.name: PowerTwoActualLcmOrbitNonintegralitySupply
declarations.docstring: Cofinal non-integrality of the actual power-two LCM-diagonal tail orbit.

declarations.name: actualLcmTailOrbit_notMem_int_of_irrational
declarations.signature: theorem actualLcmTailOrbit_notMem_int_of_irrational (hirr : Irrational (∑' n : ℕ, (Nat.totient n : ℝ) / 2 ^ n)) (a : ℕ) : actualLcmTailOrbit a ∉ Set.range ((↑) : ℤ → ℝ)
declarations.docstring: Irrationality makes every actual power-two LCM-diagonal tail orbit a non-integer.

declarations.name: irrational_totientSeries_iff_actualLcmOrbitNonintegralitySupply
declarations.signature: theorem irrational_totientSeries_iff_actualLcmOrbitNonintegralitySupply : Irrational (∑' n : ℕ, (Nat.totient n : ℝ) / 2 ^ n) ↔ PowerTwoActualLcmOrbitNonintegralitySupply
declarations.docstring: The exact power-two actual-LCM orbit frontier is equivalent to Erdős #249.

declarations.name: irrational_totientSeries_of_actualLcmOrbitNonintegralitySupply
declarations.signature: theorem irrational_totientSeries_of_actualLcmOrbitNonintegralitySupply (hsupply : PowerTwoActualLcmOrbitNonintegralitySupply) : Irrational (∑' n : ℕ, (Nat.totient n : ℝ) / 2 ^ n)
declarations.docstring: Cofinal actual-LCM orbit non-integrality closes the irrationality endpoint directly, without a quantitative separation hypothesis.

declarations.name: actualLcmHeight
declarations.docstring: The LCM height used by the power-two endpoint at exponent `a`.

declarations.name: actualLcmTailOrbit
declarations.docstring: The actual LCM-diagonal tail orbit at exponent `a`.

declarations.name: actualLcmRawApprox
declarations.signature: noncomputable def actualLcmRawApprox (a q : ℕ) : ℝ
declarations.docstring: The normalized unreduced raw block at odd rank `q`.

declarations.name: actualLcmRawErrorRadius
declarations.signature: noncomputable def actualLcmRawErrorRadius (a q : ℕ) : ℝ
declarations.docstring: The elementary error radius for the odd-rank raw approximation.

declarations.name: diagonalAdjacentSuffixRawBlock_eq_windowDiscrepancy_add_terminal
declarations.signature: theorem diagonalAdjacentSuffixRawBlock_eq_windowDiscrepancy_add_terminal (t m : ℕ) : diagonalAdjacentSuffixRawBlock t 0 m = windowDiscrepancy (periodLcm t) (periodLcm t) m + diagonalWindowIncrement t (m + 1)
declarations.docstring: The adjacent raw block is the diagonal window numerator plus its terminal letter.

declarations.name: actualLcmTailOrbit_eq_scaled_totientSeries_sub_prefix
declarations.signature: theorem actualLcmTailOrbit_eq_scaled_totientSeries_sub_prefix (a : ℕ) : actualLcmTailOrbit a = (2 : ℝ) ^ actualLcmHeight a * ((2 : ℝ) ^ actualLcmHeight a - 1) * (∑' n : ℕ, (Nat.totient n : ℝ) / 2 ^ n) - ((totientPrefix (2 * actualLcmHeight a) : ℝ) - (totientPrefix (actualLcmHeight a) : ℝ))
declarations.docstring: The actual LCM tail orbit is the usual integer translate of the scaled #249 series orbit.

declarations.name: actualLcmTailOrbit_sub_rawApprox_eq
declarations.signature: theorem actualLcmTailOrbit_sub_rawApprox_eq (a q : ℕ) : actualLcmTailOrbit a - actualLcmRawApprox a q = (totientTail (2 * actualLcmHeight a + (2 * q + 1) + 1) - totientTail (actualLcmHeight a + (2 * q + 1) + 1) - (diagonalWindowIncrement (2 ^ a) ((2 * q + 1) + 1) : ℝ)) / (2 : ℝ) ^ ((2 * q + 1) + 1)
declarations.docstring: Exact remainder after replacing the actual LCM tail orbit by the odd-rank raw block. The terminal raw letter occurs twice in the adjacent block, which is why it is subtracted from the once-shifted tail difference.

declarations.name: abs_actualLcmTailOrbit_sub_rawApprox_lt
declarations.signature: theorem abs_actualLcmTailOrbit_sub_rawApprox_lt (a q : ℕ) : |actualLcmTailOrbit a - actualLcmRawApprox a q| < actualLcmRawErrorRadius a q
declarations.docstring: The normalized odd-rank raw block approximates the actual LCM tail orbit with an explicit elementary error.

declarations.name: actualLcmRawApprox_eq_half_div_fourPow
declarations.signature: theorem actualLcmRawApprox_eq_half_div_fourPow {a q : ℕ} (ha : 2 ≤ a) : actualLcmRawApprox a q = ((diagonalAdjacentSuffixRawBlock (2 ^ a) 0 (2 * q + 1) / 2 : ℤ) : ℝ) / (4 : ℝ) ^ q
declarations.docstring: At a power-two endpoint, the normalized raw block is the integral raw half divided by `4^q`.

declarations.name: halfWordBandAt_of_rawApprox_integerSeparation
declarations.signature: theorem halfWordBandAt_of_rawApprox_integerSeparation {a q : ℕ} (ha : 2 ≤ a) (hq : 3 ≤ q) (hsep : ∀ z : ℤ, (1 : ℝ) / 32 ≤ |actualLcmRawApprox a q - (z : ℝ)|) : PowerTwoOddHalfWordBandAt a q
declarations.docstring: Integer separation of the normalized raw block is exactly what is needed to force the landed half-word band.

declarations.name: PowerTwoActualLcmOrbitSeparationSupply
declarations.docstring: Cofinal quantitative anti-concentration of the actual LCM tail orbit at the canonical odd ranks.

declarations.name: powerTwoActualPenultimateSignedMarginSupply_of_actualLcmOrbitSeparation
declarations.docstring: Actual LCM-orbit separation supplies the exact landed signed-margin producer.

declarations.name: irrational_totientSeries_of_actualLcmOrbitSeparationSupply
declarations.signature: theorem irrational_totientSeries_of_actualLcmOrbitSeparationSupply (hsupply : PowerTwoActualLcmOrbitSeparationSupply) : Irrational (∑' n : ℕ, (Nat.totient n : ℝ) / 2 ^ n)
declarations.docstring: The orbit-separation supply therefore closes the existing Erdős #249 endpoint.

declarations.name: actualLcmTailDiff_shift_pos
declarations.signature: theorem actualLcmTailDiff_shift_pos {a J : ℕ} (ha : 8 ≤ a) (hshort : J + (a + 6) < 2 * 2 ^ a) : 0 < totientTail (2 * periodLcm (2 ^ a) + J) - totientTail (periodLcm (2 ^ a) + J)
declarations.docstring: **Unconditional positive-sign corridor.** At a power-of-two LCM height, the true translated tail difference stays positive as long as an `a+6`-term lookahead remains inside the short arithmetic window. The first lookahead letter already contributes more than enough: its quarter-height lower bound, amplified by `2^(a+5) = 32 * 2^a`, dominates four copies of the LCM height. All remaining lookahead letters are positive, and the directed lower bound controls the untranslated infinite remainder.

declarations.name: actualLcmTailOrbit_pos
declarations.signature: theorem actualLcmTailOrbit_pos (a : ℕ) (ha : 8 ≤ a) : 0 < actualLcmTailOrbit a
declarations.docstring: The actual LCM orbit itself is the first point of the positive corridor.

declarations.name: actualLcmTailOrbit_integralRepresentative_pos
declarations.signature: theorem actualLcmTailOrbit_integralRepresentative_pos {a : ℕ} (ha : 8 ≤ a) {z : ℤ} (hz : (z : ℝ) = actualLcmTailOrbit a) : 0 < z
declarations.docstring: A true integral representative of the actual LCM tail orbit cannot be nonpositive. This is the direct sign consumer for the nonintegrality lane.

declarations.name: actualLcm_trueEndpointSurvivor_neg
declarations.signature: theorem actualLcm_trueEndpointSurvivor_neg {a J K : ℕ} (ha : 8 ≤ a) (hshort : J + K + (a + 6) < 2 * 2 ^ a) {d : ℤ} (hd : (d : ℝ) = totientTail (2 * periodLcm (2 ^ a) + J) - totientTail (periodLcm (2 ^ a) + J)) : -carryOrbit (periodLcm (2 ^ a)) (periodLcm (2 ^ a) + J) d K < 0 ∧ endpointSurvivor (periodLcm (2 ^ a)) (periodLcm (2 ^ a) + J) K (-carryOrbit (periodLcm (2 ^ a)) (periodLcm (2 ^ a) + J) d K)
declarations.docstring: **Survivor-sign consumer.** If a translated actual LCM orbit is integral at the start of the positive corridor, then at every later endpoint which still has an `a+6`-letter lookahead, the survivor supplied by the true carry is strictly negative. Thus the nonnegative true-survivor branch is eliminated; this does not assert that the finite survivor set has no nonnegative spurious elements.

declarations.name: actualLcm_integral_forces_topEdgeResidue
declarations.signature: theorem actualLcm_integral_forces_topEdgeResidue {a J K : ℕ} (ha : 8 ≤ a) (hshort : J + K + (a + 6) < 2 * 2 ^ a) {d : ℤ} (hd : (d : ℝ) = totientTail (2 * periodLcm (2 ^ a) + J) - totientTail (periodLcm (2 ^ a) + J)) (hroom : ((2 * periodLcm (2 ^ a) + J + K + 2 : ℕ) : ℤ) < (2 : ℤ) ^ K) : let H
declarations.docstring: **Exact obstruction to a sign-only modular kill.** Once the dyadic modulus is wider than the directed endpoint strip, integrality together with the positive-sign corridor does not put the discrepancy residue in the central arc. It forces the opposite: the residue is exactly the top-edge representative `2^K - carry_K`. Consequently the upper inequality required by `directedCertifiedKill` fails strictly. Any contradiction after the sign theorem therefore needs an independent arithmetic exclusion of this top boundary band; the carry reset alone merely re-encodes the persistent negative survivor.

declarations.name: lcmDiagonalArithmeticKill_two_pow_four
declarations.docstring: The first exact short-window kill, at `t = 2^4` and length `23`.

declarations.name: lcmDiagonalArithmeticKill_two_pow_six
declarations.docstring: The compressed t=64 certificate supplies the exponent-six short-window kill. This consumes `certifiedKill_diagonal_t64` and feeds both the actual orbit nonintegrality route and `PowerTwoActualLcmShortArithmeticKillSupply`.

declarations.name: actualLcmTailOrbit_four_and_six_notMem_int
declarations.signature: theorem actualLcmTailOrbit_four_and_six_notMem_int : actualLcmTailOrbit 4 ∉ Set.range ((↑) : ℤ → ℝ) ∧ actualLcmTailOrbit 6 ∉ Set.range ((↑) : ℤ → ℝ)
declarations.docstring: The two routed arithmetic kills already rule out integral actual-LCM tail orbits at exponents four and six.

declarations.name: actualLcmTailOrbit_six_notMem_int
declarations.signature: theorem actualLcmTailOrbit_six_notMem_int : actualLcmTailOrbit 6 ∉ Set.range ((↑) : ℤ → ℝ)
declarations.docstring: The new exponent-six certificate rules out the next actual-LCM tail orbit directly, reusing `actualLcmTailOrbit_notMem_int_of_arithmeticKill`.

declarations.name: powerTwoActualLcmShortArithmeticKillSupply_through_six
declarations.signature: theorem powerTwoActualLcmShortArithmeticKillSupply_through_six (a₀ : ℕ) (ha₀ : a₀ ≤ 6) : ∃ a L : ℕ, a₀ ≤ a ∧ L < 2 * 2 ^ a ∧ LcmDiagonalArithmeticKill (2 ^ a) L
declarations.docstring: The exponent-six witness extends the exact cofinal-producer shape through six; the remaining endpoint gap is now precisely the unbounded continuation beyond this finite prefix.

declarations.name: irrational_totientSeries_of_shortArithmeticKillSupply
declarations.signature: theorem irrational_totientSeries_of_shortArithmeticKillSupply (hsupply : PowerTwoActualLcmShortArithmeticKillSupply) : Irrational (∑' n : ℕ, (Nat.totient n : ℝ) / 2 ^ n)
declarations.docstring: Endpoint fan-in: a cofinal supply of the exact short arithmetic kills is already sufficient for Erdős #249.

declarations.name: centralBinom_succ_le_four_mul
declarations.signature: theorem centralBinom_succ_le_four_mul (n : ℕ) : Nat.centralBinom (n + 1) ≤ 4 * Nat.centralBinom n
declarations.docstring: One step of the central-binomial recurrence costs at most a factor of `4`. This elementary monotonic estimate lets a fixed factor-four saving in the central-binomial bound propagate through every later index.

declarations.name: four_mul_centralBinom_le_four_pow
declarations.signature: theorem four_mul_centralBinom_le_four_pow {n : ℕ} (hn : 5 ≤ n) : 4 * Nat.centralBinom n ≤ 4 ^ n
declarations.docstring: From index five onward, the central binomial coefficient saves a full factor `4` against the crude `4^n` estimate.

declarations.name: centralBinom_le_four_pow_pred
declarations.signature: theorem centralBinom_le_four_pow_pred {n : ℕ} (hn : 5 ≤ n) : Nat.centralBinom n ≤ 4 ^ (n - 1)
declarations.docstring: Equivalent exponent-saving form of `four_mul_centralBinom_le_four_pow`.

declarations.name: periodLcm_two_mul_le_periodLcm_mul_four_pow_pred
declarations.signature: theorem periodLcm_two_mul_le_periodLcm_mul_four_pow_pred {n : ℕ} (hn : 5 ≤ n) : periodLcm (2 * n) ≤ periodLcm n * 4 ^ (n - 1)
declarations.docstring: The classical LCM doubling divisibility therefore gains two exponent bits at every power-of-two doubling, once the old height is at least five.

declarations.name: linearGuardExponent_succ
declarations.signature: theorem linearGuardExponent_succ {a : ℕ} (ha : 4 ≤ a) : (2 * 2 ^ a - (2 * a + 4)) + 2 * (2 ^ a - 1) = 2 * 2 ^ (a + 1) - (2 * (a + 1) + 4)
declarations.docstring: Pure exponent arithmetic for the linear-guard induction. Keeping this small normalization out of the LCM proof prevents Presburger automation from seeing the imported arithmetic context.

declarations.name: linearGuardDepth_add_signGuard_lt
declarations.signature: theorem linearGuardDepth_add_signGuard_lt {a L m : ℕ} (ha : 14 ≤ a) (hL : L < 2 * 2 ^ a - (2 * a + 4)) (hm : m ≤ L + 11) : m + 1 + (a + 6) < 2 * 2 ^ a
declarations.docstring: Pure depth budget consumed after the logarithmic LCM estimate.

declarations.name: periodLcm_pow_two_lt_two_pow_linearGuard
declarations.signature: theorem periodLcm_pow_two_lt_two_pow_linearGuard {a : ℕ} (ha : 4 ≤ a) : periodLcm (2 ^ a) < 2 ^ (2 * 2 ^ a - (2 * a + 4))
declarations.docstring: **Linear LCM guard.** The exact base saving at `2^4`, together with the factor-four central-binomial saving, adds two guard bits at every doubling. Thus the exponent deficit is `2a+4`, rather than the constant twelve used by the earlier short-window interface.

declarations.name: oddGuardedCanonicalAdjacentSuffixDepth_powerTwo_succ_add_signGuard_lt
declarations.signature: theorem oddGuardedCanonicalAdjacentSuffixDepth_powerTwo_succ_add_signGuard_lt {a : ℕ} (ha : 14 ≤ a) : oddGuardedCanonicalAdjacentSuffixDepth (2 ^ a) + 1 + (a + 6) < 2 * 2 ^ a
declarations.docstring: At cofinal power-two scales the odd-guarded canonical depth retains the entire `a+6` lookahead required by the actual-LCM positive-sign corridor. The extra successor covers both adjacent depths produced by the half-word certificate.

declarations.name: ActualLcmTerminalDyadicStaircase
declarations.signature: def ActualLcmTerminalDyadicStaircase (a J K m : ℕ) : Prop
declarations.docstring: The terminal `m` letters of a depth-`K` actual-LCM word form a dyadic staircase when the `r`-th letter in that suffix is divisible by `2^(r+1)`. The exponents increase toward the terminal letter because its binary weight decreases toward one.

declarations.name: small_modulus_has_positive_divisible_candidate
declarations.signature: theorem small_modulus_has_positive_divisible_candidate {M B : ℤ} (hM : 0 < M) (hMB : M ≤ B) : ∃ e : ℤ, 0 < e ∧ e ≤ B ∧ M ∣ e
declarations.docstring: The sharp elementary ceiling for a zero-residue argument: when the modulus is no larger than the positive-carry strip, the modulus itself is a nonzero admissible representative.

declarations.name: two_pow_dvd_windowDiscrepancy_of_dyadicStaircase
declarations.signature: theorem two_pow_dvd_windowDiscrepancy_of_dyadicStaircase {h N m : ℕ} (hstair : ∀ r : ℕ, r < m → (2 : ℤ) ^ (r + 1) ∣ deltaTotient h (N + r + 1)) : (2 : ℤ) ^ m ∣ windowDiscrepancy h N m
declarations.docstring: A staircase of length `m` makes its complete binary word divisible by `2^m`. This is the weighted form of the staircase: the `r`-th divisibility factor and its binary place value multiply to the common exponent `m`.

declarations.name: windowDiscrepancy_add
declarations.signature: theorem windowDiscrepancy_add (h N L m : ℕ) : windowDiscrepancy h N (L + m) = (2 : ℤ) ^ m * windowDiscrepancy h N L + windowDiscrepancy h (N + L) m
declarations.docstring: Splitting a discrepancy word after `L` letters leaves the old prefix multiplied by `2^m` and a fresh length-`m` suffix.

declarations.name: two_pow_dvd_windowDiscrepancy_of_terminalDyadicStaircase
declarations.signature: theorem two_pow_dvd_windowDiscrepancy_of_terminalDyadicStaircase {h N K m : ℕ} (hmK : m ≤ K) (hstair : ∀ r : ℕ, r < m → (2 : ℤ) ^ (r + 1) ∣ deltaTotient h (N + (K - m) + r + 1)) : (2 : ℤ) ^ m ∣ windowDiscrepancy h N K
declarations.docstring: A terminal staircase annihilates the entire depth-`K` word modulo `2^m`: all earlier letters already carry the missing factor through their binary weights.

declarations.name: lcmRayArithmeticLetter_lt_directedRoom
declarations.signature: theorem lcmRayArithmeticLetter_lt_directedRoom (t j : ℕ) : lcmRayArithmeticLetter t j < ((2 * periodLcm t + j + 2 : ℕ) : ℤ)
declarations.docstring: Every actual arithmetic letter is strictly below the elementary directed room at its upper endpoint.

declarations.name: not_actualLcmTerminalDyadicStaircase_of_room
declarations.signature: theorem not_actualLcmTerminalDyadicStaircase_of_room {a J K m : ℕ} (ha : 8 ≤ a) (hshort : J + K + (a + 6) < 2 * 2 ^ a) (hwide : ((2 * periodLcm (2 ^ a) + J + K + 2 : ℕ) : ℤ) < (2 : ℤ) ^ m) : ¬ActualLcmTerminalDyadicStaircase a J K m
declarations.docstring: **Terminal-staircase no-go at the required scale.** In the positive short LCM window, the last letter of a terminal staircase is positive and strictly smaller than the carry-killing modulus. The staircase asks that it be divisible by that modulus, which is impossible. Thus the full staircase below is a useful route-pruning test, not a viable cofinal producer for the actual-LCM top edge.

declarations.name: windowDiscrepancy_emod_two_pow_eq_terminal
declarations.signature: theorem windowDiscrepancy_emod_two_pow_eq_terminal {h N K m : ℕ} (hmK : m ≤ K) : windowDiscrepancy h N K % (2 : ℤ) ^ m = windowDiscrepancy h (N + (K - m)) m % (2 : ℤ) ^ m
declarations.docstring: Modulo `2^m`, a depth-`K` discrepancy depends only on its final `m` letters. This is the non-vacuous replacement for asking every terminal letter to vanish separately.

declarations.name: certifiedKill_of_shifted_terminal
declarations.signature: theorem certifiedKill_of_shifted_terminal {h N s K : ℕ} (hcert : certifiedKill h (N + s) K) : certifiedKill h N (s + K)
declarations.docstring: A certificate at a translated terminal word lifts to the complete word. The terminal-suffix identity fixes the low residue. A residue central modulo `2^K` stays central modulo every larger dyadic modulus because both its distance from zero and its distance from the upper endpoint can only grow.

declarations.name: FirstCertifiedKill
declarations.signature: def FirstCertifiedKill (h N L : ℕ) : Prop
declarations.docstring: The least-depth certificate predicate.

declarations.name: exists_firstCertifiedKill_of_exists_certifiedKill
declarations.signature: theorem exists_firstCertifiedKill_of_exists_certifiedKill {h N : ℕ} (hexists : ∃ L : ℕ, certifiedKill h N L) : ∃ L : ℕ, FirstCertifiedKill h N L
declarations.docstring: Every nonempty certificate set has a first escape depth.

declarations.name: FirstCertifiedKill.depth_floor
declarations.signature: theorem FirstCertifiedKill.depth_floor {h N L : ℕ} (hfirst : FirstCertifiedKill h N L) : (2 * (N + h + L + 2) : ℤ) < 2 ^ L
declarations.docstring: A first escape has the same dyadic depth floor as any certificate.

declarations.name: firstCertifiedKill_long_terminal
declarations.signature: theorem firstCertifiedKill_long_terminal {h N L b : ℕ} (hfirst : FirstCertifiedKill h N L) (hscale : N + h + L + 2 < 2 ^ b) (hlong : b + 3 ≤ L) : certifiedKill h (N + (L - (b + 2))) (b + 2)
declarations.docstring: **Long first-escape compression.** Suppose depth `L` is the first certificate, while its endpoint radius is below `2^b`. If at least `b+2` letters precede the final step, then those final `b+2` letters already form a certificate at their translated base. At depth `L-1` the residue is in one of the two edge arcs. The fresh totient letter has size at most `B-2`, where `B` is the new radius. Hence the affine update lies in `[-B+2, 3B-4]` on the low arc or `[-3B+4, B-4]` after centering the high arc. The first-escape certificate chooses the only possible sign in each case. Since `2^(b+2) = 4 * 2^b > 4B`, the resulting value is already central modulo `2^(b+2)`.

declarations.name: firstCertifiedKill_terminal_min
declarations.signature: theorem firstCertifiedKill_terminal_min {h N L b : ℕ} (hfirst : FirstCertifiedKill h N L) (hscale : N + h + L + 2 < 2 ^ b) : certifiedKill h (N + (L - min L (b + 2))) (min L (b + 2))
declarations.docstring: Uniform terminal form of `firstCertifiedKill_long_terminal`. A first certificate is either already no longer than `b+2`, or its final `b+2` letters are themselves a certificate. Thus every first escape below the `2^b` endpoint scale has an equivalent translated witness whose depth is at most `b+2`.

declarations.name: FirstCertifiedKill.exists_terminal_certificate
declarations.signature: theorem FirstCertifiedKill.exists_terminal_certificate {h N L b : ℕ} (hfirst : FirstCertifiedKill h N L) (hscale : N + h + L + 2 < 2 ^ b) : ∃ s K : ℕ, s + K = L ∧ K ≤ b + 2 ∧ certifiedKill h (N + s) K
declarations.docstring: Existential compression packet for downstream arithmetic. It exposes only the translated base, the bounded terminal depth, and the exact prefix/suffix split; the potentially enormous original first depth no longer appears in the residue condition.

declarations.name: DyadicMixedGuard
declarations.docstring: The two scale-`b` guard bits of a `(b+2)`-bit residue are mixed. The intervals are exactly the binary cylinders `01` and `10`; every lower bit is left unrestricted.

declarations.name: certifiedDyadic_twoLevel_socket_or_mixed
declarations.signature: theorem certifiedDyadic_twoLevel_socket_or_mixed {A B : ℤ} {b : ℕ} (hscale : B < (2 : ℤ) ^ b) (hcert : B < A % (2 : ℤ) ^ (b + 2) ∧ A % (2 : ℤ) ^ (b + 2) < (2 : ℤ) ^ (b + 2) - B) : (B < A % (2 : ℤ) ^ (b + 1) ∧ A % (2 : ℤ) ^ (b + 1) < (2 : ℤ) ^ (b + 1) - B) ∨ DyadicMixedGuard A b
declarations.docstring: **Exact two-level dyadic dichotomy.** If a `(b+2)`-bit residue is central for a radius `B < 2^b`, then either its terminal `(b+1)`-bit residue is already central for the same radius, or its two guard bits are mixed. This is the finite socket/guard alternative; it uses no information about the lower `b` bits.

declarations.name: certifiedKill_of_dyadicMixedGuard
declarations.signature: theorem certifiedKill_of_dyadicMixedGuard {h N b : ℕ} (hscale : N + h + (b + 2) + 2 < 2 ^ b) (hguard : DyadicMixedGuard (windowDiscrepancy h N (b + 2)) b) : certifiedKill h N (b + 2)
declarations.docstring: Mixed guard bits automatically certify a `(b+2)`-word whenever the endpoint radius is below `2^b`.

declarations.name: certifiedKill_bplus2_iff_socket_or_mixed
declarations.signature: theorem certifiedKill_bplus2_iff_socket_or_mixed {h N b : ℕ} (hscale : N + h + (b + 2) + 2 < 2 ^ b) : certifiedKill h N (b + 2) ↔ certifiedKill h (N + 1) (b + 1) ∨ DyadicMixedGuard (windowDiscrepancy h N (b + 2)) b
declarations.docstring: A `(b+2)` terminal certificate is exactly a `(b+1)` socket or a mixed two-bit guard, under the natural radius scale.

declarations.name: FirstCertifiedKill.exists_socket_or_mixed
declarations.signature: theorem FirstCertifiedKill.exists_socket_or_mixed {h N L b : ℕ} (hfirst : FirstCertifiedKill h N L) (hscale : N + h + L + 2 < 2 ^ b) (hbL : b < L) : ∃ s : ℕ, certifiedKill h (N + s) (b + 1) ∨ (N + s + h + (b + 2) + 2 < 2 ^ b ∧ DyadicMixedGuard (windowDiscrepancy h (N + s) (b + 2)) b)
declarations.docstring: A first escape at its genuine bit scale produces one of the two terminal cylinders: a `(b+1)` socket, or a `(b+2)` mixed guard carrying its scale inequality.

declarations.name: GuardCylinderWitness
declarations.docstring: Exact arithmetic target left after all carry compression.

declarations.name: exists_certifiedKill_iff_guardCylinderWitness
declarations.signature: theorem exists_certifiedKill_iff_guardCylinderWitness (h N : ℕ) : (∃ L : ℕ, certifiedKill h N L) ↔ GuardCylinderWitness h N
declarations.docstring: **Guard-cylinder normal form.** Existence of a certificate at an arbitrary depth is exactly equivalent to a logarithmic terminal socket or a two-bit mixed guard. The forward direction selects the genuine bit length `b = log₂(B)+1` of the first-escape radius. The reverse direction is the terminal transport theorem.

declarations.name: ActualLcmTopEdgeResidueGap
declarations.signature: def ActualLcmTopEdgeResidueGap (a J K m : ℕ) : Prop
declarations.docstring: A one-sided actual-word gap which excludes the positive top-edge carry. Unlike total staircase annihilation, this condition merely asks the final `m`-bit residue to lie at or below the complement of the directed carry strip. By `windowDiscrepancy_emod_two_pow_eq_terminal`, it is a condition on the last `m` actual arithmetic letters alone.

declarations.name: actualLcmTopEdgeResidueGap_iff_terminal
declarations.signature: theorem actualLcmTopEdgeResidueGap_iff_terminal (a J K m : ℕ) : ActualLcmTopEdgeResidueGap a J K m ↔ m ≤ K ∧ ((2 * periodLcm (2 ^ a) + J + K + 2 : ℕ) : ℤ) < (2 : ℤ) ^ m ∧ windowDiscrepancy (periodLcm (2 ^ a)) (periodLcm (2 ^ a) + J + (K - m)) m % (2 : ℤ) ^ m ≤ (2 : ℤ) ^ m - ((2 * periodLcm (2 ^ a) + J + K + 2 : ℕ) : ℤ)
declarations.docstring: Exact terminal-suffix form of the one-sided residue gap.

declarations.name: diagonalSuffixResidue_eq_windowDiscrepancy
declarations.signature: theorem diagonalSuffixResidue_eq_windowDiscrepancy (t J m : ℕ) : diagonalSuffixResidue t J m = windowDiscrepancy (periodLcm t) (periodLcm t + J) m % 2 ^ m
declarations.docstring: The sliding-suffix residue is exactly the corresponding translated actual-LCM discrepancy word modulo its suffix modulus.

declarations.name: actualLcmTopEdgeResidueGap_or_of_adjacentSuffixMidband
declarations.signature: theorem actualLcmTopEdgeResidueGap_or_of_adjacentSuffixMidband {a m : ℕ} (hroom : ((2 * periodLcm (2 ^ a) + m + 3 : ℕ) : ℤ) < (2 : ℤ) ^ m) (hlo : ((2 * periodLcm (2 ^ a) + m + 2 : ℕ) : ℤ) ≤ diagonalAdjacentSuffixResidue (2 ^ a) 0 m) (hhi : diagonalAdjacentSuffixResidue (2 ^ a) 0 m ≤ (2 : ℤ) ^ m - ((2 * periodLcm (2 ^ a) + m + 3 : ℕ) : ℤ)) : ActualLcmTopEdgeResidueGap a 0 m m ∨ ActualLcmTopEdgeResidueGap a 0 (m + 1) m
declarations.docstring: **One-sided adjacent-gap geometry.** To obtain an upper top-edge gap at one of two adjacent depths, the circular suffix displacement need only avoid the two individual upper-edge arcs. The older symmetric certificate spends the sum of both edge widths on both sides; this theorem spends one `2H` edge on each side and asks for no lower margin at the selected depth.

declarations.name: LcmDiagonalTopEdgeGap
declarations.docstring: The corrected top-edge target on the quotient-scale arithmetic word. It retains only the upper edge of `LcmDiagonalArithmeticKill`; no positive lower margin is required.

declarations.name: actualLcmTopEdgeResidueGap_zero_self_iff_lcmDiagonalTopEdgeGap
declarations.signature: theorem actualLcmTopEdgeResidueGap_zero_self_iff_lcmDiagonalTopEdgeGap (a K : ℕ) : ActualLcmTopEdgeResidueGap a 0 K K ↔ LcmDiagonalTopEdgeGap (2 ^ a) K
declarations.docstring: At `J = 0` and full precision `m = K`, the localized gap is exactly the one-sided quotient-scale arithmetic gap.

declarations.name: lcmDiagonalTopEdgeGap_of_diagonalFreshLossResidueCert
declarations.signature: theorem lcmDiagonalTopEdgeGap_of_diagonalFreshLossResidueCert {t L : ℕ} (hcert : diagonalFreshLossResidueCert t L) : LcmDiagonalTopEdgeGap t L
declarations.docstring: The older asymmetric fresh-loss certificate is stronger than the new one-sided top-edge target: its strict upper edge gives the desired weak upper edge, while its positive lower edge forces the modulus room.

declarations.name: lcmDiagonalTopEdgeGap_of_lcmDiagonalArithmeticKill
declarations.signature: theorem lcmDiagonalTopEdgeGap_of_lcmDiagonalArithmeticKill {t L : ℕ} (hkill : LcmDiagonalArithmeticKill t L) : LcmDiagonalTopEdgeGap t L
declarations.docstring: The symmetric arithmetic kill also projects to the corrected one-sided gap.

declarations.name: actualLcmTopEdgeResidueGap_zero_self_of_diagonalSymmetricResidueCert
declarations.signature: theorem actualLcmTopEdgeResidueGap_zero_self_of_diagonalSymmetricResidueCert {a K : ℕ} (hcert : diagonalSymmetricResidueCert (2 ^ a) K) : ActualLcmTopEdgeResidueGap a 0 K K
declarations.docstring: Symmetric diagonal certificates can be consumed by the localized top-edge route without passing through the real tail first.

declarations.name: ActualLcmTerminalPuncturedDyadicStaircase
declarations.signature: def ActualLcmTerminalPuncturedDyadicStaircase (a J K m : ℕ) : Prop
declarations.docstring: A viable weakening of the impossible full staircase. Only the letters before the terminal one are annihilated at their binary places; the last letter is retained as a nonzero residue and is required to land below the top-edge carry band.

declarations.name: actualLcmTopEdgeResidueGap_of_puncturedDyadicStaircase
declarations.signature: theorem actualLcmTopEdgeResidueGap_of_puncturedDyadicStaircase {a J K m : ℕ} (ha : 8 ≤ a) (hshort : J + K + (a + 6) < 2 * 2 ^ a) (hpunc : ActualLcmTerminalPuncturedDyadicStaircase a J K m) : ActualLcmTopEdgeResidueGap a J K m
declarations.docstring: A punctured staircase produces the one-sided top-edge residue gap. The terminal arithmetic letter survives literally; every earlier suffix letter vanishes modulo `2^m` after its binary weight is included.

declarations.name: puncturedDyadicStaircase_penultimate_eq_half
declarations.signature: theorem puncturedDyadicStaircase_penultimate_eq_half {a J K m : ℕ} (ha : 8 ≤ a) (hshort : J + K + (a + 6) < 2 * 2 ^ a) (hpunc : ActualLcmTerminalPuncturedDyadicStaircase a J K m) : lcmRayArithmeticLetter (2 ^ a) (J + K - 1) = (2 : ℤ) ^ (m - 1) ∧ (2 : ℤ) ^ m < 2 * ((2 * periodLcm (2 ^ a) + J + K + 2 : ℕ) : ℤ)
declarations.docstring: The punctured route has an exact penultimate-letter cost. At the wide modulus required by the carry strip, positivity and the elementary letter upper bound force the penultimate letter to be exactly the half-turn `2^(m-1)`. In particular the modulus must be the first dyadic scale above the room bound; taking an extra bit makes even the punctured route empty.

declarations.name: actualLcmTailDiff_notMem_int_of_topEdgeResidueGap
declarations.signature: theorem actualLcmTailDiff_notMem_int_of_topEdgeResidueGap {a J K m : ℕ} (ha : 8 ≤ a) (hshort : J + K + (a + 6) < 2 * 2 ^ a) (hgap : ActualLcmTopEdgeResidueGap a J K m) : totientTail (2 * periodLcm (2 ^ a) + J) - totientTail (periodLcm (2 ^ a) + J) ∉ Set.range ((↑) : ℤ → ℝ)
declarations.docstring: **Non-vacuous localized top-edge consumer.** If a terminal dyadic residue avoids the upper carry strip at any precision `m ≤ K`, the positive actual-LCM tail difference cannot be integral. This is strictly weaker than the symmetric certified-kill band and does not demand zero residue.

declarations.name: actualLcmTailOrbit_notMem_int_of_topEdgeResidueGap
declarations.signature: theorem actualLcmTailOrbit_notMem_int_of_topEdgeResidueGap {a K m : ℕ} (ha : 8 ≤ a) (hshort : K + (a + 6) < 2 * 2 ^ a) (hgap : ActualLcmTopEdgeResidueGap a 0 K m) : actualLcmTailOrbit a ∉ Set.range ((↑) : ℤ → ℝ)
declarations.docstring: The localized residue-gap consumer at the actual orbit `J = 0`.

declarations.name: PowerTwoActualLcmTopEdgeResidueGapSupply
declarations.docstring: Cofinal supply target for the genuinely non-vacuous one-sided actual-word gap.

declarations.name: PowerTwoAdjacentSuffixMidbandSupply
declarations.docstring: The exact cofinal arithmetic socket exposed by one-sided adjacent-gap geometry. At depth `m`, the adjacent suffix displacement avoids only the two individual upper-edge arcs. The buffer is stated for the larger candidate depth `m + 1`, so either branch produced below remains inside the actual-LCM sign corridor.

declarations.name: PowerTwoOddGuardTopEdgeHalfWordBandSupply
declarations.docstring: Odd-depth half-word form of the one-sided top-edge producer. If `m = 2q+1`, the adjacent suffix residue is twice the half-word residue, and both directed edge widths divide by two to the same exact threshold `periodLcm (2^a) + q + 2`. This is substantially weaker than the older fixed `1/32` central band.

declarations.name: centeredTopEdgeBand_iff_abs
declarations.signature: theorem centeredTopEdgeBand_iff_abs {M B z : ℤ} (hM : 0 < M) (hBhalf : 2 * B ≤ M) (hz : |z| ≤ M / 2) : (B ≤ z % M ∧ z % M ≤ M - B) ↔ B ≤ |z|
declarations.docstring: A closed Euclidean band of arbitrary half-width is exactly a lower bound on the absolute value of a centered representative.

declarations.name: twice_topEdgeHalfWordThreshold_le_fourPow
declarations.signature: theorem twice_topEdgeHalfWordThreshold_le_fourPow {a q : ℕ} (ha : 2 ≤ a) (hdepth : oddGuardedCanonicalAdjacentSuffixDepth (2 ^ a) = 2 * q + 1) : 2 * ((periodLcm (2 ^ a) + q + 2 : ℕ) : ℤ) ≤ (4 : ℤ) ^ q
declarations.docstring: At the guarded canonical rank, the exact top-edge threshold fits inside the signed half-cell of the base-four half-word.

declarations.name: oddGuardTopEdgeHalfWordBand_iff_actualFinalCenteredMagnitude
declarations.signature: theorem oddGuardTopEdgeHalfWordBand_iff_actualFinalCenteredMagnitude {a q : ℕ} (ha : 2 ≤ a) (hdepth : oddGuardedCanonicalAdjacentSuffixDepth (2 ^ a) = 2 * q + 1) : let B : ℤ
declarations.docstring: Pointwise exact form of the new producer: the half-word avoids both top-edge arcs precisely when its actual centered lift has magnitude at least `periodLcm (2^a) + q + 2`.

declarations.name: oddHalfWordTopEdgeBand_iff_actualCenteredMagnitude_of_fit
declarations.signature: theorem oddHalfWordTopEdgeBand_iff_actualCenteredMagnitude_of_fit {a q : ℕ} (ha : 2 ≤ a) (B : ℤ) (hfit : 2 * B ≤ (4 : ℤ) ^ q) : (B ≤ powerTwoOddHalfCorrectionWord a q % (4 : ℤ) ^ q ∧ powerTwoOddHalfCorrectionWord a q % (4 : ℤ) ^ q ≤ (4 : ℤ) ^ q - B) ↔ B ≤ |actualOddHalfCenteredLift a q|
declarations.docstring: Arbitrary-rank version of the exact centered-state identity. The canonical-depth hypothesis is used only to prove that the requested edge width fits inside the half-cell; once that fit is supplied explicitly, the identity holds at every odd rank.

declarations.name: PowerTwoActualFinalTopEdgeMagnitudeSupply
declarations.docstring: Cofinal actual-state form of the exact top-edge half-word producer.

declarations.name: topEdgeHalfWordBandSupply_iff_actualFinalCenteredMagnitudeSupply
declarations.docstring: The exact top-edge half-word supply and the final centered-magnitude supply are equivalent, not merely one-way reductions.

declarations.name: exists_int_scaled_actualLcmTailOrbit_sub_eq
declarations.signature: theorem exists_int_scaled_actualLcmTailOrbit_sub_eq {a q : ℕ} (ha : 2 ≤ a) : ∃ k : ℤ, (2 : ℝ) ^ (2 * q + 1) * (actualLcmTailOrbit a - (k : ℝ)) = (totientTail (2 * periodLcm (2 ^ a) + (2 * q + 1)) - totientTail (periodLcm (2 ^ a) + (2 * q + 1))) - ((diagonalWindowIncrement (2 ^ a) (2 * q + 1 + 1) - 2 * actualOddHalfCenteredLift a q : ℤ) : ℝ)
declarations.docstring: The actual LCM orbit differs from an integer by one exact shifted-tail error. The integer is selected by centering the even odd-depth raw block; no integrality or half-cell-fit hypothesis is used.

declarations.name: exists_int_actualLcmTailOrbit_close_of_actualTerminalCarryCorridor
declarations.signature: theorem exists_int_actualLcmTailOrbit_close_of_actualTerminalCarryCorridor {a q : ℕ} (ha : 8 ≤ a) (hshort : 2 * q + 1 + (a + 6) < 2 * 2 ^ a) (hcorr : diagonalWindowIncrement (2 ^ a) (2 * q + 1 + 1) - ((2 * periodLcm (2 ^ a) + (2 * q + 1) + 2 : ℕ) : ℤ) < 2 * actualOddHalfCenteredLift a q ∧ 2 * actualOddHalfCenteredLift a q < diagonalWindowIncrement (2 ^ a) (2 * q + 1 + 1)) : ∃ k : ℤ, |actualLcmTailOrbit a - (k : ℝ)| < actualLcmRawErrorRadius a q
declarations.docstring: A hit in the open terminal/carry corridor gives an integer within the elementary raw-error radius of the actual LCM orbit. Thus the corridor is an exact shrinking anti-concentration target, not merely a modular band.

declarations.name: actualTerminalCarryCorridorEscape_of_actualLcmOrbitSeparation
declarations.signature: theorem actualTerminalCarryCorridorEscape_of_actualLcmOrbitSeparation {a q : ℕ} (ha : 8 ≤ a) (hshort : 2 * q + 1 + (a + 6) < 2 * 2 ^ a) (hsep : ∀ k : ℤ, actualLcmRawErrorRadius a q ≤ |actualLcmTailOrbit a - (k : ℝ)|) : 2 * actualOddHalfCenteredLift a q ≤ diagonalWindowIncrement (2 ^ a) (2 * q + 1 + 1) - ((2 * periodLcm (2 ^ a) + (2 * q + 1) + 2 : ℕ) : ℤ) ∨ diagonalWindowIncrement (2 ^ a) (2 * q + 1 + 1) ≤ 2 * actualOddHalfCenteredLift a q
declarations.docstring: Separation from every integer by the elementary raw-error radius forces escape from the open terminal/carry corridor at that rank.

declarations.name: two_mul_actualOddHalfCenteredLift_eq_terminal_sub_trueCarry
declarations.signature: theorem two_mul_actualOddHalfCenteredLift_eq_terminal_sub_trueCarry {a q : ℕ} (ha : 8 ≤ a) (hshort : 2 * q + 1 + 1 + (a + 6) < 2 * 2 ^ a) (hfit : 2 * ((periodLcm (2 ^ a) + q + 2 : ℕ) : ℤ) ≤ (4 : ℤ) ^ q) {z : ℤ} (hz : (z : ℝ) = actualLcmTailOrbit a) : 2 * actualOddHalfCenteredLift a q = diagonalWindowIncrement (2 ^ a) (2 * q + 1 + 1) - carryOrbit (periodLcm (2 ^ a)) (periodLcm (2 ^ a)) z (2 * q + 1)
declarations.docstring: If the actual LCM tail orbit is integral, then the doubled centered odd-half state is exactly the terminal arithmetic letter minus the positive true carry at the same endpoint. The half-cell fit is what turns the modular identity into an equality of integers.

declarations.name: actualLcmTailOrbit_notMem_int_of_actualTerminalCarryCorridorEscape
declarations.signature: theorem actualLcmTailOrbit_notMem_int_of_actualTerminalCarryCorridorEscape {a q : ℕ} (ha : 8 ≤ a) (hshort : 2 * q + 1 + 1 + (a + 6) < 2 * 2 ^ a) (hfit : 2 * ((periodLcm (2 ^ a) + q + 2 : ℕ) : ℤ) ≤ (4 : ℤ) ^ q) (hescape : 2 * actualOddHalfCenteredLift a q ≤ diagonalWindowIncrement (2 ^ a) (2 * q + 1 + 1) - ((2 * periodLcm (2 ^ a) + (2 * q + 1) + 2 : ℕ) : ℤ) ∨ diagonalWindowIncrement (2 ^ a) (2 * q + 1 + 1) ≤ 2 * actualOddHalfCenteredLift a q) : actualLcmTailOrbit a ∉ Set.range ((↑) : ℤ → ℝ)
declarations.docstring: Under integrality, the doubled centered state lies in the open corridor between the terminal letter minus the directed endpoint bound and the terminal letter itself. Escaping either side therefore proves exact nonintegrality at that rank.

declarations.name: actualLcmTailOrbit_notMem_int_of_actualTerminalDominance
declarations.signature: theorem actualLcmTailOrbit_notMem_int_of_actualTerminalDominance {a q : ℕ} (ha : 8 ≤ a) (hshort : 2 * q + 1 + 1 + (a + 6) < 2 * 2 ^ a) (hfit : 2 * ((periodLcm (2 ^ a) + q + 2 : ℕ) : ℤ) ≤ (4 : ℤ) ^ q) (hdom : diagonalWindowIncrement (2 ^ a) (2 * q + 1 + 1) ≤ 2 * actualOddHalfCenteredLift a q) : actualLcmTailOrbit a ∉ Set.range ((↑) : ℤ → ℝ)
declarations.docstring: A terminal letter dominated by twice the actual centered state excludes an integral actual-LCM orbit at that odd rank.

declarations.name: PowerTwoFlexibleActualTerminalCarryCorridorEscapeSupply
declarations.docstring: Cofinal supply of odd ranks whose centered state escapes the exact open terminal/carry corridor forced by an integral actual-LCM orbit.

declarations.name: PowerTwoFlexibleActualTerminalDominanceSupply
declarations.docstring: Cofinal one-sided producer exposed by the exact terminal/carry identity. Unlike the two-sided magnitude target, it only asks the centered state to dominate half of the final literal arithmetic letter.

declarations.name: flexibleActualTerminalCarryCorridorEscapeSupply_of_dominance
declarations.docstring: Terminal dominance is the upper escape branch of the exact carry corridor.

declarations.name: PowerTwoFlexibleActualTopEdgeMagnitudeSupply
declarations.docstring: Strictly weaker cofinal producer: the witness may use any odd rank whose exact top-edge threshold fits the half-cell and whose adjacent depth remains inside the actual-LCM sign corridor.

declarations.name: flexibleActualTerminalCarryCorridorEscapeSupply_of_magnitude
declarations.docstring: The two-sided centered-magnitude producer implies escape from the exact terminal/carry corridor. The positive centered branch escapes above the terminal letter; the negative branch escapes below the directed endpoint bound.

declarations.name: flexibleActualTopEdgeMagnitudeSupply_of_actualFinal
declarations.docstring: The canonical final-state producer is a special case of the flexible odd-rank producer.

declarations.name: powerTwoAdjacentSuffixMidbandSupply_of_flexibleActualTopEdgeMagnitude
declarations.docstring: An exact centered-magnitude witness at any admissible odd rank supplies the one-sided adjacent-suffix midband.

declarations.name: powerTwoAdjacentSuffixMidbandSupply_of_oddGuardTopEdgeHalfWordBand
declarations.docstring: The exact odd half-word band supplies the one-sided adjacent midband. The linear LCM guard pays the larger-depth sign buffer automatically.

declarations.name: powerTwoActualLcmTopEdgeResidueGapSupply_of_adjacentSuffixMidband
declarations.docstring: A cofinal one-sided adjacent midband gives the corrected actual-LCM top-edge supply, choosing whichever of depths `m` and `m + 1` has the upper gap.

declarations.name: powerTwoActualLcmTopEdgeResidueGapSupply_of_oddGuardHalfWordBand
declarations.docstring: The existing odd-guard half-word producer reaches the corrected top-edge supply. The new linear LCM guard is the missing quantitative link: it keeps both adjacent certificate depths inside the `a+6` sign corridor.

declarations.name: actualLcmOrbitNonintegralitySupply_of_topEdgeResidueGap
declarations.docstring: A cofinal localized top-edge gap supplies exact actual-LCM orbit nonintegrality.

declarations.name: actualLcmOrbitNonintegralitySupply_of_flexibleActualTerminalDominance
declarations.docstring: The one-sided terminal-dominance producer supplies cofinal exact nonintegrality of the actual LCM orbit.

declarations.name: actualLcmOrbitNonintegralitySupply_of_flexibleActualTerminalCarryCorridorEscape
declarations.docstring: Escaping either side of the exact terminal/carry corridor supplies cofinal nonintegrality of the actual LCM orbit.

declarations.name: irrational_totientSeries_of_topEdgeResidueGapSupply

declarations.signature: theorem irrational_totientSeries_of_adjacentSuffixMidbandSupply (hsupply : PowerTwoAdjacentSuffixMidbandSupply) : Irrational (∑' n : ℕ, (Nat.totient n : ℝ) / 2 ^ n)
declarations.docstring: Direct #249 endpoint for the weaker one-sided adjacent-suffix producer.

declarations.name: irrational_totientSeries_of_oddGuardTopEdgeHalfWordBandSupply
declarations.signature: theorem irrational_totientSeries_of_oddGuardTopEdgeHalfWordBandSupply (hsupply : PowerTwoOddGuardTopEdgeHalfWordBandSupply) : Irrational (∑' n : ℕ, (Nat.totient n : ℝ) / 2 ^ n)
declarations.docstring: Direct #249 endpoint for the exact odd half-word top-edge band.

declarations.name: irrational_totientSeries_of_actualFinalTopEdgeMagnitudeSupply
declarations.signature: theorem irrational_totientSeries_of_actualFinalTopEdgeMagnitudeSupply (hsupply : PowerTwoActualFinalTopEdgeMagnitudeSupply) : Irrational (∑' n : ℕ, (Nat.totient n : ℝ) / 2 ^ n)
declarations.docstring: Direct #249 endpoint in the exact centered actual-state formulation.

declarations.name: irrational_totientSeries_of_flexibleActualTopEdgeMagnitudeSupply
declarations.signature: theorem irrational_totientSeries_of_flexibleActualTopEdgeMagnitudeSupply (hsupply : PowerTwoFlexibleActualTopEdgeMagnitudeSupply) : Irrational (∑' n : ℕ, (Nat.totient n : ℝ) / 2 ^ n)
declarations.docstring: Direct #249 endpoint for the flexible arbitrary-odd-rank producer.

declarations.name: irrational_totientSeries_of_flexibleActualTerminalDominanceSupply
declarations.signature: theorem irrational_totientSeries_of_flexibleActualTerminalDominanceSupply (hsupply : PowerTwoFlexibleActualTerminalDominanceSupply) : Irrational (∑' n : ℕ, (Nat.totient n : ℝ) / 2 ^ n)
declarations.docstring: Direct #249 endpoint for the one-sided terminal-dominance producer.

declarations.name: irrational_totientSeries_of_flexibleActualTerminalCarryCorridorEscapeSupply
declarations.signature: theorem irrational_totientSeries_of_flexibleActualTerminalCarryCorridorEscapeSupply (hsupply : PowerTwoFlexibleActualTerminalCarryCorridorEscapeSupply) : Irrational (∑' n : ℕ, (Nat.totient n : ℝ) / 2 ^ n)
declarations.docstring: Direct #249 endpoint for the exact terminal/carry corridor-escape producer.

declarations.name: actualLcmTailDiff_notMem_int_of_terminalDyadicStaircase
declarations.signature: theorem actualLcmTailDiff_notMem_int_of_terminalDyadicStaircase {a J K m : ℕ} (ha : 8 ≤ a) (hshort : J + K + (a + 6) < 2 * 2 ^ a) (hstair : ActualLcmTerminalDyadicStaircase a J K m) (hwide : ((2 * periodLcm (2 ^ a) + J + K + 2 : ℕ) : ℤ) < (2 : ℤ) ^ m) : totientTail (2 * periodLcm (2 ^ a) + J) - totientTail (periodLcm (2 ^ a) + J) ∉ Set.range ((↑) : ℤ → ℝ)
declarations.docstring: The formal terminal-staircase implication. Its hypotheses are inconsistent by `not_actualLcmTerminalDyadicStaircase_of_room`; the theorem is retained as an explicit consumer-shaped record of the failed route. A fixed small modulus also cannot suffice, as `small_modulus_has_positive_divisible_candidate` shows.

declarations.name: actualLcmTailOrbit_notMem_int_of_terminalDyadicStaircase
declarations.signature: theorem actualLcmTailOrbit_notMem_int_of_terminalDyadicStaircase {a K m : ℕ} (ha : 8 ≤ a) (hshort : K + (a + 6) < 2 * 2 ^ a) (hstair : ActualLcmTerminalDyadicStaircase a 0 K m) (hwide : ((2 * periodLcm (2 ^ a) + K + 2 : ℕ) : ℤ) < (2 : ℤ) ^ m) : actualLcmTailOrbit a ∉ Set.range ((↑) : ℤ → ℝ)
declarations.docstring: The same producer specialized to the actual orbit at `J = 0`.

declarations.name: carryDerivative
declarations.signature: def carryDerivative (u : ℕ → ℤ) (n : ℕ) : ℤ
declarations.docstring: The discrete derivative naturally recovered from a binary carry orbit.

declarations.name: carryDerivative_eq_scaledCoeff_of_recurrence
declarations.signature: theorem carryDerivative_eq_scaledCoeff_of_recurrence {c : ℕ → ℕ} {v : ℕ} {u : ℕ → ℤ} (hrec : ∀ N : ℕ, u (N + 1) = 2 * u N - ((v * c (N + 1) : ℕ) : ℤ)) {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) : carryDerivative u n = ((v * c n : ℕ) : ℤ)
declarations.docstring: Any exact binary-orbit recurrence recovers its coefficient at every positive index through `carryDerivative`. Temperedness is not needed.

declarations.name: totient_temperedOrbit_derivative
declarations.signature: theorem totient_temperedOrbit_derivative {v : ℕ} {u : ℕ → ℤ} (hu : IsTemperedBinaryOrbit Nat.totient v u) {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) : carryDerivative u n = ((v * Nat.totient n : ℕ) : ℤ)
declarations.docstring: A tempered totient orbit recovers the scaled totient sequence through its discrete carry derivative.

declarations.name: totient_carryDerivative_coprime_mul
declarations.signature: theorem totient_carryDerivative_coprime_mul {v : ℕ} {u : ℕ → ℤ} (hu : IsTemperedBinaryOrbit Nat.totient v u) {m n : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (hn : 0 < n) (hcop : Nat.Coprime m n) : (v : ℤ) * carryDerivative u (m * n) = carryDerivative u m * carryDerivative u n
declarations.docstring: The carry derivative inherits Euler totient's multiplicativity on coprime positive arguments.

declarations.name: totient_carryDerivative_gcd_mul
declarations.signature: theorem totient_carryDerivative_gcd_mul {v : ℕ} {u : ℕ → ℤ} (hu : IsTemperedBinaryOrbit Nat.totient v u) {m n : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (hn : 0 < n) : carryDerivative u (m * n) * carryDerivative u (m.gcd n) = (m.gcd n : ℤ) * carryDerivative u m * carryDerivative u n
declarations.docstring: GCD-corrected multiplicativity of the carry derivative. Unlike the coprime specialization, this identity retains the exact non-coprime defect.

declarations.name: carryKernelSeq
declarations.signature: def carryKernelSeq (u : ℕ → ℤ) (j r : ℕ) : ℕ → ℚ
declarations.docstring: A dyadic section of an integer carry orbit, viewed over `ℚ`.

declarations.name: totient_carryKernel_diff
declarations.signature: theorem totient_carryKernel_diff {v : ℕ} {u : ℕ → ℤ} (hu : IsTemperedBinaryOrbit Nat.totient v u) {j r : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r) : (fun n => (v : ℚ) * totientKernelSeq j r n) = fun n => 2 * carryKernelSeq u j (r - 1) n - carryKernelSeq u j r n
declarations.docstring: Every positive-residue totient-kernel channel is a two-term difference of adjacent carry-kernel channels. This is the exact coefficient-to-carry bridge used by rank-transfer arguments.

declarations.name: TotientOddIndex
declarations.docstring: The odd canonical dyadic channels through levels `1,...,e`.

declarations.name: TotientCarryIndex
declarations.docstring: The full carry-section family through levels `1,...,e`.

declarations.name: canonicalTotientOddKernelFamily

declarations.docstring: The carry differences that recover the odd canonical totient channels.

declarations.signature: theorem card_totientOddIndex (e : ℕ) : Fintype.card (TotientOddIndex e) = 2 ^ e - 1
