declarations.name: eventually_zero_of_bounded_tail_normalizedVanishes
declarations.signature: theorem eventually_zero_of_bounded_tail_normalizedVanishes (C : ℕ → ℕ) (E : ℕ → ℤ) (M : ℕ) (hbound : ∀ n, C n ≤ M) (hvanish : ∀ K, ∃ N, ∀ n, N ≤ n → K * Int.natAbs (E n) < C n) : ∃ N, ∀ n, N ≤ n → E n = 0
declarations.docstring: A uniformly bounded positive tail and division-free normalized vanishing force the integral centered state to vanish eventually.

declarations.name: negativeRelativeMass
declarations.signature: noncomputable def negativeRelativeMass (C : ℕ → ℕ) (E : ℕ → ℤ) (n : ℕ) : ℝ
declarations.docstring: The normalized negative mass of an integral tail step.

declarations.name: tail_growth_le_one_add_negativeRelativeMass
declarations.signature: theorem tail_growth_le_one_add_negativeRelativeMass (C : ℕ → ℕ) (E : ℕ → ℤ) (hCpos : ∀ n, 0 < C n) (hstep : ∀ n, (C (n + 1) : ℤ) = (C n : ℤ) - E n) : ∀ n, (C (n + 1) : ℝ) ≤ C n * (1 + negativeRelativeMass C E n)
declarations.docstring: The exact update `Cₙ₊₁ = Cₙ - Eₙ` is bounded above by multiplication by `1 + negativeRelativeMass`.

declarations.name: eventually_zero_of_summable_relativeGrowth
declarations.signature: theorem eventually_zero_of_summable_relativeGrowth (C : ℕ → ℕ) (E : ℕ → ℤ) (δ : ℕ → ℝ) (hδ : ∀ n, 0 ≤ δ n) (hsum : Summable δ) (hgrowth : ∀ n, (C (n + 1) : ℝ) ≤ C n * (1 + δ n)) (hvanish : ∀ K, ∃ N, ∀ n, N ≤ n → K * Int.natAbs (E n) < C n) : ∃ N, ∀ n, N ≤ n → E n = 0
declarations.docstring: Summable nonnegative relative growth makes the integral tail eventually bounded; division-free normalized vanishing then forces eventual zero.

declarations.name: eventually_zero_of_summable_negativeRelativeMass
declarations.signature: theorem eventually_zero_of_summable_negativeRelativeMass (C : ℕ → ℕ) (E : ℕ → ℤ) (hCpos : ∀ n, 0 < C n) (hstep : ∀ n, (C (n + 1) : ℤ) = (C n : ℤ) - E n) (hvanish : ∀ K, ∃ N, ∀ n, N ≤ n → K * Int.natAbs (E n) < C n) (hsum : Summable (negativeRelativeMass C E)) : ∃ N, ∀ n, N ≤ n → E n = 0
declarations.docstring: Finite normalized negative mass forces the integral centered state to vanish eventually.

declarations.name: sylvesterNext_eventually_of_summable_negativeRelativeMass
declarations.signature: theorem sylvesterNext_eventually_of_summable_negativeRelativeMass (a D : ℕ → ℤ) (C : ℕ → ℕ) (hD : ∀ n, D (n + 1) = nextDenState (a n) (D n)) (hC : ∀ n, (C (n + 1) : ℤ) = nextTailState (a n) (D n) (C n)) (hCpos : ∀ n, 0 < C n) (hstep : ∀ n, (C (n + 1) : ℤ) = (C n : ℤ) - centeredState (a n) (D n) (C n)) (hvanish : ∀ K, ∃ N, ∀ n, N ≤ n → K * Int.natAbs (centeredState (a n) (D n) (C n)) < C n) (hsum :
declarations.docstring: Paper-facing endpoint: finite normalized negative mass forces the exact reciprocal-tail orbit to follow the Sylvester recurrence eventually.

declarations.name: mersenneLayer
declarations.docstring: The cyclotomic layer for the exact polynomial `X - 2`.

declarations.name: prime_index_dvd_pred
declarations.signature: theorem prime_index_dvd_pred {q p : ℕ} (hq : q.Prime) (hp : p.Prime) (hdiv : p ∣ mersenneLayer q) : q ∣ p - 1
declarations.docstring: A prime divisor of the prime-index Mersenne layer has exact order `q` for the residue of `2`, and hence is congruent to `1` modulo `q`.

declarations.name: mersenneLayer_orderConsumer
declarations.docstring: Exact degree-one order consumer for the polynomial `X - 2`.

declarations.name: mersenneLayer_layerSupply
declarations.docstring: Prime-index Mersenne layers are nontrivial and coprime to their index.

declarations.name: mersenneLayer_unboundedPrimeDivisorSupply
declarations.docstring: **Unconditional unbounded prime support for the exact `X - 2` layers.** For every size bound and every lower bound on the prime index, a remote prime-index Mersenne layer has a prime divisor exceeding the size bound.

declarations.name: totientBlock
declarations.docstring: The first `H` totient-tail letters at `N`, cleared by `2^H`.

declarations.name: mersenne_mul_tail_eq_block_add_diff
declarations.signature: theorem mersenne_mul_tail_eq_block_add_diff (H N : ℕ) : ((2 : ℝ) ^ H - 1) * totientTail N = (totientBlock H N : ℝ) + (totientTail (N + H) - totientTail N)
declarations.docstring: Exact finite-block identity: `(2^H-1) R_N = Q_(H,N) + (R_(N+H)-R_N)`.

declarations.name: totientBlock_succ
declarations.signature: theorem totientBlock_succ (H N : ℕ) : totientBlock H (N + 1) = 2 * totientBlock H N - ((2 : ℤ) ^ H - 1) * (Nat.totient (N + 1) : ℤ) + deltaTotient H (N + 1)
declarations.docstring: Sliding the finite Mersenne block by one obeys the same affine recurrence as the carry, up to the exact multiple `(2^H-1) * φ(N+1)`.

declarations.name: carryOrbit_modEq_neg_totientBlock_shift
declarations.signature: theorem carryOrbit_modEq_neg_totientBlock_shift {H N p : ℕ} {d : ℤ} (hpM : p ∣ 2 ^ H - 1) (hmod : Int.ModEq (p : ℤ) d (-totientBlock H N)) : ∀ i : ℕ, Int.ModEq (p : ℤ) (carryOrbit H N d i) (-totientBlock H (N + i))
declarations.docstring: The prime-filtered residue propagates at every carry depth. Thus the endpoint is simultaneously constrained modulo the Mersenne prime and, through the ordinary carry reset, modulo the relevant power of two.

declarations.name: primeBasepointFiltered_survivor_at_three_unique
declarations.signature: theorem primeBasepointFiltered_survivor_at_three_unique {H N p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hNp : N < p) (hH : H ≤ p - 1) {z w : ℤ} (hzMod : Int.ModEq (p : ℤ) z (-totientBlock H N)) (hwMod : Int.ModEq (p : ℤ) w (-totientBlock H N)) (hzSurv : |carryOrbit H N z 3| ≤ (N + H + 4 : ℤ)) (hwSurv : |carryOrbit H N w 3| ≤ (N + H + 4 : ℤ)) : z = w
declarations.docstring: **Product-modulus four-to-one collapse at a free basepoint.** Under the large-prime geometry `N < p` and `H ≤ p-1`, two states in the same prime-filtered class cannot both remain in the sharp strip through depth three. Their initial spacing is a nonzero multiple of `p`; the dyadic carry multiplies it by `8`, beyond the combined width of the two endpoint strips.

declarations.name: modulusFiltered_survivor_unique
declarations.signature: theorem modulusFiltered_survivor_unique {H N M K : ℕ} (hK : 1 ≤ K) (hM : 0 < M) {z w : ℤ} (hzMod : Int.ModEq (M : ℤ) z w) (hzSurv : |carryOrbit H N z K| ≤ (N + H + K + 1 : ℤ)) (hwSurv : |carryOrbit H N w K| ≤ (N + H + K + 1 : ℤ)) (hwidth : (N + H + K + 1 : ℤ) < (2 : ℤ) ^ (K - 1) * (M : ℤ)) : z = w
declarations.docstring: **General product-modulus spacing.** At depth `K`, two launches in one class modulo `M` are separated by a multiple of `2^K M`. Hence a strip of radius strictly below `2^(K-1) M` contains at most one surviving state. This isolates the quantitative fact behind both the clean-prime collapse and any later full-Mersenne-quotient filter.

declarations.name: PrimeFilteredCarryKill
declarations.signature: def PrimeFilteredCarryKill (H p K : ℕ) : Prop
declarations.docstring: Every denominator-compatible integer carry at a clean prime anchor must leave the exact tail strip within `K` steps. The congruence reduces the unfiltered interval of `O(p)` candidates to at most four states.

declarations.name: primeFilteredResidue
declarations.docstring: Least nonnegative representative of the denominator-forced carry class.

declarations.name: primeFiltered_candidate_eq_one_of_four
declarations.signature: theorem primeFiltered_candidate_eq_one_of_four {H p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hH : H ≤ p - 1) {z : ℤ} (hbox : |z| ≤ (p + H : ℤ)) (hmod : Int.ModEq (p : ℤ) z (-totientBlock H (p - 1))) : z = primeFilteredResidue H p - 2 * p ∨ z = primeFilteredResidue H p - p ∨ z = primeFilteredResidue H p ∨ z = primeFilteredResidue H p + p
declarations.docstring: Exact four-state normal form. If `H ≤ p-1`, every filtered candidate in the analytic initial box is one of `r-2p, r-p, r, r+p`, where `r` is the least nonnegative filtered residue.

declarations.name: primeFourCarryCandidates
declarations.signature: def primeFourCarryCandidates (H p : ℕ) : Finset ℤ
declarations.docstring: The four explicit representatives which can meet the analytic candidate box at a clean anchor.

declarations.name: primeFourCarryCandidate_modEq_residue
declarations.signature: theorem primeFourCarryCandidate_modEq_residue {H p : ℕ} {z : ℤ} (hz : z ∈ primeFourCarryCandidates H p) : Int.ModEq (p : ℤ) z (primeFilteredResidue H p)
declarations.docstring: Every one of the four explicit states has the filtered residue.

declarations.name: primeFourCarry_survivor_at_three_unique
declarations.signature: theorem primeFourCarry_survivor_at_three_unique {H p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hH : H ≤ p - 1) {z w : ℤ} (hz : z ∈ primeFourCarryCandidates H p) (hw : w ∈ primeFourCarryCandidates H p) (hzSurv : |carryOrbit H (p - 1) z 3| ≤ (p + H + 3 : ℤ)) (hwSurv : |carryOrbit H (p - 1) w 3| ≤ (p + H + 3 : ℤ)) : z = w
declarations.docstring: **Four-to-one collapse in three steps.** Two distinct filtered states cannot both survive through carry depth three. Their difference is a nonzero multiple of `p`, hence grows by a factor `8`, while both sharp analytic strips together have width less than `8p`.

declarations.name: PrimeFourCarryKill
declarations.signature: def PrimeFourCarryKill (H p K : ℕ) : Prop
declarations.docstring: Literal four-state version of the denominator-filtered carry search.

declarations.name: primeFourCarryLockedThrough
declarations.signature: def primeFourCarryLockedThrough (H p K : ℕ) : Finset ℤ
declarations.docstring: Four-state launches which stay in every sharp integer strip through depth `K`.

declarations.name: mem_primeFourCarryLockedThrough_iff
declarations.signature: theorem mem_primeFourCarryLockedThrough_iff {H p K : ℕ} {z : ℤ} : z ∈ primeFourCarryLockedThrough H p K ↔ z ∈ primeFourCarryCandidates H p ∧ |z| ≤ (p + H : ℤ) ∧ ∀ i ∈ Finset.range (K + 1), |carryOrbit H (p - 1) z i| ≤ (p + H + i : ℤ)

declarations.name: primeFourCarryKill_iff_lockedThrough_eq_empty
declarations.signature: theorem primeFourCarryKill_iff_lockedThrough_eq_empty {H p K : ℕ} : PrimeFourCarryKill H p K ↔ primeFourCarryLockedThrough H p K = ∅
declarations.docstring: A four-state kill says exactly that no four-state launch remains locked through the checked depth.

declarations.name: primeFourCarryLockedThrough_three_card_le_one
declarations.signature: theorem primeFourCarryLockedThrough_three_card_le_one {H p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hH : H ≤ p - 1) : (primeFourCarryLockedThrough H p 3).card ≤ 1
declarations.docstring: After three steps the locked-state set has cardinality at most one.

declarations.name: PrimeSingleLockedCarryKill
declarations.signature: def PrimeSingleLockedCarryKill (H p K : ℕ) : Prop
declarations.docstring: Once the first three carry steps have collapsed the four possible launches to at most one, it suffices to test only that locked state. The depth lower bound makes the reduction back to the four-state predicate lossless.

declarations.name: primeFourCarryKill_mono
declarations.signature: theorem primeFourCarryKill_mono {H p K K' : ℕ} (hKK' : K ≤ K') (hkill : PrimeFourCarryKill H p K) : PrimeFourCarryKill H p K'
declarations.docstring: Carry-kill certificates are monotone in the checked depth.

declarations.name: primeSingleLockedCarryKill_of_primeFourCarryKill
declarations.signature: theorem primeSingleLockedCarryKill_of_primeFourCarryKill {H p K : ℕ} (hK : 3 ≤ K) (hkill : PrimeFourCarryKill H p K) : PrimeSingleLockedCarryKill H p K
declarations.docstring: A four-state certificate of depth at least three kills the sole three-step locked state, if that state exists.

declarations.name: primeFourCarryKill_of_primeSingleLockedCarryKill
declarations.signature: theorem primeFourCarryKill_of_primeSingleLockedCarryKill {H p K : ℕ} (hkill : PrimeSingleLockedCarryKill H p K) : PrimeFourCarryKill H p K
declarations.docstring: Testing the state locked through depth three recovers the full four-state kill: every state omitted from the locked set already escaped in one of those first three steps.

declarations.name: primeSingleLockedCarryKill_iff_primeFourCarryKill
declarations.signature: theorem primeSingleLockedCarryKill_iff_primeFourCarryKill {H p K : ℕ} (hK : 3 ≤ K) : PrimeSingleLockedCarryKill H p K ↔ PrimeFourCarryKill H p K
declarations.docstring: At every checked depth at least three, the four-state predicate is equivalent to testing only the state which survived those first steps.

declarations.name: primeFourCarryKill_iff_primeFilteredCarryKill
declarations.signature: theorem primeFourCarryKill_iff_primeFilteredCarryKill {H p K : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hH : H ≤ p - 1) : PrimeFourCarryKill H p K ↔ PrimeFilteredCarryKill H p K
declarations.docstring: Four-state and residue-filtered certificates are equivalent at a clean size-compatible anchor.

declarations.name: tail_diff_notMem_int_of_primeFilteredCarryKill
declarations.signature: theorem tail_diff_notMem_int_of_primeFilteredCarryKill {H p K : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hkill : PrimeFilteredCarryKill H p K) (hfilter : ∀ z : ℤ, (z : ℝ) = totientTail (p - 1 + H) - totientTail (p - 1) → Int.ModEq (p : ℤ) z (-totientBlock H (p - 1))) : totientTail (p - 1 + H) - totientTail (p - 1) ∉ Set.range ((↑) : ℤ → ℝ)
declarations.docstring: Soundness of the filtered finite search, separated from the rational-denominator argument which supplies its initial congruence.

declarations.name: exists_primeFilteredCarryKill_of_tail_diff_notMem_int
declarations.signature: theorem exists_primeFilteredCarryKill_of_tail_diff_notMem_int {H p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hnon : totientTail (p - 1 + H) - totientTail (p - 1) ∉ Set.range ((↑) : ℤ → ℝ)) : ∃ K : ℕ, PrimeFilteredCarryKill H p K
declarations.docstring: Pointwise completeness of the finite carry search. If the true tail difference is not integral, no integer launch can stay forever in the sharp linear strip; finiteness of the initial candidate interval then supplies one uniform escape depth. The residue filter may only discard candidates.

declarations.name: PrimeBasepointFilteredCarryKill
declarations.signature: def PrimeBasepointFilteredCarryKill (H N p K : ℕ) : Prop
declarations.docstring: Basepoint-decoupled denominator-filtered carry search. The modulus prime need not also determine the left endpoint: this is the form needed to combine a large divisor of `2^H - 1` with an independently engineered short totient window.

declarations.name: primeBasepointFilteredLockedThrough
declarations.signature: def primeBasepointFilteredLockedThrough (H N p K : ℕ) : Finset ℕ
declarations.docstring: Prime-filtered launch indices which remain in every sharp integer strip through depth `K` at an arbitrary basepoint. Storing the indices rather than the translated integer states makes membership in the finite analytic launch interval structural.

declarations.name: mem_primeBasepointFilteredLockedThrough_iff
declarations.signature: theorem mem_primeBasepointFilteredLockedThrough_iff {H N p K j : ℕ} : j ∈ primeBasepointFilteredLockedThrough H N p K ↔ j ∈ Finset.range (2 * (N + H + 1) + 1) ∧ Int.ModEq (p : ℤ) ((j : ℤ) - (N + H + 1 : ℤ)) (-totientBlock H N) ∧ ∀ i ∈ Finset.range (K + 1), |carryOrbit H N ((j : ℤ) - (N + H + 1 : ℤ)) i| ≤ (N + H + i + 1 : ℤ)

declarations.name: primeBasepointFilteredLockedThrough_three_card_le_one
declarations.signature: theorem primeBasepointFilteredLockedThrough_three_card_le_one {H N p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hNp : N < p) (hH : H ≤ p - 1) : (primeBasepointFilteredLockedThrough H N p 3).card ≤ 1
declarations.docstring: The entire free-basepoint filtered launch interval has at most one state which survives through depth three.

declarations.name: modulusFilteredLockedThrough_three_card_le_one
declarations.signature: theorem modulusFilteredLockedThrough_three_card_le_one {H N M : ℕ} (hM : 0 < M) (hwidth : N + H + 2 < M) : (primeBasepointFilteredLockedThrough H N M 3).card ≤ 1
declarations.docstring: If a composite modulus already exceeds the initial analytic radius, the filtered launch set locked through depth three has cardinality at most one. This is the form used by the full Mersenne quotient after the odd denominator has been divided out.

declarations.name: PrimeBasepointSingleLockedCarryKill
declarations.signature: def PrimeBasepointSingleLockedCarryKill (H N p K : ℕ) : Prop
declarations.docstring: Once the full filtered interval has collapsed through depth three, the basepoint certificate needs to test only its at-most-one locked index.

declarations.name: primeBasepointFilteredCarryKill_mono
declarations.signature: theorem primeBasepointFilteredCarryKill_mono {H N p K K' : ℕ} (hKK' : K ≤ K') (hkill : PrimeBasepointFilteredCarryKill H N p K) : PrimeBasepointFilteredCarryKill H N p K'
declarations.docstring: Free-basepoint filtered certificates are monotone in the checked depth.

declarations.name: primeBasepointSingleLockedCarryKill_of_filtered
declarations.signature: theorem primeBasepointSingleLockedCarryKill_of_filtered {H N p K : ℕ} (hK : 3 ≤ K) (hkill : PrimeBasepointFilteredCarryKill H N p K) : PrimeBasepointSingleLockedCarryKill H N p K
declarations.docstring: A full free-basepoint certificate of depth at least three kills the sole three-step locked state, if it exists.

declarations.name: primeBasepointFilteredCarryKill_of_singleLocked
declarations.signature: theorem primeBasepointFilteredCarryKill_of_singleLocked {H N p K : ℕ} (hkill : PrimeBasepointSingleLockedCarryKill H N p K) : PrimeBasepointFilteredCarryKill H N p K
declarations.docstring: Testing only the free-basepoint state locked through depth three recovers the full filtered kill: every omitted index already escaped during those first three steps.

declarations.name: primeBasepointSingleLockedCarryKill_iff_filtered
declarations.signature: theorem primeBasepointSingleLockedCarryKill_iff_filtered {H N p K : ℕ} (hK : 3 ≤ K) : PrimeBasepointSingleLockedCarryKill H N p K ↔ PrimeBasepointFilteredCarryKill H N p K
declarations.docstring: At every checked depth at least three, the full free-basepoint predicate is equivalent to testing its at-most-one locked state.

declarations.name: primeBasepointFilteredCarryKill_pred_iff
declarations.signature: theorem primeBasepointFilteredCarryKill_pred_iff {H p K : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) : PrimeBasepointFilteredCarryKill H (p - 1) p K ↔ PrimeFilteredCarryKill H p K
declarations.docstring: The original prime-predecessor predicate is exactly the general basepoint predicate at `N = p-1`.

declarations.name: tail_diff_notMem_int_of_primeBasepointFilteredCarryKill
declarations.signature: theorem tail_diff_notMem_int_of_primeBasepointFilteredCarryKill {H N p K : ℕ} (hkill : PrimeBasepointFilteredCarryKill H N p K) (hfilter : ∀ z : ℤ, (z : ℝ) = totientTail (N + H) - totientTail N → Int.ModEq (p : ℤ) z (-totientBlock H N)) : totientTail (N + H) - totientTail N ∉ Set.range ((↑) : ℤ → ℝ)
declarations.docstring: Soundness at an arbitrary basepoint. A filtered candidate which escaped the sharp integer strip cannot represent the true tail difference.

declarations.name: exists_primeBasepointFilteredCarryKill_of_tail_diff_notMem_int
declarations.signature: theorem exists_primeBasepointFilteredCarryKill_of_tail_diff_notMem_int {H N p : ℕ} (hnon : totientTail (N + H) - totientTail N ∉ Set.range ((↑) : ℤ → ℝ)) : ∃ K : ℕ, PrimeBasepointFilteredCarryKill H N p K
declarations.docstring: Pointwise completeness also survives basepoint decoupling: a nonintegral tail difference supplies a uniform finite escape depth for the finite filtered launch interval.

declarations.name: tail_diff_modEq_neg_totientBlock_of_scaled_tail
declarations.signature: theorem tail_diff_modEq_neg_totientBlock_of_scaled_tail {H N p v : ℕ} {d u : ℤ} (hp : p.Prime) (hpM : p ∣ 2 ^ H - 1) (hcop : Nat.Coprime p v) (hd : (d : ℝ) = totientTail (N + H) - totientTail N) (hu : (u : ℝ) = (v : ℝ) * totientTail N) : Int.ModEq (p : ℤ) d (-totientBlock H N)
declarations.docstring: The denominator filter in its algebraic core. If `v R_N` is an integer and a prime `p ∤ v` divides `2^H-1`, then every integral `H`-step tail difference is congruent to the negative cleared finite block modulo `p`.

declarations.name: tail_diff_modEq_neg_totientBlock_of_scaled_tail_factor
declarations.signature: theorem tail_diff_modEq_neg_totientBlock_of_scaled_tail_factor {H N v M : ℕ} {d u : ℤ} (hv : 0 < v) (hfactor : v * M = 2 ^ H - 1) (hd : (d : ℝ) = totientTail (N + H) - totientTail N) (hu : (u : ℝ) = (v : ℝ) * totientTail N) : Int.ModEq (M : ℤ) d (-totientBlock H N)
declarations.docstring: **Full Mersenne-factor filter.** Primality is not needed when the odd denominator factor itself has been divided from `2^H-1`. If `v * M = 2^H-1` and `v R_N` is integral, then every integral tail difference lies in the single class `-Q_(H,N) mod M`. Unlike a lone cyclotomic prime, this modulus can retain essentially the entire exponential Mersenne size.

declarations.name: scaled_tail_near_int_of_mersenne_factor_candidate
declarations.signature: theorem scaled_tail_near_int_of_mersenne_factor_candidate {H N v M : ℕ} (hM : 0 < M) (hfactor : v * M = 2 ^ H - 1) {z : ℤ} (hbox : |z| ≤ (N + H + 1 : ℤ)) (hmod : Int.ModEq (M : ℤ) z (-totientBlock H N)) : ∃ k : ℤ, |(v : ℝ) * totientTail N - (k : ℝ)| < (2 * (N + H + 2 : ℝ)) / (M : ℝ)
declarations.docstring: **Initial candidate as a near-integer witness.** Retaining the full Mersenne quotient changes the geometry qualitatively. Any filtered integer in the initial analytic box forces the fixed scaled tail `v R_N` to lie within `2(N+H+2)/M` of an integer. For denominator-compatible shifts this error tends to zero exponentially, while `v R_N` is fixed.

declarations.name: exists_uniform_int_gap_of_notMem_int
declarations.signature: theorem exists_uniform_int_gap_of_notMem_int {x : ℝ} (hx : x ∉ Set.range ((↑) : ℤ → ℝ)) : ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ z : ℤ, δ ≤ |x - (z : ℝ)|
declarations.docstring: Every noninteger real has a positive uniform distance from the integer lattice. This reusable floor-gap form is the topological half of the full-Mersenne initial-residue argument.

declarations.name: no_mersenne_factor_candidate_of_scaled_tail_gap
declarations.signature: theorem no_mersenne_factor_candidate_of_scaled_tail_gap {H N v M : ℕ} (hM : 0 < M) (hfactor : v * M = 2 ^ H - 1) {δ : ℝ} (hgap : ∀ k : ℤ, δ ≤ |(v : ℝ) * totientTail N - (k : ℝ)|) (hratio : (2 * (N + H + 2 : ℝ)) / (M : ℝ) < δ) : ∀ j ∈ Finset.range (2 * (N + H + 1) + 1), ¬Int.ModEq (M : ℤ) ((j : ℤ) - (N + H + 1 : ℤ)) (-totientBlock H N)
declarations.docstring: Once the full-Mersenne approximation error is below the lattice gap of `v R_N`, the initial analytic interval contains no filtered launch at all.

declarations.name: scaled_totientTail_notMem_int_of_irrational
declarations.signature: theorem scaled_totientTail_notMem_int_of_irrational (hirr : Irrational (∑' n : ℕ, (Nat.totient n : ℝ) / 2 ^ n)) {N v : ℕ} (hv : 0 < v) : (v : ℝ) * totientTail N ∉ Set.range ((↑) : ℤ → ℝ)
declarations.docstring: Irrationality of the full series makes every positive integral scaling of every shifted tail nonintegral. Otherwise the shift identity would write the original series as an explicit rational number.

declarations.name: exists_int_scaled_tail_of_rat_den_eq
declarations.signature: theorem exists_int_scaled_tail_of_rat_den_eq (r : ℚ) (hS : (∑' n : ℕ, (Nat.totient n : ℝ) / 2 ^ n) = (r : ℝ)) {c v N : ℕ} (hden : 2 ^ c * v = r.den) (hN : c ≤ N) : ∃ u : ℤ, (u : ℝ) = (v : ℝ) * totientTail N
declarations.docstring: Clearing the dyadic part of a rational denominator leaves an integral multiple of every sufficiently shifted tail.

declarations.name: binaryCyclotomicLayer
declarations.docstring: The unsigned binary cyclotomic layer `|Φ_n(2)|`.

declarations.name: binaryCyclotomicLayer_dvd_mersenneLayer
declarations.signature: theorem binaryCyclotomicLayer_dvd_mersenneLayer (n : ℕ) : binaryCyclotomicLayer n ∣ mersenneLayer n
declarations.docstring: Every binary cyclotomic layer divides the corresponding Mersenne number.

declarations.name: binaryCyclotomicLayer_prime_order_decomposition
declarations.signature: theorem binaryCyclotomicLayer_prime_order_decomposition {n p : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (hp : p.Prime) (hpdvd : p ∣ binaryCyclotomicLayer n) : ∃ a : ℕ, n = p ^ a * orderOf ((2 : ℕ) : ZMod p)
declarations.docstring: A prime divisor of `Φ_n(2)` supplies the characteristic-free order decomposition `n = p^a * ord_p(2)`. The decomposition remains valid in the exceptional characteristic case; cleanliness below is exactly what forces `a = 0`.

declarations.name: two_ne_zero_of_prime_dvd_binaryCyclotomicLayer
declarations.signature: theorem two_ne_zero_of_prime_dvd_binaryCyclotomicLayer {n p : ℕ} (hn : 1 < n) (hp : p.Prime) (hpdvd : p ∣ binaryCyclotomicLayer n) : ((2 : ℕ) : ZMod p) ≠ 0
declarations.docstring: The residue of `2` is nonzero at every prime divisor of a positive binary cyclotomic layer.

declarations.name: exists_clean_binaryCyclotomicAnchor
declarations.signature: theorem exists_clean_binaryCyclotomicAnchor (h N₀ : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) : ∃ q p : ℕ, q.Prime ∧ p.Prime ∧ Nat.Coprime p (h * q) ∧ p ∣ binaryCyclotomicLayer (h * q) ∧ h * q ∣ p - 1 ∧ N₀ ≤ p - 1
declarations.docstring: **Unconditional clean composite-ray producer.** For every positive period `h` and every threshold, a prime-index multiplier `q` and a prime factor `p` of `Φ_(h*q)(2)` can be chosen so that the factor is clean, `ord_p(2) = h*q`, and hence `h*q ∣ p-1`. The characteristic-prime case is eliminated directly from the exact cyclotomic order decomposition. Choosing `q > 2^h` rules out `p = q`; choosing `q > h` rules out every `p ∣ h`.

declarations.name: tail_diff_int_of_period_mul
declarations.signature: lemma tail_diff_int_of_period_mul {h N₀ : ℕ} (hint : ∀ N, N₀ ≤ N → totientTail (N + h) - totientTail N ∈ Set.range ((↑) : ℤ → ℝ)) : ∀ k N, N₀ ≤ N → totientTail (N + h * k) - totientTail N ∈ Set.range ((↑) : ℤ → ℝ)
declarations.docstring: An eventual `h`-period tail-integrality law also holds for every positive or zero multiple `h * k`, by telescoping `k` adjacent differences.

declarations.name: CleanCyclotomicAnchorSupply
declarations.docstring: Cofinal clean cyclotomic provenance, without any certificate field.

declarations.name: cleanCyclotomicAnchorSupply_binaryCyclotomicLayer
declarations.docstring: The actual binary cyclotomic layers have unconditional cofinal clean anchors.

declarations.name: CyclotomicPrimeFilteredCarryKillSupply
declarations.docstring: The exact denominator-filtered residual. At a cofinal clean cyclotomic anchor, only the carry candidates in one forced residue class modulo `p` must be expelled. Since `H ∣ p-1`, the initial interval contains at most four such candidates.

declarations.name: CyclotomicPrimeFourCarryKillSupply
declarations.docstring: The same cofinal residual with the carry search literally restricted to the four possible representatives.

declarations.name: CyclotomicPrimeSingleLockedCarryKillSupply
declarations.docstring: The exact cofinal residual after the four-to-one collapse: each clean anchor asks only whether its at-most-one state locked through depth three eventually leaves the sharp strip.

declarations.name: PrimeBasepointFilteredCarryKillSupply
declarations.docstring: Basepoint-decoupled prime-filter supply. A multiple `H` of the denominator period supplies the Mersenne divisor, while the left endpoint `N` is free to carry an independently constructed short arithmetic window. The size condition `H ≤ p-1` retains the large-modulus geometry of clean cyclotomic anchors.

declarations.name: PrimeBasepointSingleLockedCarryKillSupply
declarations.docstring: Exact one-locked-state version of the basepoint-decoupled supply.

declarations.name: primeBasepointSingleLockedCarryKillSupply_iff_filtered
declarations.docstring: The free-basepoint one-state supply and full filtered supply are exactly equivalent.

declarations.name: cyclotomicPrimeFourCarryKillSupply_iff_filtered
declarations.signature: theorem cyclotomicPrimeFourCarryKillSupply_iff_filtered {C : ℕ → ℕ} : CyclotomicPrimeFourCarryKillSupply C ↔ CyclotomicPrimeFilteredCarryKillSupply C
declarations.docstring: Cofinal four-state and residue-filtered supplies are exactly equivalent; the order divisibility field supplies the required bound `H ≤ p-1`.

declarations.name: cyclotomicPrimeSingleLockedCarryKillSupply_iff_four
declarations.signature: theorem cyclotomicPrimeSingleLockedCarryKillSupply_iff_four {C : ℕ → ℕ} : CyclotomicPrimeSingleLockedCarryKillSupply C ↔ CyclotomicPrimeFourCarryKillSupply C
declarations.docstring: Cofinal one-state and four-state supplies are exactly equivalent. In the reverse direction a certificate is harmlessly extended to depth three before restricting it to the locked state.

declarations.name: primeBasepointFilteredCarryKillSupply_of_cyclotomicFiltered
declarations.signature: theorem primeBasepointFilteredCarryKillSupply_of_cyclotomicFiltered {C : ℕ → ℕ} (hsupply : CyclotomicPrimeFilteredCarryKillSupply C) : PrimeBasepointFilteredCarryKillSupply
declarations.docstring: Every cyclotomic filtered supply furnishes the more flexible basepoint-decoupled supply by taking its original endpoint `N = p-1`.

declarations.name: irrational_totient_series_of_primeBasepointFilteredCarryKillSupply
declarations.signature: theorem irrational_totient_series_of_primeBasepointFilteredCarryKillSupply (hsupply : PrimeBasepointFilteredCarryKillSupply) : Irrational (∑' n : ℕ, (Nat.totient n : ℝ) / 2 ^ n)
declarations.docstring: **Basepoint-decoupled conditional closure of Erdős #249.** Rationality clears the dyadic denominator at the independently supplied endpoint `N`; the odd denominator is absorbed because its Euler period divides `H`, and the fresh prime divisor of `2^H-1` forces the filtered block congruence.

declarations.name: irrational_totient_series_of_cyclotomicPrimeFilteredCarryKillSupply
declarations.signature: theorem irrational_totient_series_of_cyclotomicPrimeFilteredCarryKillSupply {C : ℕ → ℕ} (hsupply : CyclotomicPrimeFilteredCarryKillSupply C) : Irrational (∑' n : ℕ, (Nat.totient n : ℝ) / 2 ^ n)
declarations.docstring: **Prime-filtered conditional closure of Erdős #249.** Rationality splits its denominator as `2^c v`; Euler supplies a base period `φ(v)`, and every clean cyclotomic multiple forces an integral tail carry into the single residue class checked by `PrimeFilteredCarryKill`.

declarations.name: cyclotomicPrimeFilteredCarryKillSupply_of_irrational_of_cleanAnchorSupply
declarations.signature: theorem cyclotomicPrimeFilteredCarryKillSupply_of_irrational_of_cleanAnchorSupply {C : ℕ → ℕ} (hclean : CleanCyclotomicAnchorSupply C) (hMersenne : ∀ n : ℕ, C n ∣ mersenneLayer n) (hirr : Irrational (∑' n : ℕ, (Nat.totient n : ℝ) / 2 ^ n)) : CyclotomicPrimeFilteredCarryKillSupply C
declarations.docstring: Irrationality repopulates the filtered finite certificates at any clean anchor family whose layers divide the corresponding Mersenne values.

declarations.name: cyclotomicPrimeFilteredCarryKillSupply_iff_irrational_of_cleanAnchorSupply
declarations.signature: theorem cyclotomicPrimeFilteredCarryKillSupply_iff_irrational_of_cleanAnchorSupply {C : ℕ → ℕ} (hclean : CleanCyclotomicAnchorSupply C) (hMersenne : ∀ n : ℕ, C n ∣ mersenneLayer n) : CyclotomicPrimeFilteredCarryKillSupply C ↔ Irrational (∑' n : ℕ, (Nat.totient n : ℝ) / 2 ^ n)
declarations.docstring: With clean Mersenne-dividing layers, the denominator-filtered four-state certificate supply is exactly Erdős #249, not a stronger surrogate.

declarations.name: binaryCyclotomicPrimeFilteredCarryKillSupply_iff_irrational
declarations.signature: theorem binaryCyclotomicPrimeFilteredCarryKillSupply_iff_irrational : CyclotomicPrimeFilteredCarryKillSupply binaryCyclotomicLayer ↔ Irrational (∑' n : ℕ, (Nat.totient n : ℝ) / 2 ^ n)
declarations.docstring: Exact prime-filtered claim ceiling for the concrete binary cyclotomic layers.

declarations.name: primeBasepointFilteredCarryKillSupply_iff_irrational
declarations.signature: theorem primeBasepointFilteredCarryKillSupply_iff_irrational : PrimeBasepointFilteredCarryKillSupply ↔ Irrational (∑' n : ℕ, (Nat.totient n : ℝ) / 2 ^ n)
declarations.docstring: The basepoint-decoupled supply is itself exactly Erdős #249. The forward implication uses its direct consumer; the reverse implication is already furnished by clean binary cyclotomic anchors.

declarations.name: FullMersenneSingleLockedCarryKillSupply
declarations.docstring: **Full-Mersenne one-state claim ceiling.** For every possible dyadic preperiod `c` and positive odd denominator factor `v`, a remote multiple `H` of `φ(v)` retains the whole quotient `M = (2^H - 1) / v`. The quotient is required to exceed the complete initial carry radius, so its launches locked through depth three form an at-most-one set. The only remaining demand is that this single state eventually escape.

declarations.name: fullMersenneSingleLockedCarryKillSupply_of_irrational
declarations.signature: theorem fullMersenneSingleLockedCarryKillSupply_of_irrational (hirr : Irrational (∑' n : ℕ, (Nat.totient n : ℝ) / 2 ^ n)) : FullMersenneSingleLockedCarryKillSupply
declarations.docstring: Irrationality supplies the full-Mersenne one-state certificates. The exponential quotient is made larger than the chosen linear carry radius by the repository's general linear-versus-power lemma; Euler supplies the exact denominator factor.

declarations.name: irrational_totient_series_of_fullMersenneSingleLockedCarryKillSupply
declarations.signature: theorem irrational_totient_series_of_fullMersenneSingleLockedCarryKillSupply (hsupply : FullMersenneSingleLockedCarryKillSupply) : Irrational (∑' n : ℕ, (Nat.totient n : ℝ) / 2 ^ n)
declarations.docstring: The full Mersenne quotient directly excludes rationality. For the actual odd denominator factor `v`, the supplied factorization makes every integral tail difference land in the retained composite residue class; the one-state certificate is losslessly converted back to the full filtered kill.

declarations.name: fullMersenneSingleLockedCarryKillSupply_iff_irrational
declarations.signature: theorem fullMersenneSingleLockedCarryKillSupply_iff_irrational : FullMersenneSingleLockedCarryKillSupply ↔ Irrational (∑' n : ℕ, (Nat.totient n : ℝ) / 2 ^ n)
declarations.docstring: The full-Mersenne one-state residual is exactly Erdős #249. It loses neither direction while replacing the prime factor by an exponentially large denominator quotient and certifying that only one launch survives the initial collapse.

declarations.name: fullMersenneBlockResidue
declarations.signature: def fullMersenneBlockResidue (H N M : ℕ) : ℤ
declarations.docstring: The least nonnegative representative of the forced full-Mersenne block class.

declarations.name: FullMersenneCenteredResidueGap
declarations.signature: def FullMersenneCenteredResidueGap (H N M : ℕ) : Prop
declarations.docstring: The forced block residue lies in the central open arc left after removing the complete initial analytic interval from both ends of a modulus.

declarations.name: fullMersenneBlockResidue_succ
declarations.signature: theorem fullMersenneBlockResidue_succ {H N M : ℕ} (hM : M ∣ 2 ^ H - 1) : fullMersenneBlockResidue H (N + 1) M = (2 * fullMersenneBlockResidue H N M - deltaTotient H (N + 1)) % (M : ℤ)
declarations.docstring: **Exact centered-residue dynamics.** Once `M` divides the height-`H` Mersenne number, sliding the basepoint doubles the current residue and subtracts the new totient-difference letter. The large endpoint term in `totientBlock_succ` disappears modulo `M`; no analytic tail or carry lift remains in this recurrence.

declarations.name: fullMersenneBlockCenteredLift
declarations.signature: def fullMersenneBlockCenteredLift (H N M : ℕ) : ℤ
declarations.docstring: The canonical signed representative of the forced full-Mersenne block class. Unlike the least nonnegative residue, this lives in the closed signed half-cell around zero.

declarations.name: fullMersenneBlockCenteredLift_emod
declarations.signature: theorem fullMersenneBlockCenteredLift_emod (H N M : ℕ) : fullMersenneBlockCenteredLift H N M % (M : ℤ) = fullMersenneBlockResidue H N M
declarations.docstring: Centering preserves exactly the least nonnegative full-Mersenne block residue.

declarations.name: fullMersenneBlockCenteredLift_succ_modEq
declarations.signature: theorem fullMersenneBlockCenteredLift_succ_modEq {H N M : ℕ} (hM : M ∣ 2 ^ H - 1) : Int.ModEq (M : ℤ) (fullMersenneBlockCenteredLift H (N + 1) M) (2 * fullMersenneBlockCenteredLift H N M - deltaTotient H (N + 1))
declarations.docstring: Signed centered lifts obey the same affine recurrence modulo every divisor of `2^H-1`. This is the signed version of `fullMersenneBlockResidue_succ`, suitable for a later no-wrap argument.

declarations.name: fullMersenneBlockCenteredLift_succ_eq_of_abs_add_abs_lt
declarations.signature: theorem fullMersenneBlockCenteredLift_succ_eq_of_abs_add_abs_lt {H N M : ℕ} (hM : M ∣ 2 ^ H - 1) (hsmall : |fullMersenneBlockCenteredLift H (N + 1) M| + |2 * fullMersenneBlockCenteredLift H N M - deltaTotient H (N + 1)| < (M : ℤ)) : fullMersenneBlockCenteredLift H (N + 1) M = 2 * fullMersenneBlockCenteredLift H N M - deltaTotient H (N + 1)
declarations.docstring: Quantitative no-wrap principle for the centered residue dynamics. If the two signed sides together fit strictly inside one modulus, their modular affine recurrence is an actual equality in `ℤ`.

declarations.name: fullMersenneCenteredResidueGap_iff_abs_centeredLift
declarations.signature: theorem fullMersenneCenteredResidueGap_iff_abs_centeredLift {H N M : ℕ} (hM : 0 < M) (hroom : 2 * (N + H + 2) ≤ M) : FullMersenneCenteredResidueGap H N M ↔ ((N + H + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) < |fullMersenneBlockCenteredLift H N M|
declarations.docstring: With one unit of room for strict integer inequalities, the open central residue arc is exactly escape of the signed centered lift from the analytic radius `N+H+1`. This turns the remaining Euclidean two-sided band into one absolute-value inequality.

declarations.name: fullMersenneBlockCenteredLift_succ_eq_of_two_edge_locks
declarations.signature: theorem fullMersenneBlockCenteredLift_succ_eq_of_two_edge_locks {H N M : ℕ} (hM : 0 < M) (hMersenne : M ∣ 2 ^ H - 1) (hlarge : 4 * (N + H + 3) < M) (hlock : ¬FullMersenneCenteredResidueGap H N M) (hlockSucc : ¬FullMersenneCenteredResidueGap H (N + 1) M) : fullMersenneBlockCenteredLift H (N + 1) M = 2 * fullMersenneBlockCenteredLift H N M - deltaTotient H (N + 1)
declarations.docstring: **Two-edge-lock rigidity.** When the modulus is wider than four successive analytic radii, failure of the central gap at two adjacent basepoints removes every possible modular wrap. The signed representatives must then follow the literal affine totient-difference recurrence in `ℤ`. Thus a long edge-locked residue orbit is not merely congruent to a carry orbit: in the large-modulus regime it *is* that orbit.

declarations.name: fullMersenneBlockCenteredLift_add_eq_carryOrbit_of_edge_locks
declarations.signature: theorem fullMersenneBlockCenteredLift_add_eq_carryOrbit_of_edge_locks {H N M L : ℕ} (hM : 0 < M) (hMersenne : M ∣ 2 ^ H - 1) (hlarge : 4 * (N + L + H + 3) < M) (hlock : ∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ L → ¬FullMersenneCenteredResidueGap H (N + i) M) : ∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ L → fullMersenneBlockCenteredLift H (N + i) M = carryOrbit H N (fullMersenneBlockCenteredLift H N M) i
declarations.docstring: **Interval edge-lock rigidity.** If the central full-Mersenne gap fails through a whole interval and the modulus has room for the final analytic radius, then every centered block lift on that interval is literally the ordinary integer carry orbit launched from the first lift. This is the iterated form of `fullMersenneBlockCenteredLift_succ_eq_of_two_edge_locks`; there is no modular ambiguity left anywhere in the interval.

declarations.name: exists_fullMersenneCenteredResidueGap_of_carryOrbit_escape
declarations.signature: theorem exists_fullMersenneCenteredResidueGap_of_carryOrbit_escape {H N M L : ℕ} (hM : 0 < M) (hMersenne : M ∣ 2 ^ H - 1) (hlarge : 4 * (N + L + H + 3) < M) (hescape : ∃ i : ℕ, i ≤ L ∧ (((N + i + H + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) < |carryOrbit H N (fullMersenneBlockCenteredLift H N M) i|)) : ∃ i : ℕ, i ≤ L ∧ FullMersenneCenteredResidueGap H (N + i) M
declarations.docstring: **Finite full-Mersenne escape certificate.** Under the same large-modulus geometry, it is enough to find one depth at which the ordinary carry orbit launched from the canonical signed block lift exceeds the local analytic radius. Some central full-Mersenne residue gap must then already occur at or before that depth. This is the exact contrapositive consumer of interval edge-lock rigidity.

declarations.name: exists_fullMersenneCenteredResidueGap_of_survivorKill
declarations.signature: theorem exists_fullMersenneCenteredResidueGap_of_survivorKill {H N M L : ℕ} (hM : 0 < M) (hMersenne : M ∣ 2 ^ H - 1) (hlarge : 4 * (N + L + H + 3) < M) (hkill : survivorKill H N L) : ∃ i : ℕ, i ≤ L ∧ FullMersenneCenteredResidueGap H (N + i) M
declarations.docstring: The ordinary finite survivor certificate can now be consumed directly against the canonical full-Mersenne residue. If every integer launch in the initial analytic box escapes by depth `L`, then a modulus large enough to prevent wrapping cannot remain edge-locked throughout that interval.

declarations.name: survivorKill_of_certifiedKill
declarations.signature: theorem survivorKill_of_certifiedKill {H N L : ℕ} (hcert : certifiedKill H N L) : survivorKill H N L
declarations.docstring: A central dyadic endpoint certificate kills every launch in the initial analytic box at its certified depth. This packages the endpoint-fibre interpretation of `certifiedKill` in the `survivorKill` interface used by the full-Mersenne dynamics.

declarations.name: exists_fullMersenneCenteredResidueGap_of_certifiedKill
declarations.signature: theorem exists_fullMersenneCenteredResidueGap_of_certifiedKill {H N M L : ℕ} (hM : 0 < M) (hMersenne : M ∣ 2 ^ H - 1) (hlarge : 4 * (N + L + H + 3) < M) (hcert : certifiedKill H N L) : ∃ i : ℕ, i ≤ L ∧ FullMersenneCenteredResidueGap H (N + i) M
declarations.docstring: Every ordinary dyadic central-arc certificate therefore forces a genuine central gap for any sufficiently large divisor of the same Mersenne layer. This lets the existing checked certificate bank feed the exact full-Mersenne quotient geometry without another launch enumeration.

declarations.name: FullMersenneInitialResidueGap
declarations.signature: def FullMersenneInitialResidueGap (H N M : ℕ) : Prop
declarations.docstring: The full Mersenne quotient residue misses the complete initial analytic interval. Equivalently, there is no denominator-compatible launch even before the carry orbit is iterated.

declarations.name: fullMersenneInitialResidueGap_iff_centered
declarations.signature: theorem fullMersenneInitialResidueGap_iff_centered {H N M : ℕ} (hM : 0 < M) : FullMersenneInitialResidueGap H N M ↔ FullMersenneCenteredResidueGap H N M
declarations.docstring: Exact Euclidean normal form of the zero-launch condition. For a positive modulus, absence of every representative in `[-B,B]` is equivalent to the least nonnegative block residue lying strictly between `B` and `M-B`.

declarations.name: mersenne_factor_modulus_pos
declarations.signature: theorem mersenne_factor_modulus_pos {H v M : ℕ} (hH : 0 < H) (hfactor : v * M = 2 ^ H - 1) : 0 < M
declarations.docstring: Any positive-height exact factorization `v M = 2^H - 1` has a positive quotient.

declarations.name: FullMersenneInitialResidueGapSupply
declarations.docstring: **Full-Mersenne launch-gap claim ceiling.** For every possible rational denominator and every requested basepoint, a remote Euler multiple has a full quotient whose forced block residue misses the entire initial analytic interval.

declarations.name: FullMersenneCenteredResidueGapSupply
declarations.docstring: Pure centered-residue form of the full-Mersenne residual. This is an explicit arithmetic statement about one finite block sum and one Euclidean remainder; it contains no carry orbit and no quantified launch index.

declarations.name: FullMersenneCanonicalBasepointResidueGapSupply
declarations.docstring: **Canonical-denominator basepoint form.** For a prospective rational denominator `2^c v`, the finite block starts at the single forced basepoint `N = c`. There is no remote-basepoint quantifier and no basepoint witness; only the Euler-multiple height and its exact Mersenne quotient remain.

declarations.name: exists_fullMersenneInitialResidueGap_at_of_irrational
declarations.signature: theorem exists_fullMersenneInitialResidueGap_at_of_irrational (hirr : Irrational (∑' n : ℕ, (Nat.totient n : ℝ) / 2 ^ n)) (v N : ℕ) (hv : 0 < v) (hcop : Nat.Coprime 2 v) : ∃ H M : ℕ, 0 < H ∧ Nat.totient v ∣ H ∧ v * M = 2 ^ H - 1 ∧ FullMersenneInitialResidueGap H N M
declarations.docstring: At every *prescribed* basepoint, irrationality supplies a sufficiently large Euler-multiple height whose full Mersenne quotient misses the complete analytic launch interval. This is stronger than merely finding a remote basepoint: `N` is fixed before `H` is chosen.

declarations.name: fullMersenneInitialResidueGapSupply_of_irrational
declarations.signature: theorem fullMersenneInitialResidueGapSupply_of_irrational (hirr : Irrational (∑' n : ℕ, (Nat.totient n : ℝ) / 2 ^ n)) : FullMersenneInitialResidueGapSupply
declarations.docstring: Irrationality forces cofinally remote full-Mersenne launch gaps. At a fixed basepoint `N`, the scaled tail `v R_N` has a positive distance from the integer lattice. An Euler multiple `H` is then chosen so that the exponentially large quotient `(2^H-1)/v` makes every hypothetical launch contradict this fixed gap.

declarations.name: irrational_totient_series_of_fullMersenneInitialResidueGapSupply
declarations.signature: theorem irrational_totient_series_of_fullMersenneInitialResidueGapSupply (hsupply : FullMersenneInitialResidueGapSupply) : Irrational (∑' n : ℕ, (Nat.totient n : ℝ) / 2 ^ n)
declarations.docstring: A full-Mersenne launch-gap supply excludes every rational denominator. The rational-denominator clearing argument forces the true integral tail difference into precisely the residue class which the supplied gap says does not meet its unavoidable analytic interval.

declarations.name: fullMersenneInitialResidueGapSupply_iff_irrational
declarations.signature: theorem fullMersenneInitialResidueGapSupply_iff_irrational : FullMersenneInitialResidueGapSupply ↔ Irrational (∑' n : ℕ, (Nat.totient n : ℝ) / 2 ^ n)
declarations.docstring: **Exact zero-launch claim ceiling.** Erdős #249 is equivalent to the statement that, for every possible rational denominator, some remote full Mersenne quotient has no compatible integer even in the initial analytic box. Thus no positive-depth carry search remains in the exact residual.

declarations.name: fullMersenneCenteredResidueGapSupply_iff_irrational
declarations.signature: theorem fullMersenneCenteredResidueGapSupply_iff_irrational : FullMersenneCenteredResidueGapSupply ↔ Irrational (∑' n : ℕ, (Nat.totient n : ℝ) / 2 ^ n)
declarations.docstring: **Arithmetic normal form of Erdős #249.** The problem is exactly the cofinal centrality of the explicit remainder `(-totientBlock H N) % ((2^H-1)/v)`. All analytic tails, carry trajectories, cyclotomic prime choices, and finite launch searches have been eliminated from this equivalent claim.

declarations.name: fullMersenneCenteredResidueGapSupply_of_canonicalBasepoint
declarations.docstring: A canonical-basepoint gap can be inflated to any requested remote basepoint by feeding `max c N₀` into the dyadic-exponent slot. The odd denominator `v`, Euler height condition, and full Mersenne quotient are unchanged.

declarations.name: fullMersenneCanonicalBasepointResidueGapSupply_of_irrational
declarations.signature: theorem fullMersenneCanonicalBasepointResidueGapSupply_of_irrational (hirr : Irrational (∑' n : ℕ, (Nat.totient n : ℝ) / 2 ^ n)) : FullMersenneCanonicalBasepointResidueGapSupply
declarations.docstring: Irrationality supplies the centered gap at the exact denominator basepoint `N = c`; no search in `N` is needed.

declarations.name: fullMersenneCanonicalBasepointResidueGapSupply_iff_irrational
declarations.signature: theorem fullMersenneCanonicalBasepointResidueGapSupply_iff_irrational : FullMersenneCanonicalBasepointResidueGapSupply ↔ Irrational (∑' n : ℕ, (Nat.totient n : ℝ) / 2 ^ n)
declarations.docstring: **Fixed-basepoint arithmetic normal form of Erdős #249.** For every candidate denominator `2^c v`, it is enough—and is exactly equivalent—to find one Euler-multiple height `H` for which `(-totientBlock H c) % ((2^H-1)/v)` lies outside the two endpoint intervals of width `c+H+1`. The arbitrary remote basepoint and its witness have disappeared.

declarations.name: primeBasepointSingleLockedCarryKillSupply_iff_irrational
declarations.signature: theorem primeBasepointSingleLockedCarryKillSupply_iff_irrational : PrimeBasepointSingleLockedCarryKillSupply ↔ Irrational (∑' n : ℕ, (Nat.totient n : ℝ) / 2 ^ n)
declarations.docstring: The most compressed free-basepoint claim ceiling is exactly Erdős #249: every remote clean anchor has at most one three-step survivor, and that sole state eventually escapes.

declarations.name: irrational_totient_series_of_cyclotomicPrimeFourCarryKillSupply
declarations.signature: theorem irrational_totient_series_of_cyclotomicPrimeFourCarryKillSupply {C : ℕ → ℕ} (hsupply : CyclotomicPrimeFourCarryKillSupply C) : Irrational (∑' n : ℕ, (Nat.totient n : ℝ) / 2 ^ n)
declarations.docstring: Four-state conditional closure of Erdős #249.

declarations.name: cyclotomicPrimeFourCarryKillSupply_iff_irrational_of_cleanAnchorSupply
declarations.signature: theorem cyclotomicPrimeFourCarryKillSupply_iff_irrational_of_cleanAnchorSupply {C : ℕ → ℕ} (hclean : CleanCyclotomicAnchorSupply C) (hMersenne : ∀ n : ℕ, C n ∣ mersenneLayer n) : CyclotomicPrimeFourCarryKillSupply C ↔ Irrational (∑' n : ℕ, (Nat.totient n : ℝ) / 2 ^ n)

declarations.name: binaryCyclotomicPrimeFourCarryKillSupply_iff_irrational
